About the Role

Hinge Health uses software, including AI, to deliver care for joint and muscle health, and has expanded into pelvic health, migraine, and digestive health. We partner with employers and health plans to provide this care at scale, improving members' quality of life and reducing healthcare costs.

The Visits team owns scheduling for all of Hinge Health, along with the visit experience in our member app and in the tools our care team uses. That covers HingeSelect (our network of specialists, in-person providers, and surgeons) and visits in every Hinge Health program, from physical therapy to migraine and GI care.

Next, we want every visit at Hinge Health to feel like the best doctor's office you've been to, minus the clipboards and hold music. Members should be able to find the right visit, book it in a few taps, show up prepared, and afterward see what happened and what to do next, whether the visit was by video or in person. Providers should be able to act on a visit without leaving our tools, from referrals to labs to prescriptions. Each visit leaves a structured record that shapes the next one, from the follow-up booking to AI experiences that help members act on their care.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Visits, you'll own projects across that experience, from technical design through launch, while visit volume grows many times over. Your strength might be mobile, web, or the services behind them. There's central work here for each, and nobody is expected to be an expert in all three. It's 0-to-1 work at a startup's pace, backed by the resources and data of a market leader.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Lead projects from ambiguity to launch: Partner with product, design, and clinical teams to turn loosely defined goals into sequenced plans that several engineers can build against, then ship them at a high, steady pace.

  • Extend the scheduling platform: Grow the system every Hinge Health visit is booked through to support more specialties, more providers, and real-time booking with outside provider networks, while keeping every booking correct as volume climbs.

  • Close the loop after each visit: Build encounters, our record of what happened at each visit, along with the visit history and after-visit summaries that members see in the app, providers work from, and our AI experiences build on.

  • Bring new specialties onto one platform: Launch specialties like migraine and GI care on shared visit infrastructure, so adding the next one is mostly configuration rather than a rebuild.

  • Run what you ship: Define SLOs for the systems you own, roll out launches and migrations safely, lead incident response through to root-cause fixes, and protect member health data in every design and code review.

  • Raise the engineering bar: Write design docs for key decisions, give high-signal code reviews, and mentor earlier-career engineers. Use AI tools to multiply your own output and help teammates do the same.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.

  • Professional experience with at least one of the languages or frameworks we use: TypeScript, Go, React Native, or React.

  • Experience leading a production feature or system from technical design through launch, working closely with product and design partners.

  • Professional experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) in your day-to-day engineering work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building products 0-to-1 in a rapid-growth environment, using data and experiments to decide what to build next.

  • Experience shipping product features powered by LLMs or agentic workflows to production.

  • Experience building scheduling, booking, or marketplace systems at scale.

  • Experience with clinical data and healthcare integrations, such as FHIR or HL7 data, EHRs, claims, labs, or pharmacies.

  • Familiarity with our core stack: React Native, React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Go, gRPC, Postgres, Temporal, Kafka, Docker, and AWS.

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance tech, or other high-compliance industries (HIPAA, SOC 2).


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About this role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Hinge Health, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale software solutions that directly impact our members’ health outcomes. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners, including product managers and designers, to deliver new product capabilities and improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of our features. This role is essential to advancing our mission of transforming joint and muscle care through technology, including the integration of AI-driven solutions to automate and enhance care delivery. Hinge Health software engineers work on small interdisciplinary teams focused on different parts of the user journey.

As a member of the Accounts team, you will help build and shape new improved experiences with impact across the whole company. A resilient and scalable Accounts system ensures both stability and helps with growth of our member base. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to build scalable, performant, and accessible applications that will enable every user to securely register, sign in and access our features

Frontend engineers contribute to their team’s success by adding beautiful, useful features to Hinge Health applications. Senior frontend engineers design and implement end-to-end solutions for large-scale features, profile app performance, and help maintain a high bar with thoughtful and constructive code reviews.

We enjoy a continuous deployment DevOps culture, and take owner-operator pride in supporting our code in production with an on-call rotation. Rotations vary by team. Our production systems rely on React Native, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Nestjs, GraphQL, Golang, Docker, Temporal, Rails, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Apollo, and Redux. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security/compliance posture is at the highest standards of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Exhibit strong user and business judgment, grounding decisions in customer needs and business priorities to drive durable product value

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 3+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • Experience with at least one software programming language

  • Experience in the full software development life cycle

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment

  • Experience with mobile app development/deployment lifecycles

  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript

  • Experience with cloud based services (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, and gRPC, protobufs, and temporal, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design and coding assistance

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or scalable architectures

  • Experience with healthcare technology or regulated environments

  • Experience with Agile development practices

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hinge Health is a digital health company focused on delivering evidence-based solutions for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain. By combining personalized exercise therapy with virtual care, Hinge Health empowers individuals to manage and reduce chronic pain - improving quality of life and reducing healthcare costs. We partner with employers and health plans to provide these solutions at scale, helping organizations enhance employee health and productivity.

With the launch of HingeSelect, we’re taking the next big step: integrating digital and in-person care for improved outcomes and a better member experience. We are also improving our processes around ingesting and handling member data with focus on security, observability and traceability.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is passionate about creating exceptional user experiences using Golang, gRPC based micro-services. As a member of the Accounts team, you will help build and shape new improved experiences with impact across the whole company. A resilient and scalable Accounts system ensures both stability and helps with growth of our member base. This role has a strong focus on user identity and account management — registration, authentication, authorization, and identity provider integrations — so hands-on experience with identity management platforms (e.g., Auth0, Okta) and IAM concepts (SSO, OIDC, SAML, MFA/passwordless auth) is highly valued. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to build scalable, performant, and accessible applications.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a high-impact product in its early stages. You’ll play a key role in defining the technical foundations and ensuring a seamless and delightful experience for users. The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, is comfortable with ambiguity, and cares deeply about product quality and user experience.

Backend engineers at Hinge Health contribute to their team’s success by architecting and implementing end-to-end solutions, well-tested performant APIs and data models. In addition, candidates will profile their systems to stay out ahead of scaling bottlenecks, and help maintain a high bar with thoughtful and constructive code reviews.

We enjoy a continuous deployment DevOps culture, and take owner-operator pride in supporting our code in production. Our production systems rely on Golang, gRPC, AWS, Postgres, Redis, and temporal. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security/compliance posture is at the highest standards of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Design, build, and operate identity and account management systems — member registration and sign-in workflows, OTP/MFA verification, social login, account linking, and identity provider (e.g., Auth0) integrations.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 3+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • Experience with at least one software programming language

  • Experience in the full software development life cycle

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Golang, Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.)

  • Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud based services (e.g. gRPC, protobufs, temporal, Docker/Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.)

  • Experience building or maintaining user identity, authentication, or account management systems (e.g., registration, sign-in, credential/identity linking, role-based authorization)

  • Hands-on experience with an identity provider platform such as Auth0, Okta, or similar (OIDC, SAML, SSO, passwordless or social authentication, IdP management/authentication APIs)

  • Experience with data ingestion, integration and security is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Auth0 specifically — Management/Authentication APIs, Organizations, event streams or tenant/connection configuration — or comparable IdP depth

  • Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM) concepts: multi-factor authentication, entity resolution/deduplication for user or member records, and credential lifecycle management

  • Experience with Temporal (or similar durable workflow engines) for orchestrating user lifecycle operations such as registration, bootstrapping, or invitations

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design and coding assistance

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or scalable architectures

  • Experience with healthcare technology or regulated environments

  • Experience with Agile development practices

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

About Us

Hinge Health is pioneering the world's most patient-centered Digital Musculoskeletal (MSK) Clinic. We are building a world-class R&D organization where engineers, product managers and designers can move fast with confidence, create high-quality solutions and stay deeply engaged in their work.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead Agentic Engineering and Developer Experience across Hinge Health R&D. In this role, you will treat the software development lifecycle as a product—using agentic workflows, developer platforms, and automation to transform how we build, test, deploy, and operate software.

You will own the product strategy and roadmap for improving the end-to-end developer experience, identifying and eliminating friction from concept and code creation through testing, deployment, and observability. Your goal will be to help our teams deliver high-quality products faster, more reliably, and with greater confidence. Working closely with engineering and technical leaders, you will uncover where development slows down, identify the highest-leverage opportunities for improvement, and translate them into products, platforms, and workflows that drive measurable gains in developer velocity, software quality, and developer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

You will define and drive Hinge Health’s strategy for Agentic Engineering and Developer Experience, partnering with technical leaders across Service Enablement, App Enablement, Platform Quality, SRE, Security, and Infrastructure to identify where AI agents, automation, developer platforms, and workflow improvements can meaningfully increase R&D capacity. You will own developer efficiency as a product area, translating real-world engineering friction into prioritized quarterly roadmaps and measurable investments that improve how teams build, ship and operate software.

  • Advance Agentic Development: Identify, validate, and scale AI-powered workflows across coding, testing, debugging, observability, and knowledge discovery. Measure success through demonstrated improvements in productivity, quality, and developer experience—not tool adoption alone.

  • Accelerate Developer Velocity: Improve local development, CI/CD, build and test infrastructure, code review, ephemeral environments, and release workflows to shorten feedback loops and reduce lead time for changes.

  • Build Paved Roads: Partner with engineering teams to create reusable platforms, self-service capabilities, and standardized development paths that reduce unnecessary complexity and make it easier to build and ship software.

  • Measure Engineering Effectiveness: Establish and track a clear measurement framework spanning DXI, DORA metrics, PR throughput and cycle time, deployment frequency, lead time for changes, build and test performance, MTTR, and developer satisfaction.

  • Represent the Developer Voice: Use listening tours, workflow analysis, engineering data, and developer feedback to identify friction and translate it into prioritized product opportunities.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Adoption: Partner across App Enablement, Security, Infrastructure, and SRE to improve development and release workflows while balancing velocity with reliability, compliance, security, and platform scalability. Drive adoption of new developer platforms, agentic capabilities, and engineering practices across a large, distributed R&D organization.

Qualifications

We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can partner with engineers and translate complex engineering challenges into product strategy.

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, including experience with developer experience, engineering productivity, developer platforms, infrastructure, or other deeply technical products.

  • Strong understanding of modern software development, including CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Experience using engineering productivity or developer experience metrics to identify opportunities and measure impact.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional technical initiatives and drive adoption of new tools, platforms, or engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous hands-on software engineering or other technical experience.

  • Experience with agentic development workflows or AI tools that measurably improve developer productivity.

Experience building or scaling internal developer platforms, platform engineering capabilities, or complex application development environments.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About the Role

Hinge Health is looking for an experienced Senior Motion Designer to help us evolve and scale our brand through motion. You will produce a wide variety of deliverables—from high-fidelity campaign work and customer stories to product animations and explainer videos. Working within the Brand, Creative & Content team, balance crafting original designs with partnering with Designers, Writers, Producers, and stakeholders to define how our product and brand come to life.

We believe movement is medicine, and you will infuse that belief into our brand expression. We are looking for an A-player who balances deep technical expertise with a "learn-it-all" drive, someone who is passionate about motion graphics, animation and how the story gets translated alongside video editing, and sound design.

What you'll Accomplish

  • Elevate visual storytelling: Concept and craft high-quality design and motion graphics, UI motion, and visual effects that bring the brand narrative to life across video and digital touchpoints.

  • Deliver end-to-end excellence: Drive projects from initial concept to high-fidelity final delivery, utilizing storyboarding, style frames, and animation to execute detail-oriented work within our brand system.

  • Scale motion operations: Evolve our motion principles and guidelines while establishing self-serve workflows and templates that empower the wider organization to produce great work at speed.

  • Champion brand innovation: Push the boundaries of our motion language to deliver innovative work that delights customers and drives measurable business objectives.

  • Optimize for efficiency: Proactively identify and integrate emerging industry trends, software, and tools to continuously improve the quality, speed, and technical capabilities of our motion design output.

What we're looking for

  • Professional Experience: 3 years of experience in motion design, video, and editing.

  • Portfolio: A strong body of work that demonstrates expertise in product, branding, communication design, and storytelling.

  • Production Versatility: The ability to concept, design, and produce motion assets across brand foundations, marketing campaigns, paid social, and organic channels.

  • Design Expertise: Strong conceptual skills with proficiency in motion design, typography, color theory, illustration, photography, and layout.

  • Storytelling: The ability to craft a narrative combined with the production know-how to cut and deliver assets.

  • Systems Thinking: A strategic and detail-oriented approach to building and maintaining design systems.

  • Time Management: The capacity to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards and meeting deadlines.

  • Organization: A commitment to maintaining organized systems for project files, assets, and templates.

  • Communication: Clear verbal and written skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across the organization.

  • Project Management: Excellent organizational skills to drive projects from concept to completion.

  • Technical Proficiency: Expertise in Adobe CC (After Effects), Figma, Final Cut Pro, Cinema 4D, and Rive, along with experience utilizing AI platforms to enhance creativity and efficiency.

  • Business Alignment: The ability to generate creative solutions that directly align with business goals.

  • Mindset: A growth-oriented attitude and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

What Shapes this Company

  • Effective Communication: We are clear, concise and quick to respond.

  • Learn-it-all: We are always willing to learn and get better.

  • Hustle: We are creative and unrelenting, always finding a way.

  • Accountability: We act in the company's best interest and meet commitments.

  • Lead at all levels: We are hands-on, and we set a clear vision.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

The Opportunity

Join the team transforming how we treat chronic pain by addressing its root cause: the brain. Hinge Health is expanding beyond physical therapy to build a comprehensive Brain Health ecosystem. In this mission-critical role, you will lead the architecture and development of agentic AI systems that deliver personalized pain reprocessing therapy and mindfulness interventions. You will bridge the gap between clinical science and software engineering, building the engine that helps millions of members retrain how their nervous systems process pain.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Architect Next-Gen AI Therapies: Build and scale the agentic AI systems that power multi-session conversational therapy, ensuring they maintain context, demonstrate emotional intelligence, and align with clinical protocols.

  • Build a Unified Education Platform: Design the centralized service that delivers personalized pain science education and mindset strategies, adapting content to each member's therapeutic goals.

  • Drive Technical Strategy: Define the long-term technical vision for Brain Health in partnership with product and clinical leadership, balancing immediate delivery with scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure.

  • Lead & Mentor: Act as a technical beacon for the team, mentoring engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, and driving cross-functional collaboration across data science, clinical, and platform teams.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Who You Are

  • A Strategic Builder: You don't just write code; you architect systems that scale. You have a deep understanding of distributed systems and can navigate the complexity of building AI-driven products in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • A "Learn-it-all": You stay on the bleeding edge of AI and software engineering, constantly evaluating emerging technologies to optimize performance and improve the platform.

  • A Cross-Functional Leader: You thrive in multidisciplinary environments, translating complex technical concepts for clinical and product stakeholders to ensure our solutions are both clinically sound and technically robust.

  • An Owner-Operator: You take pride in your work, from architecture to production support, embodying a DevOps culture where you own the reliability and performance of your code.

Basic Qualifications

  • Have 4+ years of practical software engineering experience, including meaningful time shipping AI-powered products to real users.

  • At minimum a Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Have led the design and delivery of complex, user-facing products end-to-end — across product surfaces, backend services, and AI/ML systems.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Have worked in early-stage or fast-moving, rapidly evolving environments, and have ideally built products from 0 to 1.

  • Are technically proficient in modern AI application development, with demonstrated depth in working with LLMs (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic systems, evals) and a strong fullstack foundation (e.g., Python, TypeScript/NestJS).

  • Take a product-focused approach to building AI solutions that are robust, safe, and genuinely useful in users' hands.

  • Have successfully driven cross-team alignment to get impactful work shipped, and work with influence over authority.

  • Have experience establishing engineering standards, system architectures, and development best practices — especially around evaluation, safety, and reliability for AI systems.

  • Thrive in fast-paced environments and can navigate ambiguity to deliver high-quality products.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Contributions to open-source AI or software engineering projects.

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Hinge Health is growing our team of passionate creatives on a mission to get every body moving. The Senior Lead Visual Designer on the Brand, Creative & Content Growth Creative team at Hinge Health will lead the visual strategy and design execution for our growth marketing efforts, driving member enrollment through high-impact, memorable brand experiences.

  • Create the conditions for team excellence through mentorship, thoughtful feedback, and operational rigor that helps others do their best work.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with marketing, product, and content stakeholders and using performance data or experimentation results to inform creative decisions

The Opportunity

Enrollment and Onboarding is the front door to Hinge Health. Every member's care starts here: registering, answering the clinical questionnaire that determines eligibility and program fit, getting accepted, and then calibrating their first exercise therapy so day one feels made for them. The pod owns that whole path, on web and in our React Native app, for every program we offer, from chronic and acute musculoskeletal (MSK) pain to pelvic health and migraine.

This stretch is where members decide whether Hinge Health is for them. Small improvements in how quickly and confidently someone gets from sign-up to their first session compound into large gains in how many people actually start care.

As the Staff Software Engineer on this pod, you'll be the technical lead for a team of six engineers, working full-stack across NestJS services, a GraphQL backend-for-frontend (BFF), React web, and React Native. The system is a clinical intake pipeline and a server-driven mobile experience at the same time, and you'll set its architecture. Day to day you'll partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and User Research to turn what we learn about members into a better first week.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Own the enrollment and onboarding architecture: Set technical direction for the services and clients that take a member from registration through questionnaire, acceptance, and baseline calibration. Keep it coherent as programs, surfaces, and clinical rules multiply.

  • Build durable, observable member workflows: Design the multi-step, long-running orchestration behind enrollment on Temporal, with the idempotency, retry, and failure semantics a clinical intake flow demands.

  • Ship native, server-driven experiences: Lead the mobile and web experience for clinical questionnaires and calibration. Render data-driven survey and layout definitions in React Native and React so clinical and product teams can change content without an app release.

  • Turn intake signals into a personalized start: Connect what we learn about a member during enrollment to their first exercise therapy session, working with Data Science and partner teams so onboarding feels calibrated to the person.

  • Move the funnel: Instrument and experiment on the enrollment and onboarding funnel with Product, Design, and User Research. You'll be measured on accepted members who reach their first session.

  • Retire legacy safely: Lead migrations off legacy systems while they stay in production, and hold the line on quality, testing, observability, and protected health information (PHI) handling across the pod's repositories.

  • Lead through influence: Mentor the team's senior and mid-level engineers and raise the bar through design and code review. Represent the pod technically with partner teams across accounts, mobile platform, care, and data.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Who You Are

  • A full-stack owner: You've shipped and operated user-facing flows end to end, from React Native or React through the services behind them, and you're comfortable moving the boundary between client and server when the product needs it.

  • A systems thinker about state: You've built or run durable, multi-step workflows in production and you know what it takes to make them correct, from retries, idempotency, and versioning to what happens to the user when a step fails.

  • A builder across horizons: You're equally at home defining new architecture and hardening a legacy path that still serves real members.

  • A force multiplier: You raise everyone around you through mentorship, review, and standards that reduce friction.

  • A partner across disciplines: You work closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and User Research, and you can explain a technical tradeoff to a clinician as clearly as to an engineer.

  • Outcome-driven: You measure your work by what changed for members.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience

  • Led the design and delivery of complex user-facing products end to end, across mobile or web clients and the backend services behind them

  • 3+ years of TypeScript/JavaScript across the stack: Node.js (NestJS or similar) on the backend, React Native or React on the frontend

  • Production experience with durable workflow or long-running state orchestration (Temporal, Cadence, Step Functions, or a state machine you built and kept correct)

  • 2+ years mentoring or leading other engineers and working with partners in product, design, and data

Preferred Qualifications

  • NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Temporal in production

  • Server-driven UI or configuration-driven presentation layers on mobile: dynamic forms, survey engines, conditional logic defined in data rather than code

  • Signup, onboarding, intake, or application flows where completion rate was your metric

  • Migrated or decomposed a legacy system while it remained in production

  • Experimentation on critical-path product surfaces: A/B tests, feature flags, funnel instrumentation

  • Healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain, including PHI constraints on logging and storage

  • Track record as a Staff-level individual contributor who shapes direction without direct reports

","descriptionPlain":"THE OPPORTUNITY Enrollment and Onboarding is the front door to Hinge Health. Every member's care starts here: registering, answering the clinical questionnaire that determines eligibility and program fit, getting accepted, and then calibrating their first exercise therapy so day one feels made for them. The pod owns that whole path, on web and in our React Native app, for every program we offer, from chronic and acute musculoskeletal (MSK) pain to pelvic health and migraine. This stretch is where members decide whether Hinge Health is for them. Small improvements in how quickly and confidently someone gets from sign-up to their first session compound into large gains in how many people actually start care. As the Staff Software Engineer on this pod, you'll be the technical lead for a team of six engineers, working full-stack across NestJS services, a GraphQL backend-for-frontend (BFF), React web, and React Native. The system is a clinical intake pipeline and a server-driven mobile experience at the same time, and you'll set its architecture. Day to day you'll partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and User Research to turn what we learn about members into a better first week. WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH - Own the enrollment and onboarding architecture: Set technical direction for the services and clients that take a member from registration through questionnaire, acceptance, and baseline calibration. Keep it coherent as programs, surfaces, and clinical rules multiply. - Build durable, observable member workflows: Design the multi-step, long-running orchestration behind enrollment on Temporal, with the idempotency, retry, and failure semantics a clinical intake flow demands. - Ship native, server-driven experiences: Lead the mobile and web experience for clinical questionnaires and calibration. Render data-driven survey and layout definitions in React Native and React so clinical and product teams can change content without an app release. - Turn intake signals into a personalized start: Connect what we learn about a member during enrollment to their first exercise therapy session, working with Data Science and partner teams so onboarding feels calibrated to the person. - Move the funnel: Instrument and experiment on the enrollment and onboarding funnel with Product, Design, and User Research. You'll be measured on accepted members who reach their first session. - Retire legacy safely: Lead migrations off legacy systems while they stay in production, and hold the line on quality, testing, observability, and protected health information (PHI) handling across the pod's repositories. - Lead through influence: Mentor the team's senior and mid-level engineers and raise the bar through design and code review. Represent the pod technically with partner teams across accounts, mobile platform, care, and data. - Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build. About the Role

In this fast paced client-facing role, you will own day-to-day relationships with our employer clients and ensure they are maximizing the benefits from the Hinge Health programs. You will also have the opportunity to train, coach, and develop our CS Associates and Managers. This role demands a little bit of everything, from being a trusted adviser, project manager, product expert, coach to other team members, and more. You will be responsible for driving adoption with our clients, reporting on program value, managing escalations, expanding product offerings, and securing renewals. This is a cross-functional role that partners with Growth, Sales, Data, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Clinical to provide excellent service for our clients. The ideal candidate will also help contribute to best practices and be open to evolving responsibilities as our team grows.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience as a Client Success Manager, ideally within digital health, and is excellent at building relationships, managing the demands of a full book of business, and knows how to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. clients, consultants, health plans, cross-functional partners, etc). We are looking for an individual who can effectively balance their client needs with internal resources to drive high customer satisfaction year after year.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Driving revenue: Secure best-practice enrollment communications campaigns aimed at achieving annual enrollment goals for your clients

  • Long-term client management: Ensure 100% client retention with high client satisfaction (9/10+ NPS scores)

  • Customer advocacy: Turn clients into advocates to fulfill sales references and Marketing/PR requests

  • Product expansion: Ensure your clients are offering Hinge Health’s full suite of products to maximize member impact.

Basic Qualifications

  • Relationship-building: Able to build relationships at all levels as a trusted & respected thought-partner

  • Data storytelling: Able to craft a compelling story using data-driven insights to make recommendations to influence customer decisions.

  • Product Knowledge: Subject matter expert on our product, knowing the specifics and functionalities, and understanding common use cases and best practices. Able to confidently answer questions and present solutions to clients.

  • Strategic influence: Able to effectively navigate the complexities of a book of business with clients in multiple stages of their lifecycle. Gain insight into client culture, priorities, and goals. Effectively convey client needs internally, driving the resources needed for successful client relationships.

  • Manages Complexity: Able to make sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Able to ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations, acquire data and uncover root causes to difficult problems.

  • Communicate effectively: Able to communicate with internal and external stakeholders in ways that conveys both clarity of thought and rigor, while being concise - be that via prose or visual aids.

  • Think long-term: Does not sacrifice long-term value for short term results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree strongly preferred

  • Experience at a high-growth company and understand the associated challenges

  • Have an understanding of employee benefits, digital health, and the startup work environment

  • Data integration proficiency, advanced Excel knowledge and skills

Compensation

This position will have an annual salary, plus equity and benefits. Please note the annual salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

The Opportunity

Access to high-quality musculoskeletal (MSK) care is often fragmented and difficult to navigate. You will solve this by building the engine that powers our physical provider network, directly connecting 20M+ members to best-in-class in-person care. As a foundational member of our Commercial Team, you won't just sell; you will define the provider network strategy for your territory, transforming how major health systems and provider groups partner with Hinge Health to deliver care.

What You'll Accomplish

  • In your first 3 months: You will master the Hinge Health provider value proposition and map the high-priority provider landscape in your territory. You’ll build a qualified pipeline of prospective provider groups and initiate key relationships.

  • In your first 6 months: You will close your first provider network contracts, navigating complex negotiations with legal and clinical stakeholders. You will launch these initial partners, ensuring a seamless implementation and onboarding experience.

  • In your first year: You will fully own the network strategy for your territory, consistently hitting network growth targets. You will act as the "Voice of the Provider" to our product teams, influencing the roadmap for our hybrid care model.

Basic Requirements

  • This territory consists of targeted metro regions in the US. You must reside in this territory to be considered.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 5 years work experience.

  • Background in provider sales and/or network development.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, provider network development / management, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health.

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

  • Excellent strategic territory management, prospecting, project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup, with demonstrated ability to innovate and solve problems creatively.

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members.


Preferred Requirements

  • Startup experience

  • Experience with clinical quality and price transparency tools

  • Experience with provider network adequacy tools

  • Experience with physical therapy and/or orthopedic clinical solutions or provider community

The Opportunity

The Content Platform team builds the shared systems that help Hinge Health create, manage, enrich, localize, publish, search, and deliver content across treatment experiences. The platform supports assets such as video, audio, images, captions, and text used by applications including Phoenix, Carehub, and onboarding experiences.

The team is extending the platform to make media and content workflows more scalable, observable, and self-service. This includes automated enrichment, localization, quality validation, asset lifecycle management, and AI-assisted content generation for exercise therapy and other treatment experiences.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of media and AI content pipelines. You will work across service boundaries to turn complex content operations into reliable, reusable platform capabilities.

You will design and ship systems that coordinate media processing, AI-generated audio and video assets, captions, localization, publishing, and quality control. You will help shape the platform architecture, make difficult trade-offs explicit, and build mechanisms that allow partner teams and content creators to move faster with less operational risk.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language

  • 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle

  • 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript

  • 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build reliable, intuitive, and scalable full-stack products for Member Records, the care-team-member-facing context layer within CareHub. Member Records surfaces the right member information at the right moment so each care-team interaction is informed and actionable, reducing the need to search across fragmented systems.

The experience brings together the context care-team members need to support a member, including member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indication, and history. Current product work also includes helping care-team members understand device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions, especially when a member is active in more than one program.

Member Records is part of the broader Member Record & Configurator pod. The adjacent Configurator experience gives physical therapists a way to review and personalize exercise therapy programs, while Member Records provides the member context needed to make those decisions.

You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to turn complex workflows into simple experiences. You will contribute from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support.

This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys owning meaningful product areas end to end, makes sound technical trade-offs, and raises the quality of the systems and team around them.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Design and deliver full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Build maintainable frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, and data models for member-record workflows.

  • Translate ambiguous product and workflow requirements into clear technical designs and incremental delivery plans.

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and partner engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Improve the reliability, performance, security, observability, and maintainability of production systems.

  • Write high-quality, well-tested code and contribute to effective testing strategies across the stack.

  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, incident response, and operational improvements.

  • Identify technical debt and make pragmatic improvements that help the team move faster safely.

  • Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, thoughtful reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

  • Use modern developer and AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development quality and productivity.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software.

  • 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development.

  • 3+years backend experience with Node.js, service development, API design, and integration patterns.

  • 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS

  • Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization,

  • Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support.

  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices.

  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

  • A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers.   • Well-being support: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

About the Role

Health is a digital health company focused on providing innovative, evidence-based solutions for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain. Through a combination of personalized exercise therapy and virtual care, Hinge Health helps individuals manage and reduce chronic pain, improving their quality of life while lowering healthcare costs. The company partners with employers and health plans to offer these solutions at scale, improving overall employee health and productivity.

At Hinge Health, our AI platform team is leading the way in transforming how businesses leverage Artificial Intelligence. Our mission is to build cutting-edge solutions and platforms that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in software engineering and an interest in AI to join our team.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll contribute to the development and maintenance of key components of our AI infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with engineers and data scientists to ensure the platform supports the complex needs of AI models and machine learning workflows.

We enjoy a continuous deployment DevOps culture, and take owner-operator pride in supporting our code in production. Our production systems rely on React Native, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Nestjs, GraphQL, Docker, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Apollo, and Redux. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security/compliance posture is at the highest standards of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Work with the AI/ML team to integrate models and agents into the platform and ensure smooth deployment.

  • Write clean, maintainable code with an emphasis on performance, reliability and scalability.

  • Build and maintain APIs and microservices that enable AI model & agent deployment and data processing.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to platform performance, integration, and reliability.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand technical requirements and deliver effective solutions.

  • Support ongoing improvements to the AI platform’s systems and workflows, contributing ideas and feedback to architectural discussions.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • 3+ years of experience in backend development using Python, TypeScript, or Java

  • Experience developing RESTful APIs and services

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

  • Experience using Git for version control and collaborating in an agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in AI/ML related field

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML technologies such as LLMs, RAG, or agentic AI

  • Solid understanding of database systems and data processing technologies

  • Familiarity with Generative AI technologies

  • Experience building and managing infrastructure using IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation across AWS and other cloud platforms

  • Experience driving CI/CD automation and observability through Datadog, Sentry, and related tools to improve deployment speed and system reliability

  • Experience in frontend development using React/Typescript

The Opportunity

At Hinge Health, we’re transforming how 20+ million people access musculoskeletal care through AI-powered, human-centered solutions - and our R&D organization is the engine behind that innovation.

We’re looking for a Technical Program Builder to join the Office of the CTO and architect the R&D operational engine. This is a unique “builder” TPM role where you won’t just manage processes. You will design and implement the systems, tooling, and AI agents that automate them.

You’ll leverage AI, automation, and smart infrastructure to eliminate manual coordination, reduce operational drag, and enable teams to move faster with clarity and precision. If you have seen program management at complex organizations first hand and found yourself thinking “this meeting could be automated” or “we shouldn’t need a human to track this,” you’ll thrive here.

This role is about building scalable execution infrastructure - not status reporting. You will act as a force multiplier for engineering teams, creating systems that streamline cross-pod coordination and ensure our internal operations are as innovative as the care we deliver to our members.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

  • Audit & Identify: Assess R&D operational processes and identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation and tooling improvements. Create a clean system of processes across R&D.

  • Build Relationships: Establish trust with R&D leadership and pod leads, understanding their pain points and operational bottlenecks.

  • Quick Wins: Deploy initial automated agents or scripts to streamline the most repetitive R&D workflows.

In your first 6 months:

  • Launch AI-Driven Infrastructure: Architect and deploy the R&D knowledge base and Internal Developer Portal optimized for both human and AI retrieval.

  • Standardize Operations: Design and roll out standardized operational processes across R&D, championing "AI-native ways of working."

  • Drive Planning Excellence: Lead one full quarterly OKR cycle, establishing a "single source of truth" for the R&D roadmap.

In your first year:

  • Scale Systems: Build low-code integrations (Jira/Linear, Slack, GSuite) that automate metrics collection and surface project health/velocity in real-time.

  • Transform Execution: Own the end-to-end R&D planning cycle, reducing planning overhead by 30% through automation while improving forecast accuracy.

  • Establish Innovation Culture: Identify and implement AI/ML opportunities that become operational standards, acting as a force multiplier for R&D leadership.

Who You Are

  • A Builder at Heart: You don't just ask for a tracker; you build the tool that generates it. You are comfortable writing scripts, configuring AI agents, and using technical skills to solve operational problems directly.

  • A Strategic Orchestrator: You excel at "Leading at all Levels," navigating the complexity of cross-pod coordination to align diverse stakeholders on planning and OKRs without losing sight of the big picture. You are a direct communicator, can get clear answers, and know how to motivate teams with a sense of urgency.

  • A Resilient Problem Solver: You thrive in fast-paced environments and embody our "Hustle" value. When gaps appear—whether in personnel or process—you step in to bridge them, ensuring the team never misses a beat.

Basic Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technical program management, product operations, or a related engineering role

  • Demonstrated experience building custom AI agents or utilizing LLM APIs to drive productivity and automation

  • Proven track record of managing comprehensive planning cycles and OKR processes for technical teams

  • Experience with modern project management ecosystems (e.g., Jira, Linear) and documentation platforms (e.g., Notion, Confluence)

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex process changes to diverse audiences

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Developer Experience (DX) metrics and how to influence them

  • Background in software engineering or data analysis

  • Certification in Agile or Project Management (PMP, CSM)

  • Experience working in a high-growth technology environment

  • Experience working in Health Tech and familiarity with healthcare regulations

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About The Role

Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager is the primary regulatory strategist and architect for our AI/ML Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) portfolio. While many companies view Regulatory Affairs as a purely administrative function, at Hinge Health we leverage this role as a technical discipline.

In this role, you will be responsible for the hands-on authorship and management of regulatory submissions (510(k), De Novo, Pre-Subs) for our cutting-edge AI products. You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, and Engineering teams to interpret the evolving FDA framework for AI/ML, helping us navigate complex pathways like Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP). You will also own the internal regulatory functions that support our Quality Management System, ensuring our rapid innovation remains compliant.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Submission Leadership (AI/ML SaMD): Lead the planning, authorship, and submission of regulatory filings (510(k), De Novo, Q-Submissions) for AI/ML-enabled software. You will be the primary author, not just a reviewer, translating complex technical and clinical data into compelling regulatory narratives.

  • Regulatory Strategy & AI Policy: Develop and execute regulatory strategies for new product introductions and major software updates. You will serve as the internal authority on the FDA’s evolving AI/ML Action Plan, guiding the business on how to validate and monitor adaptive algorithms.

  • Design Control & Change Impact: Participate in Design Reviews and Change Control Boards (CCB) to assess the regulatory impact of software changes. You will determine when a new 510(k) or "Letter to File" is required, specifically evaluating changes to AI models and retraining pipelines.

  • QMS & Internal Compliance: Support the maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring regulatory requirements (21 CFR 820, ISO 13485) are reflected in internal procedures. You will act as the Regulatory representative during internal and external audits (FDA, ISO).

  • Promotional Review: Review and approve labeling, marketing materials, and user manuals to ensure claims are substantiated and consistent with cleared indications for use.

  • Post-Market Surveillance & Vigilance: Partner with Quality to monitor post-market performance of AI models. You will lead the assessment of complaints for regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., eMDRs) and manage any necessary recalls or field actions.

  • Cross-Functional Coaching: Educate technical teams on regulatory principles, demystifying the submission process and helping engineers understand how their documentation directly supports regulatory clearance.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Software Engineering, Regulatory Science, or a related technical/scientific field.

  • Experience: A minimum of 4-6 + years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within the medical device industry, with a minimum of 3 years focused on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or Digital Health.

  • Submission Expertise: Proven track record of authoring and clearing US FDA Class II submissions (510(k) or De Novo). Experience interfacing directly with FDA reviewers during the review clock.

  • Technical Fluency: Ability to understand software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML concepts sufficiently to describe them to regulators. Familiarity with IEC 62304 and FDA Guidance on Software Validation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AI/ML Specifics: Direct experience with regulatory submissions involving Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Computer Vision. Familiarity with Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP) principles and Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP).

  • International Experience: Experience with international registrations, particularly EU MDR (CE Marking) for software, or Health Canada requirements.

  • Data Analysis: Ability to review statistical analysis plans and clinical validation reports to ensure they meet regulatory expectations for substantial equivalence or safety/effectiveness.

  • Agile Integration: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment and adapting regulatory submission timelines to iterative software release cycles.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

About the Role

Hinge Health is seeking a Firmware Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in designing and developing our next-generation hardware products.

As a junior-to-mid-level engineer, you will work on diverse projects, driving firmware / embedded software for highly integrated medical devices. You will work cross-functionally with electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing teams to bring products from concept through production.

The ideal candidate is excited about solving real problems with hardware – your work will have a direct impact on reducing pain and improving the lives of our millions of members. In joining our HW group within the broader R&D organization, you will be part of a highly capable, motivated, small team where your contributions and ideas truly matter.

What You’ll accomplish

  • Develop firmware for highly integrated embedded devices that are loved by our members and make a real positive impact

  • Work at all stages of the product development process, from exploration and prototyping to detailed design, testing, and ramping to mass production

  • Collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, and senior firmware engineers on system architecture and integration

  • Ensure design quality and meeting medical device regulatory requirements with clear documentation and robust testing

  • Support DevOps for embedded software, including automation of building and testing code

  • Keep abreast of the latest developments in AI and leverage the tools in a way that makes sense for firmware

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience developing in a team environment using version control (Git) and with embedded development tools and workflows (setting up build systems, J-Link, debugging)
