About the Role

At Hinge Health, we’re transforming care at scale, helping millions of people live pain-free lives. Now, we're looking for a Director of Product Management to lead one of our most member-critical product areas: the Member Journey.

Member Journey defines the framework for the end-to-end experience. That includes how members enroll, receive care, and see a reduction in their pain through Hinge Health. This is the leader for a group of product pods directly tied to our core member outcomes: onboarding, long term retention, new program growth, and outcomes. Done well, it turns an employer benefit into a habit-forming care relationship.

As a Director of Product Management, you'll lead a team of PMs to define the vision for the next-generation member experience in digital healthcare, including how personalization and AI reshape what it means to deliver care at scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Set the Strategic Vision: Define and communicate a multi-year product vision and strategy for the Member Journey neighborhood, ensuring alignment with Hinge Health's broader goals.

  • Lead and Grow the Team: Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers. Foster a culture of ownership, member obsession, and operational excellence.

  • Drive Enrollment, Retention, and Outcomes: Transform the member lifecycle from triage through long-term retention and ultimately driving long term change for members. Identify friction points, develop program platforms, growing our suite of programs and program extensions, and developing habits that keep members coming back.

  • Scale for New Care Programs: Build a member experience that extends gracefully to new conditions and care models without creating fragmentation or inconsistency across the product.

  • AI & Personalization Innovation: Define and execute how AI and personalization make the member experience more adaptive, relevant, and effective.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner deeply with Clinical, Design, and Data Science to understand member needs and translate them into a cohesive product roadmap. Work with Engineering and Design to ensure high-quality, scalable execution.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

  • 10+ years in Product Management building consumer-facing products or B2B2C platforms

  • 4+ years managing a team of Product Managers/Senior Product Managers

  • Experience managing foundational platforms at scale, not just owning features.

  • Comfortable working with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders (Pacific Time)

  • Technical fluency, specifically ability to engage deeply on data models, experimentation infrastructure, and system design

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to work effectively in async, globally distributed teams, paired with strong project management and a bias for urgency to drive execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Digital Health or consumer health products.

  • Experience managing platform teams and driving significant architectural designs.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML applications in personalization, recommendations, or behavior change.

  • Strong background in experimentation and A/B testing at scale.

  • Experience with consumer lifecycle management, activation funnels, or engagement mechanics.

The Opportunity

At Hinge Health, we're transforming how millions of people access musculoskeletal care—helping them move beyond pain through AI-powered, personalized healthcare. As a Client Executive, you'll be the strategic architect behind our most valuable partnerships, managing a portfolio of complex Enterprise and Jumbo clients who trust us to deliver exceptional outcomes for their members.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complexity. You'll manage strategic relationships with enterprise clients, navigating multiple stakeholder groups (e.g. client, consultant, health plan, etc), competing priorities, and high-stakes conversations. Success demands independent problem-solving—when challenges arise, you'll be expected to develop and present solutions rather than simply escalate problems. You'll work across multiple cross-functional teams (Growth, Sales, Data, Marketing, Operations, Product, Clinical) to deliver outcomes, requiring strong project management skills and the ability to influence without direct authority.

The ideal candidate is energized by building executive relationships (internally and externally) and solving complex business challenges. You should be someone who naturally gravitates toward strategic thinking, enjoys high-stakes conversations, and finds fulfillment in turning client challenges into expansion opportunities.

What You'll Accomplish

Strategic Account Retention
Drive exceptional client retention through proactive relationship management, strategic account planning, and early risk identification across your assigned portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. Build deep, multi-threaded client relationships that create sustainable competitive advantage and position Hinge Health as an indispensable strategic partner rather than a vendor.

Executive Relationship Management
Build and maintain meaningful relationships per client across different organizational levels. Identify decision-makers, map influence networks, and establish trust with C-suite executives through strategic value conversations that demonstrate measurable business impact.

Independent Strategic Thinking
When facing client challenges, research solutions, analyze options, and present recommendations with data-driven rationale. Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving and drive decisions without constant management oversight, acting as the trusted advisor clients turn to during critical moments.

Revenue Impact Focus
Understand how each client interaction connects to business outcomes (retention, expansion, competitive positioning) and articulate the specific value you're creating through relationship investments. Consistently achieve 100%+ net revenue retention through strategic renewals and expansion opportunities.

Who You Are

  • A Strategic Relationship Builder: You don't just manage accounts—you architect partnerships. You naturally build trust with C-suite executives and can navigate complex organizational hierarchies with ease.

  • An Independent Problem Solver: When challenges arise, you don't escalate—you investigate, develop solutions, and present recommendations. You thrive in ambiguity and can facilitate cross-functional alignment without formal authority.

  • Resilient Under Pressure: You energize during renewal seasons and high-stakes negotiations. Compressed timelines and competing priorities don't overwhelm you—they motivate you.

  • Data-Driven and Strategic: You translate complex data (utilization metrics, claims analyses, stakeholder feedback) into compelling executive-level narratives that drive purchasing decisions and strategic alignment.

Basic Requirements

  • 10+ years in enterprise account management with demonstrated success managing strategic client relationships. Healthcare, benefits, or SaaS experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of managing strategic enterprise accounts simultaneously while maintaining exceptional retention rates (95%+) in high-growth or competitive environments.

  • Complex stakeholder management expertise across multiple organizational levels, including C-suite executives, procurement teams, and operational stakeholders.

  • Strategic relationship building with ability to establish trust quickly, maintain engagement during extended renewal cycles (12+ months), and recover from at-risk accounts. Must provide specific examples of turning around challenging client situations.

  • Experience achieving 100%+ net revenue retention, including managing contract negotiations, performance guarantee discussions, and pricing conversations with procurement and C-suite stakeholders.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience navigating organizational changes (mergers, leadership transitions, budget cuts) while preserving client relationships and identifying expansion opportunities.

  • Experience working with intermediaries (consultants, brokers, health plans) who influence but don't control purchasing decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to conduct competitive analyses and translate complex data (utilization data, claims analyses, stakeholder feedback) into executive-level presentations that drive purchasing decisions.

  • Startup experience valued for adaptability and ownership mindset.

The Opportunity

Hinge Health is building a digital clinic that can support more than one kind of care. The Program Enablement Platform (PEP) team helps make that possible by turning one-off program engineering into shared, configurable capabilities. These capabilities help product teams create and evolve care programs faster, with less duplicated logic and fewer costly integrations across services.

As Engineering Manager for PEP, you will lead engineers building a business-domain platform in close partnership with the teams that use it. You will help set technical direction, keep the team focused on real product and business needs, and drive adoption of capabilities that make new care experiences easier to build. Early use cases include more flexible program models and support for new care areas, including concurrent care and gastrointestinal care.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Build trusted partnerships with your product and engineering partners, including the teams that depend on PEP. Learn their needs, the current program architecture, and the technical and organizational constraints shaping the platform.

  • Review PEP’s roadmap, existing capabilities, and partner requests. Establish a clear way to assess tradeoffs, communicate priorities, and make ownership and decisions explicit.

  • Work with the team to identify a focused, high-value use case. Align on the problem, the smallest useful platform capability, the partner responsibilities, and how success will be measured.

  • Stay close to the code and architecture through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on contributions appropriate to the team’s needs.

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Guide delivery of a platform capability that addresses a concrete partner-team problem and reduces repeated, program-specific engineering work.

  • Define practical contribution and engagement patterns so partner teams know how to request support, collaborate with PEP, and extend shared capabilities without unnecessary coordination overhead.

  • Partner with domain teams to plan and drive adoption. Validate that the platform is useful in real workflows, learn from migration friction, and adjust the solution based on feedback.

  • Help the team make program creation and lifecycle behavior more configurable, while keeping domain-specific logic with the appropriate domain teams.

In your first year, you will:

  • Help establish PEP as a trusted, product-minded platform team with a clear roadmap, working model, and measurable outcomes for its partner teams.

  • Improve the ability to launch care programs through reusable building blocks, reducing duplicated logic and integration effort as the platform is adopted.

  • Advance platform capabilities for flexible program lifecycles and transitions, informed by real use cases such as concurrent care and new care areas.

  • Grow and develop a high-performing engineering team through hiring, mentorship, and career development, while maintaining a strong bar for technical quality and operational reliability.

Who You Are

  • A technically credible engineering leader. You stay close to the code, contribute to architecture and design decisions, and earn trust through sound technical judgment while enabling the team to do its best work.

  • A platform thinker with product instincts. You understand that a useful platform solves real problems for its users. You can find the right abstraction without overbuilding or pushing complexity onto partner teams.

  • An adoption-minded operator. You know that a capability creates value when teams can and do use it. You work with partner teams on migration, communicate tradeoffs, and follow through on outcomes.

  • A clear, collaborative partner. You make ownership, decisions, and expectations explicit across engineering, product, and domain teams. You can align people around shared goals without relying on authority alone.

  • An accountable leader. You balance near-term delivery with durable platform investments, and you use evidence and partner feedback to adapt the roadmap.



Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

About the Role

Hinge Health is seeking a Senior Privacy and AI Counsel to join our Legal team. In this role, you will serve as a strategic legal partner to our Product, R&D, Hardware, Marketing, and Clinical teams as they develop and launch innovative new products and services in the healthcare space and play a leading role in ensuring the company’s compliance with privacy and AI laws and regulations. You will assess privacy risks and develop AI governance policies and best practices and be responsible for negotiating DSAs, BAAs and reviewing other agreements for privacy and AI issues. This position is essential for safeguarding the privacy of our customers and members, staying up-to-date on emerging technology issues, and maintaining the trust they place in us. You will report to the Associate General Counsel, Product and work closely with other members of the Legal & Compliance team, as well as cross-functional stakeholders across the organization — including access to senior leadership.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Develop and maintain, in collaboration with Compliance, privacy and AI policies and procedures in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Oversee privacy impact assessments and data protection impact assessments.

  • Provide guidance on privacy and AI related issues to various departments within the company.

  • Work with Product and R&D teams to embed privacy-by-design principles in design and execution decisions.

  • Monitor and respond to privacy-related inquiries and complaints, and lead incident response along with Security and Compliance teams.

  • Work with client-facing teams on privacy and AI related inquiries and oversight.

  • Collaborate with the security team to ensure data protection measures are in place.

Basic Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.

  • Licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • 5-7 years of experience in privacy law and data protection.

  • In-depth knowledge of U.S. and international privacy laws and regulations, including HIPAA, GDPR and CCPA.

  • Familiarity with privacy issues related to AI and machine learning, and general AI governance best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) or similar certification.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience using AI tools to enhance and accelerate deliverables

  • Experience working in the healthcare industry, preferably at a digital health company, combined with law firm experience at a nationally recognized firm

  • Experience and comfort with working at both an operational and strategic level.

  • Strong track record of cross-functional collaboration and ability to communicate complex legal and regulatory concepts in a clear, business-friendly manner

  • Self-starter who thrives working independently; comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities

The Opportunity

Join the team securing the platform that helps millions of people move beyond musculoskeletal pain. As Hinge Health's engineering organization embraces AI-assisted development — including AI-powered code generation, automated PR review workflows, agent sandboxing, and MCP gateway integrations — we need a Lead Security Engineer who will build the security guardrails, tooling, and standards that ensure we ship with confidence. You'll sit at the critical intersection of cloud security, AI-enabled engineering, and identity & access management, partnering closely with Application Security, SRE, and R&D Engineering to design and enforce security-by-design principles across our AWS environment, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling. This is your chance to make a real impact on the lives of millions by driving advancements in healthcare security — ensuring utmost compliance and privacy while enabling engineers to move fast and safely.

Candidates must be within commuting distance to New York City

 
 

Who You Are

  • A Security-First Thinker: You instinctively design systems that are secure by default, and you know how to balance security rigor with engineering velocity.

  • An AI-Savvy Engineer: You're energized (not intimidated) by the rapid adoption of AI-assisted development and see it as an opportunity to build novel security frameworks.

  • A Trust Builder: You communicate effectively across engineering, compliance, and leadership teams — authoring clear, plain-spoken technical proposals that drive alignment.

  • A Learn-it-all: You stay ahead of emerging threats and continuously evolve your approach — from adversarial ML to supply chain attacks on AI pipelines.

  • A Leader at All Levels: You're hands-on in code and architecture, but you also mentor others and help the team self-organize around measurable outcomes.

     

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, or scientific field — or comparable education/experience

  • 3+ years in cybersecurity, with 3+ years focused on security operations or IAM

  • 2+ years of experience in cloud security operations, specifically AWS

  • 2+ years of coding experience (e.g., Python, Go, or TypeScript) with hands-on experience developing Terraform and infrastructure-as-code

  • Hands-on experience securing AI/ML systems, including data pipelines, model deployments, API integrations, and their security challenges

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Solutions Architect or Security Specialty certification

  • AI/ML security certifications or familiarity with adversarial machine learning threats and mitigation strategies

  • Experience building or integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines and AI-assisted development workflows

  • Experience managing an Enterprise IdP, especially Okta, with deep understanding of OAuth 2.0 and SAML

  • SOC 2, PCI, or HIPAA audit/training certifications

  • Knowledge of low-level networking principles

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

  • Audit current cloud security posture and IAM architecture across our AWS environment; build relationships with key stakeholders in Application Security, SRE, and R&D Engineering.

  • Assess existing AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP gateway) for security risks and begin developing a governance framework.

In your first 6 months:

  • Design and implement AI-driven tools and workflows to enhance security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and IAM governance.

  • Develop and enforce policies and protocols to protect AI tools and platforms from misuse, data breaches, and external threats — including secure agent sandboxing and MCP server governance.

  • Deliver IAM solutions enabling secure, granular access controls that enforce least privilege principles, utilizing automation and AI for privilege escalation and approvals.

     

In your first year:

  • Own the security strategy for AI-enabled development and cloud infrastructure, acting as the primary subject matter expert for security engineering across the organization.

  • Ensure all compliance regulations — including HIPAA, privacy, and relevant security frameworks — are met for new services, AI tooling, and infrastructure.

  • Develop and drive cybersecurity initiatives related to incident response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and monitoring tools.

  • Mentor team members in adopting new security tools and processes; educate the broader organization through knowledge-sharing sessions and author clear technical proposals with measurable security OKRs.

About the Role

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader on the Data & ML Platform team, owning the architecture and reliability of the data infrastructure that powers real-time member experiences, analytics, and AI across Hinge Health. Where a Senior Data Engineer owns individual pipelines and systems, you own the patterns, standards, and architectural decisions that shape how the entire platform works.

You will design systems that move data from dozens of upstream services — across Kafka event streams and transactional databases — into a unified data platform that serves real-time APIs, analytical workloads, and ML systems on Databricks. You will lead the most complex technical initiatives end-to-end, drive alignment across teams, and make the architectural calls that other engineers build on. You will define data contracts, own schema evolution strategy, and set the standards for how data is modeled, tested, and governed across the platform.

You'll work in a modern stack: Python, SQL, Flink, PySpark, Kafka, Delta Lake, dbt, Airflow, Aurora PostgreSQL, and AWS. This is a high-ownership role where you operate with significant autonomy. You'll work closely with application engineers, data scientists, product teams, and SRE — not just building systems, but shaping how other teams produce and consume data reliably in a HIPAA-compliant environment.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Own data platform architecture and technical direction: Lead the design of systems that span the full pipeline stack — raw ingestion, streaming and batch transformations, analytical models, and the serving layer that downstream consumers depend on. Make architectural decisions that balance reliability, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability. Set the patterns and standards that other engineers follow.

  • Build at the intersection of data and ML platform: Design the infrastructure that connects the data platform to ML workloads — feature pipelines, feature stores, and serving layers. Partner with Data Science to ensure the data platform produces ML-ready data and supports model training and inference workflows reliably.

  • Lead the hardest cross-functional technical problems: Drive complex initiatives that span multiple teams and services. Define data contracts with upstream producers, lead schema evolution strategies, and resolve systemic friction between data producers and consumers. Be the person who steps in when a problem is too ambiguous or cross-cutting for a single team to solve.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the team: Set and enforce standards for data modeling, pipeline reliability, testing practices, code quality, and operational excellence. Mentor senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, and technical coaching. Influence how the team thinks about building systems, not just what they build.

  • Keep the platform reliable and the data trustworthy: Own the reliability posture of the most critical data systems. Define and drive SLAs and SLOs for key pipelines, lead incident response for complex data failures, and drive the systemic fixes — not just the immediate patches. Champion observability, data quality, and operational rigor as first-class concerns.

  • Make it easy for teams to own their data: Build tooling and establish practices that enable service and application teams to effectively manage their data. Coach teams on compliance strategies, performance tuning, event-driven design, and schema evolution so they can take ownership without creating bottlenecks on the data team.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of data engineering experience with a proven track record of building and operating reliable production data platforms at scale.

  • Data and ML platform crossover: You've built or contributed to ML platform infrastructure — feature pipelines, feature stores, model serving, or MLOps tooling — as a natural extension of your data engineering work. You understand the ML lifecycle well enough to design data systems that serve it effectively.

  • 5+ years of strong proficiency in Python and SQL.

  • 5+ years of experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark, Flink, Spark) and data warehouse design including star and snowflake schemas.

  • 3+ years of experience deploying and operating pipelines in the cloud, including CI/CD, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Track record of leading complex, cross-functional technical initiatives — driving architectural decisions and delivering outcomes across team boundaries.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and setting engineering standards across a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Data Engineering: 10+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with a significant portion spent in platform or infrastructure roles building systems that other teams depend on.
    Built in a growth-stage environment: Your strongest work was at a mid-sized or scaling company where you had to make foundational architectural decisions — not at a large tech company where the platform was already built.

  • Deep data modeling and governance instincts: You care about schema design, data contracts, and data quality as much as you care about pipeline throughput. You've driven improvements in how upstream services produce data and how downstream teams consume it.

  • Product and business awareness: You connect your technical work to the problems the business is trying to solve. You understand the product use cases your platform enables and use that context to prioritize and make better architectural choices.

  • Operational rigor in regulated environments: You value SLOs, incident management, and observability as first-class concerns. Experience in HIPAA, SOC 2, or similarly regulated environments is a plus.

  • Experience with Databricks ecosystem: Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog — familiarity with this stack accelerates your impact.

  • AI-forward engineering practices: You actively use AI-assisted development tools and see them as a force multiplier for both your own productivity and the team's.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. About the Role

Hinge Health is building a new gastrointestinal care program that helps people better understand their symptoms, identify the right next steps, and access appropriate support and care.

As Staff Product Designer for the GI Program, you will help define what Hinge Health’s approach to GI care could become. You will lead design through an ambiguous, clinically complex, and highly strategic 0-to-1 space, using research, prototyping, and iteration to shape the program’s vision and member experience.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Data, Operations, to explore and test how digital guidance, symptom and meal tracking, personalized care plans, behavioral support, specialist and dietitian access, and escalation to in-person care might work together.

This is an opportunity to help establish the product vision and design foundations for a new care category, make possibilities tangible through prototypes and storytelling, and iteratively define how Hinge Health can deliver integrated GI care experiences.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Shape the vision for GI care: Define a compelling long-term design vision GI within the Hinge Health platform, grounded in member needs, clinical principles, and business outcomes.

  • Lead the end-to-end member experience: Design coherent journeys across enrollment, symptom understanding, triage, daily engagement, care planning, progress tracking, and escalation to digital, clinical, or in-person care.

  • Make complex care feel simple: Translate nuanced GI symptoms, treatment pathways, testing, and clinical guidance into clear, accessible, and actionable product experiences for members.

  • Design personalized, behavior-changing experiences: Explore how care plans, tracking, education, gut-brain support, movement, and conversational guidance can help members take meaningful action and build sustainable habits.

  • Raise the design bar: Mentor other designers, share methods and learnings, and help create a high-quality, inclusive, and accessible product experience.

  • Stay close to members and outcomes: Partner with research, clinical, and data teammates to form hypotheses, test concepts, learn from member behavior, and connect design decisions to health and business outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product design experience, including close partnership with product and engineering teams.

  • A standout portfolio demonstrating high-impact product work, strong craft, and leadership on complex or ambiguous initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Interaction, Industrial, Product, Service Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or equivalent experience.

Staff-Level Qualifications

  • Design craft mastery: Expertise in interaction and visual design, with a track record of advancing craft quality and inspiring excellence across teams.

  • Strategic problem solving: Experience leading ambiguous problem spaces, setting product vision, and defining design strategy across products or platforms.

  • Systems thinking: Ability to design coherent end-to-end experiences, identify patterns across surfaces, and contribute to scalable design systems.

  • Healthcare complexity: Experience simplifying complex, sensitive, regulated, or data-rich domains into understandable and trustworthy user experiences.

  • Data-informed design: Fluency in combining qualitative research, behavioral data, experimentation, and clinical or operational insight to guide decisions.

  • Influence and communication: Highly effective written, verbal, and visual communicator who can align senior stakeholders around a design direction.

  • Cross-functional leadership: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Clinical, Operations, and research partners across shared goals and timelines.

  • AI curiosity: Thoughtful curiosity about emerging AI tools and conversational experiences, with good judgment about how to use them safely and meaningfully in healthcare.

  • Mission alignment: Genuine interest in improving healthcare access and helping people live healthier lives through thoughtful design and technology.About Hinge Health

The Opportunity

Over 1.7 billion people worldwide live with musculoskeletal pain — and Hinge Health is on a mission to help them move beyond it. Our TrueMotion computer vision technology turns everyday mobile devices into powerful motion-tracking tools, giving members real-time feedback and guidance as they work through personalized exercise therapy. The CV User Experience team is responsible for making that magic feel effortless: building deeply interactive, TrueMotion-driven features that monitor movement, coach performance, and track recovery progress.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as the technical leader for this team — someone who can architect end-to-end systems across mobile and backend, tackle complex scaling challenges, and raise the bar on engineering quality. If you're passionate about building high-quality software that directly improves people's health outcomes, this is your role.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

  • Ramp into the CV User Experience stack (React Native, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, AWS) and build relationships with product managers, designers, data scientists, and computer vision scientists.

  • Deliver your first end-to-end feature while auditing the current architecture for scaling and performance bottlenecks.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

In your first 6 months:

  • Own and lead architectural discussions for TrueMotion-driven experiences, proactively identifying challenges and proposing innovative solutions to complex mobile and full-stack engineering problems.

  • Establish stronger system observability using Datadog and Sentry, improving monitoring, logging, and error tracking across the full stack.

  • Profile systems to stay ahead of scaling and performance bottlenecks, ensuring a fast, responsive mobile experience for users.

In your first year:

  • Act as the primary technical leader for the team's architecture — designing robust, end-to-end solutions including performant APIs, mobile application architecture, and data models that are the foundation for TrueMotion's next generation.

  • Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement through thoughtful code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

  • Every quarter, identify, propose, and execute a significant upgrade or innovative change to the team's workflow, tooling, or architecture.

Who You Are

  • A Force Multiplier: You don't just ship great code — you improve the team's overall architecture, developer tooling, and practices, making everyone around you more effective.

  • A Learn-it-all: You stay at the forefront of mobile development, computer vision UX, and AI-powered developer tools. You bring "only-now-possible" ideas to the team and turn them into shipped capabilities.

  • Accountable: You take owner-operator pride in your code in production. You meet commitments, estimate well, and don't stop before solving the last 10–20% where the messy edge cases lie.

  • A Trust Builder: You communicate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data science teams to align on shared goals. You explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is understandable and not condescending.

  • Hands-On Leader: You lead at all levels — architecting systems and writing code, reviewing PRs and mentoring engineers, thinking quarters ahead and unblocking teammates today.

Basic Qualifications

  • At minimum, 4 + years of professional software engineering experience

  • At minimum, a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping mobile applications

  • 3+ years of experience with backend technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, or GraphQL

  • 2+ years of experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Experience working in distributed systems and microservices architectures

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools to accelerate development workflows, improve code quality, and streamline debugging

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping mobile applications using React Native

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and tools such as Apache Kafka

  • Proficiency with observability tools such as Datadog and Sentry

  • Strong understanding of system design principles, mobile application architecture, and CI/CD pipelines

  • Experience with computer vision–driven user experiences on mobile platforms

  • Demonstrated track record of mentoring engineers and leading architectural discussions across teams

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Hinge Health, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale software solutions that directly impact our members’ health outcomes. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners, including product managers and health economists, to deliver new product capabilities and improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of our features. This role is essential to advancing our mission of transforming joint and muscle care through technology, including the integration of AI-driven solutions to automate and enhance care delivery. Hinge Health software engineers work on small interdisciplinary teams focused on different parts of the user journey.

The ROI Pod (Return on Investment Identification & Measurement Pod) at Hinge Health is a cross-functional team, bringing together Data Engineering, Data Science, Health Economics, Product, and Software Engineering. Our mission is to build advanced tools and analyses that identify and measure ROI, directly supporting Hinge Health’s goal of delivering measurable value to clients and driving higher ROI for all clients in 2026 and beyond. The pod’s work spans optimizing targeted enrollment using predictive models, personalizing interventions to maximize clinical and economic impact, and automating client-facing ROI analyses to accelerate and scale reporting.

We enjoy a continuous deployment DevOps culture, and take owner-operator pride in supporting our code in production. Our production systems rely on React Native, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Nestjs, GraphQL, Docker, Rails, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Apollo, and Redux. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security/compliance posture is at the highest standards of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Modernize existing pipelines to scale our proven products with company growth.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 6+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic coding and AI tooling for coding assistance

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or scalable architectures

  • Experience with healthcare technology or regulated environments

  • Experience with Agile development practices

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

The Opportunity

Hinge Health is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a software engineering team inside Hardware R&D, focused on the software systems behind a connected medical device experience. This role sits at the intersection of consumer software, connected devices, clinical workflows, and regulated product delivery. You will own a single, high-complexity engineering team that spans mobile, backend, BLE, and hardware-adjacent software, and will be responsible for building a platform that is reliable, compliant, and adaptable enough to support rapid product iteration in a demanding domain.

You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, Regulatory, Hardware Engineering, Data, Member Support, and Quality/Compliance teams to define strategy, ship high-quality products, and ensure the device experience is safe, scalable, and delightful for our members end to end.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

  • Build a deep understanding of our device ecosystem, including FDA-regulated device software, BLE connectivity, mobile and backend platforms, and the clinical and operational workflows that support them.

  • Establish clear team priorities, execution rhythms, and ways of working, including backlog quality, sprint planning, delivery goals, and retrospectives.

  • Develop strong partnerships with Product, Clinical, Regulatory, Hardware Engineering, Data, Member Support, and Quality/Compliance counterparts to ensure alignment on goals, constraints, and quality expectations.

In your first 6 months:

  • Orchestrate large cross-functional programs that span device, mobile, backend, and operations, proactively uncovering corner cases and non-functional risks (reliability, security, performance, scalability).

  • Drive technical strategy across mobile, backend, device-control, and BLE surfaces so the platform can support both rapid product iteration and long-term maintainability.

  • Establish strong quality and compliance practices for regulated software, including structured review points with regulatory and quality partners, release gating, tech debt paydown plans, and operational feedback loops.

  • Lead a team that owns production health in an on-call, continuous delivery environment, improving incident response, observability, and reliability over time.

In your first year:

  • Translate member pain points, support signals, and product goals into engineering investments that materially improve reliability, reduce support burden, and strengthen the member experience for our device products.

  • Lead the software roadmap in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders, balancing member experience, technical quality, operational reliability, and regulatory constraints across the platform.

  • Hire, coach, and develop engineers and emerging technical leaders, building a high-performance, high-accountability culture within a complex and high-ambiguity remit.

  • Contribute beyond your immediate team through interview design, leveling clarity, process improvements, and broader engineering stewardship across Hardware R&D and the wider engineering organization.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of consumer software, connected devices, and regulated product delivery, and you are comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-accountability environments.

  • You are a strong systems thinker who can reason across mobile apps, backend services, BLE/device-control flows, and operational workflows, making clear time-versus-cost tradeoffs for stakeholders.

  • You are a builder of teams: you hire, coach, and develop engineers and emerging leaders, and you create a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and high standards for quality and compliance.

  • You are a trusted cross-functional partner who collaborates deeply with Product, Clinical, Regulatory, Hardware, Data, and Operations to deliver outcomes, not just ship features.

  • You are comfortable owning production health and operational excellence in an on-call, continuous delivery environment, and you use data, telemetry, and support signals to continuously improve the system.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience leading and managing engineering teams, including managing 5+ direct reports through hiring, coaching, and performance management.

  • Experience delivering production software for connected devices, BLE-enabled systems, device-control flows, or in close partnership with firmware and hardware teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with healthcare, HIPAA, GDPR, FDA-regulated products, or other software in regulated environments.

  • Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs in environments with high quality, reliability, or compliance expectations.

  • Familiarity with modern mobile, backend, and platform systems, for example technologies such as React Native, Python, TypeScript, GraphQL, Docker, AWS, Postgres, Redis, or comparable systems.

  • Experience building test infrastructure, simulation layers, or developer productivity tooling for complex, distributed systems.

  • Experience leading teams that own production health in an on-call, continuous delivery environment.

  • Experience using AI-assisted prototyping or engineering workflows thoughtfully in product development.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. The Opportunity

As a Senior Software Backend Engineer at Hinge Health, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that directly improve member health outcomes. You will work closely with cross-functional partners, including product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, to deliver new capabilities and enhance the maintainability, reliability, and performance of our products.

In this role, you will help advance Hinge Health’s mission to transform joint and muscle care through technology. This includes contributing to AI-driven solutions that automate workflows, improve care delivery, and create better experiences for both care teams and members. Hinge Health engineers work in small, interdisciplinary teams aligned to different parts of the member journey, with strong ownership from development through production.

You will join the CareHub team, which is building the platform where care happens at Hinge Health. CareHub is the unified system that equips physical therapists, health coaches, care managers, and other care teams with the tools they need to deliver personalized, high-quality musculoskeletal care. It brings together member history, care plans, documentation, communication, and daily workflows in one place, enabling clinicians to spend less time navigating systems and more time supporting members.

As CareHub 2.0 evolves, the team is modernizing the platform to improve performance, scalability, and user experience, while also introducing AI-powered capabilities that simplify workflows and increase operational efficiency across care delivery.

We operate in a continuous deployment DevOps culture and take owner-operator pride in supporting our code in production. Our production systems use technologies including React Native, React, Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Docker, Rails, AWS, Postgres, Redis, Apollo, and Redux. Our engineering workflow follows trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance standards meet the demands of healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Design and build AI-powered clinical agents using LangGraph.js for stateful orchestration, composing multi-node StateGraphs that handle context gathering, LLM reasoning, and action execution within a shared NestJS service.

  • Integrate LangSmith for end-to-end AI observability, including prompt versioning and management via LangSmith Hub, automated per-node tracing, evaluation pipelines with golden datasets, and CI-gated quality checks that block regressions before merge.

  • Develop and maintain agentic workflows that leverage LLMs (Claude Sonnet via AWS Bedrock)

  • Contribute to the Member-Centric Knowledge Graph and RAG-based retrieval systems that give agents the clinical context, causal evidence, and relationship awareness needed for intelligent decision-making.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team's features, and contribute to the team's overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

Who You Are

  • A "Learn-it-all": You are proficient in modern stacks (TypeScript, Node.js) but remain curious. You leverage AI tools to accelerate your workflow and are eager to explore new technologies to solve complex problems.

  • A Trust Builder: You communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners (Product Managers, Designers), ensuring everyone is aligned on shared goals.

  • Resilient & Solution-Oriented: You break down complex problems into manageable tasks, navigating ambiguity to deliver results even when the path isn't perfectly defined.

  • An Owner-Operator: You take pride in supporting your code in production, embracing a DevOps culture where you build, deploy, and own your solutions.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 5+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • 3+ years of work experience Node JS/ Typescript

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, including prompt engineering, model integration (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, AWS Bedrock), and evaluating AI output quality

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration libraries for building stateful, multi-step AI workflows

  • Familiarity with LangSmith or equivalent AI observability/evaluation platforms for tracing, prompt management, and regression testing of LLM-powered features

  • Understanding of responsible AI practices including PHI/PII handling, guardrails, and output validation in healthcare or regulated environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design and coding assistance

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or scalable architectures

  • Experience with healthcare technology or regulated environments

  • Backend engineer with exposure to technology like NodeJS

  • Experience on hosting the solution on Cloud like AWS

  • Experience with Agile development practices

  • Hands-on experience with LangGraph.js for building composable subgraphs, conditional routing, and checkpointed state management in production AI systems

  • Experience with LangSmith Hub for prompt versioning, A/B testing prompt variants across environments, and building CI-gated evaluation pipelines with golden datasets

  • Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, vector search, or embedding-based retrieval systems

  • Experience building multi-agent orchestration systems using Temporal, LangGraph, or similar frameworks for durable, human-in-the-loop workflows

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

  • Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

  • Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.

We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. About the Role

We are seeking a QA Associate Manager to join our Growth Marketing Operations (GROMO) team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in marketing campaign testing and quality assurance, with expertise in audience segmentation, personalization logic, and campaign execution validation.

This role requires a deep working knowledge of marketing deployment platforms—including how to build, test, and troubleshoot campaigns using systems like Iterable, Adobe Journey Optimizer, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working within these platforms to design campaign logic, validate audience segmentation, resolve execution failures, and monitor post-send performance. You understand not just how to test campaigns, but how the underlying system logic impacts deliverability, targeting accuracy, and cross-channel orchestration.

The primary focus will be on testing, diagnosing, and optimizing marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging. You will work closely with marketing, CRM, and data teams to ensure flawless campaign execution and identify potential issues before launch.

As Hinge Health continues to scale its marketing complexity, this role will also help evolve QA toward more automated, AI-assisted, human-supervised ways of working. At the P3 level, that means using AI and automation to improve the speed, consistency, and depth of campaign validation, while applying strong judgment to verify outputs, investigate anomalies, and recommend practical process improvements. This role is not expected to set the company-wide AI QA strategy, but it should actively contribute to a more modern, scalable quality practice through thoughtful experimentation and day-to-day adoption of new tools.

What You'll Accomplish

Testing & Validation

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for marketing campaigns and audience segmentation logic.

  • Validate dynamic content, personalization rules, event triggers, and data accuracy before deployment.

  • Identify, document, and track issues related to segmentation mismatches, automation logic, and campaign execution failures.

  • Apply a mix of manual, exploratory, and repeatable validation methods based on campaign complexity, risk, and timeline.

  • Use AI-assisted workflows where appropriate to accelerate pre-launch checks, spot inconsistencies, and improve test coverage, while maintaining human review and final QA accountability

Diagnostics & Troubleshooting

  • Investigate live campaign issues using platform logs, segmentation reports, and campaign performance data.

  • Collaborate with marketing operations, CRM, and data teams to troubleshoot campaign execution errors.

  • Validate webhook integrations, API connections, and cross-channel marketing triggers, as needed.

  • Surface recurring failure patterns and recommend practical guardrails, checklists, or workflow changes that reduce repeat issues over time.

Data Analysis & Quality Assurance

  • Ensure audience segmentation accuracy and data integrity before deployment.

  • Use SQL or marketing analytics tools to verify segmentation logic and troubleshoot discrepancies.

  • Validate tracking parameters (UTMs, attribution tags) to ensure correct campaign performance reporting.

Process Improvement & Documentation

  • Develop QA checklists, testing procedures, and best practices for marketing campaign validation.

  • Document troubleshooting steps and campaign QA methodologies to improve team efficiency.

  • Provide recommendations to enhance workflow efficiency, audience segmentation, and testing approaches.

  • Monitor campaign quality signals after launch and use findings to improve future test strategies and defect prevention.

  • Partner with teammates to trial more automated or AI-supported approaches to campaign QA, anomaly detection, and data validation where they can reduce manual toil without compromising quality.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field of study.

  • 2+ years of experience in QA, marketing operations, or CRM platform testing.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Iterable, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud).

  • 2+ years of having a strong understanding of email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging campaigns.

  • Familiarity with segmentation logic, audience targeting, and personalization strategies.

  • Ability to analyze campaign performance data using Google Sheets, Looker, or Mode Analytics.

  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills, particularly in diagnosing segmentation and campaign execution issues.

  • Experience working cross functionally with marketing, CRM, and analytics teams.

  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI and automation, with the ability to use emerging tools thoughtfully to improve QA workflows while maintaining strong judgment and accountability for final outputs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic SQL skills to analyze campaign data and investigate segmentation issues.

  • Experience using Postman, Retool, or similar API testing tools for troubleshooting integrations.

The Opportunity

Growth Engineering powers how potential members discover, enroll in, and return to Hinge Health’s MSK programs. The neighborhood spans 5 pods, about 50 engineers across the US and India, and drives measurable impact across revenue, bookings, and marketing reach.

As Senior Staff Engineer, Growth, you will set the technical vision and modernization strategy across the neighborhood. You will turn growth goals and new AI and data opportunities into scalable architecture, high-impact roadmap bets, and faster experimentation. This is a key deputy to the Director of Growth Engineering: multi-quarter in scope, hands-on, and focused on multiplying impact across multiple pods.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the Growth stack end to end, from data ingestion and activation to measurement and conversion surfaces.

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Marketing, Data Science, Platform Engineering, and Staff engineers across all 5 pods.

  • Author and drive an initial high-impact RFC, such as experimentation convergence, BFF strategy, or event taxonomy.

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Publish the architectural vision for Growth’s data and activation stack, including API boundaries, event pipelines, and third-party integrations.

  • Lead the MWeb Next.js migration strategy and the SplitIO to Statsig convergence plan.

  • Improve trust in Growth data through observability standards, SLOs, and data contracts.

  • Standardize platform patterns such as BFFs, Temporal adoption, CI and testing templates, and deployment practices.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

In your first year, you will:

  • Improve cross-pod execution through clearer ownership, faster dependency resolution, and more consistent architecture.

  • Lead 2 or more major cross-pod initiatives from concept to production.

  • Turn AI and engineering automation opportunities into durable leverage across the neighborhood.

  • Develop Staff engineers into strong pod-level technical leaders.

Who You Are

  • A technical leader who has driven architecture and modernization across multiple teams or pods.

  • A growth-minded product thinker who understands funnels, experimentation, and business metrics.

  • A hands-on architect who still codes on critical paths and raises the velocity of others.

  • A strong cross-functional partner who can turn ambiguous problems into clear technical strategy.

  • A learn-it-all and bar-raiser who reflects Hinge Health’s values in communication, ownership, and experimentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • At minimum 3+ years of experience

  • At minimum, a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science of equivalent

  • Significant experience as a senior IC owning architecture and technical strategy across multiple teams in growth, marketing, or consumer product environments.

  • Deep experience with modern web stacks such as React and Next.js, experimentation platforms such as Split.io, Statsig, or Optimizely, and event-driven data systems.

  • Strong track record building reliable data and activation platforms, including event taxonomies, data contracts, observability, and downstream data quality.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-team technical initiatives, resolve architectural disagreements, and drive adoption of shared patterns.

  • Strong product partnership skills with experience shaping growth bets, experimentation strategies, and success metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading major modernization efforts such as framework migrations, experimentation platform consolidation, or large-scale data migrations.

  • Experience with backend-for-frontend patterns and workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal.

  • Experience standardizing AI-augmented engineering workflows at team or org scale.

  • Prior experience operating at Senior Staff or Principal scope in a high-growth environment.

  • Familiarity with healthcare, B2B2C, or other regulated environments.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers.   • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.
