The Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Referrals team and help us build a unified Incentive Platform. The domain that tracks eligibility, entitlement, and fulfillment state for incentive rewards. Our team owns and operates this platform: the system of record for what a member is owed and when.

This is a high-ownership, systems-first role within the team. You'll set technical direction for a platform that's mid-consolidation. Carving a clean domain boundary out of an existing service, closing known correctness gaps, and negotiating the contracts that other teams build against. You'll work closely with product and data science, and have a direct line to business outcomes like referral conversion and cost-per-acquisition.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical direction for the Incentive Platform. Carve a dedicated domain out of its current home, with enforced boundaries and a facade other services call instead of reaching into internals.

  • Generalize eligibility and entitlement logic into real, owned APIs, replacing duplicated caps and ad hoc scripts with a single source of truth for what a member has earned and is owed.

  • Run production data migrations. Dual-write, backfill, cutover on a system with financial and compliance stakes, where correctness during the transition matters as much as the end state.

  • Negotiate and build the technical contract with Fulfillment: idempotent order creation, failure handling, real-time inventory, and reserve/release semantics. You're the technical counterparty other teams negotiate with, not just an implementer of their asks.

  • Find and close correctness gaps in the current system. Places where real dollar-value entitlements are miscounted, under-specified, or rely on an undocumented assumption.

  • Partner with product, design, and analytics to define what to build and why, balancing short-term wins with long-term platform leverage.

  • Raise the engineering bar by driving code quality, system design standards, observability, and technical decision-making on the team.

  • Mentor engineers on the team, growing their judgment on architecture and cross-team tradeoffs over time.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

What We’re Looking For

  • Domain modeling under legacy constraints - You've carved a bounded context out of a service with accreted responsibilities, without a rewrite, while it kept shipping.

  • Production migration experience - You've run a dual-write/backfill/cutover on a real data model, ideally with financial or compliance stakes where getting it wrong is expensive.

  • Full-stack depth - Strong skills across technologies such as React, React Native, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Node.js, relational and non-relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and Redis. We don’t expect a perfect match on every technology, but you should be fluent in most.

  • Staff-level leadership - You’ve set technical direction for a team, influenced cross-functional roadmaps, and made architectural decisions that have held up over time.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful time working on production systems at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating full-stack applications (for example, using React/React Native on the frontend and Node.js/TypeScript or similar on the backend).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or evolving incentive, rewards, ledger, or entitlement systems that carry real financial or compliance stakes.

  • Experience running a production data migration (dual-write, backfill, cutover) without a maintenance window, on a system where correctness during the transition mattered.

  • Experience negotiating or owning a service contract with another engineering team — API design as a cross-team negotiation, not just an internal interface.

  • Proven experience setting technical direction for a team, owning architectural decisions, and driving high-quality execution in partnership with product and data science.

  • Proven experience setting technical direction for a team, owning architectural decisions, and driving high-quality execution in partnership with product and data science.

  • Prior work at a consumer growth-focused company (for example, e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer apps) and/or experience with viral or referral growth mechanics.

  • Experience working in healthcare or other regulated-data environments.

Why This Role

  • High ownership, low bureaucracy — this team moves quickly and ships iteratively while maintaining high technical standards.

  • Direct, measurable impact — your work has a clear line of sight to how many people access MSK care through Hinge Health.

  • Greenfield technical challenges — including scaling referral infrastructure, integrating personalization, and evolving experimentation capabilities as member volume grows.

  • Deep collaboration — you’ll work closely with strong data science, product, and marketing partners who are embedded with the team.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. About the Role

In this fast paced client-facing role, you will own day-to-day relationships with our employer clients and ensure they are maximizing the benefits from the Hinge Health programs. You will also have the opportunity to train, coach, and develop our CS Associates and Managers. This role demands a little bit of everything, from being a trusted adviser, project manager, product expert, coach to other team members, and more. You will be responsible for driving adoption with our clients, reporting on program value, managing escalations, expanding product offerings, and securing renewals. This is a cross-functional role that partners with Growth, Sales, Data, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Clinical to provide excellent service for our clients. The ideal candidate will also help contribute to best practices and be open to evolving responsibilities as our team grows.

The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of experience as a Client Success Manager within digital health, building relationships, managing the demands of a full book of business comprised of employers and/or health plans, and knows how to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. clients, consultants, health plans, cross-functional partners, etc). We are looking for an individual who can effectively balance their client needs with internal resources to drive high customer satisfaction year after year.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Driving revenue: Secure best-practice enrollment communications campaigns aimed at achieving annual enrollment goals for your clients

  • Long-term client management: Ensure 100% client retention with high client satisfaction (9/10+ NPS scores)

  • Customer advocacy: Turn clients into advocates to fulfill sales references and Marketing/PR requests

  • Product expansion: Ensure your clients are offering Hinge Health’s full suite of products to maximize member impact.

Basic Qualifications

  • Relationship-building: Able to build relationships at all levels as a trusted & respected thought-partner

  • Data storytelling: Able to craft a compelling story using data-driven insights to make recommendations to influence customer decisions.

  • Product Knowledge: Subject matter expert on our product, knowing the specifics and functionalities, and understanding common use cases and best practices. Able to confidently answer questions and present solutions to clients.

  • Strategic influence: Able to effectively navigate the complexities of a book of business with clients in multiple stages of their lifecycle. Gain insight into client culture, priorities, and goals. Effectively convey client needs internally, driving the resources needed for successful client relationships.

  • Manages Complexity: Able to make sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Able to ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations, acquire data and uncover root causes to difficult problems.

  • Communicate effectively: Able to communicate with internal and external stakeholders in ways that conveys both clarity of thought and rigor, while being concise - be that via prose or visual aids.

  • Think long-term: Does not sacrifice long-term value for short term results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree strongly preferred

  • Experience at a high-growth company and understand the associated challenges

  • Have an understanding of employee benefits, digital health, and the startup work environment

  • Data integration proficiency, advanced Excel knowledge and skills

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Growth Marketing Operations sits at the center of some of Hinge Health’s most complex, cross-functional workflows. As new implementations and associated processes scale, we need a Project Manager who can bring structure to ambiguity, stabilize execution, and turn reactive coordination into more durable ways of working.

This role is best suited for a systems-minded operator who can coordinate work across business and technical teams, design clearer operating models, and improve how work moves from intake through launch and ongoing support. You will help create the ownership structures, planning mechanisms, escalation paths, and visibility needed for complex marketing and operational programs to run more reliably.

You will partner closely with stakeholders across Growth, Data Science, Commercial Operations, Engineering, QA, and other teams to improve cross-functional execution, reduce manual coordination, and strengthen the workflows that support launch readiness and operational scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • In your first 3 months

    • Audit the current state of one or more complex marketing and operational workflows, including intake, handoffs, dependencies, approvals, decision points, and failure modes.

    • Build clear current-state process maps, identify where work gets stuck, and begin owning intake and traffic control so recurring work moves through a more reliable operating cadence.

    • Establish stronger visibility into in-flight work, including timelines, owners, risks, and critical dependencies across cross-functional stakeholders.

    • Identify where work is under-scoped, inconsistently tracked, or overly dependent on manual coordination, and recommend practical fixes.

  • In your first 6 months

    • Lead cross-functional coordination across partners such as Acquisition, Data Science, Commercial Operations, Engineering, QA, and other stakeholders.

    • Build and formalize intake models, ownership frameworks, escalation paths, and launch-readiness checkpoints for owned programs.

    • Create troubleshooting and triage workflows so issues are routed quickly to the right owners, exceptions are handled consistently, and recurring breakages inform process improvements.

    • Build the practical infrastructure that helps these workflows run better, including documentation, dashboards, alerts, status visibility, and automation-ready processes.

    • Translate ambiguous business needs and technical dependencies into clear project plans, milestones, handoffs, and decision points.

    • Manage budget operations for owned programs, including tracking spend, initiating purchase orders, reviewing and approving expenses, and maintaining accurate visibility into platform, vendor, contractor, and campaign-related costs with strong discretion and accuracy.

  • In your first year

    • Partner with stakeholders to determine which steps should be standardized, automated, reassigned, simplified, or stopped entirely.

    • Pilot improved ways of working, gather feedback, iterate quickly, and stabilize the new model until it can run as part of steady-state operations.

    • Improve operating quality by reducing avoidable coordination overhead, surfacing risks earlier, and strengthening accountability across handoffs.

    • Provide clear, data-informed program-level updates, surface risks early, and help stakeholders make thoughtful tradeoffs without losing momentum.

    • Help build durable PMO mechanisms that improve planning, execution, and visibility across a portfolio of related workflows rather than only within individual projects.

Who You Are

  • You are a structured operator who can walk into a suboptimal workflow, understand what is happening, and create a clearer path forward.

  • You are equally comfortable driving day-to-day execution and redesigning the system behind the work so it becomes more durable over time.

  • You are effective at working across technical and non-technical teams, and you know how to connect the right people to the right problems without creating extra friction.

  • You have strong judgment about when to introduce process, when to simplify, and when to use automation or AI-enabled tooling to reduce manual coordination and improve visibility.

  • You are comfortable working in ambiguous environments where responsibilities, dependencies, and tooling may still be evolving.

  • You can translate technical constraints and operational complexity into clear plans, risks, decisions, and stakeholder actions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4+ years of project management, business operations, marketing operations, or similar cross-functional experience leading small to mid-sized projects.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives that require process mapping, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and operational execution.

  • Experience building or improving workflows that span multiple teams, systems, and handoffs.

  • Experience using project management and workflow tools to manage timelines, dependencies, ownership, and status visibility.

  • Ability to identify operational gaps, drive follow-through, and keep work moving across teams with different priorities and contexts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in growth marketing operations, lifecycle or enrollment marketing, implementation, commercial operations, or a similarly cross-functional operating environment.

  • Experience designing or improving intake systems, RACI or ownership models, SLAs, launch-readiness processes, dashboards, alerts, and workflow documentation.

  • Experience coordinating issue triage or operational troubleshooting across multiple stakeholder groups and systems.

  • Experience working alongside technical, data, or engineering teams and translating upstream or downstream dependencies into actionable project plans.

  • Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted operations, and workflow tooling used to reduce manual coordination and improve visibility.

  • Experience supporting change management, process adoption, and operational scaling in a fast-moving environment.

  • PMP, Six Sigma, or similar project management certification is preferred.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

The Opportunity
Join the team reimagining how people interact with Hinge Health’s computer vision–powered experiences. As a Senior Quality Engineer on the Computer Vision User Experience team, you’ll drive the testing strategy and quality standards that ensure our members experience accurate, reliable, and engaging guided movement sessions. By partnering closely with CV researchers, software engineers, and product designers, you’ll expand our test surfaces, reduce manual effort through automation, and raise the bar for release readiness across the lifecycle of new capabilities.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:
• Build a deep understanding of our computer vision pipelines, mobile app surfaces, and member journeys.
• Partner daily with engineers to define and execute testing for new features and improvements, with clear acceptance criteria and test cases.
• Create and execute test plans that cover unit, integration, end-to-end, automation, and manual testing for new product capabilities.

In your first 6 months:
• Expand automated test coverage across critical member flows, catching regressions earlier and significantly reducing manual effort.
• Improve and maintain test automation frameworks to increase reliability, speed up validation, and streamline release readiness.
• Deepen collaboration with CV researchers, product, and design to ensure quality is built into the design and implementation of new motion-sensitive, interactive experiences.

In your first year:
• Serve as a quality leader for the Computer Vision User Experience domain, evolving testing practices, tooling, and standards across the team.
• Architect validation plans for novel computer-vision capabilities and complex, real-time user interactions.
• Share best practices and mentor teammates to level up quality across the broader organization.

Who You Are
• You are a hands-on quality engineer who can independently lead testing strategy and execution for complex, user-facing features.
• You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, breaking down complex CV and mobile experiences into clear validation strategies, and making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed and quality that are consistent with a P3 (Career) professional level at Hinge Health.
• You collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers, and you communicate clearly about risks, coverage, and tradeoffs.
• You embody our cultural values: you’re a learn-it-all, demonstrate hustle in finding creative ways to de-risk releases, hold yourself accountable for high-quality outcomes, and lead at all levels through your ownership of quality.

Basic Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience testing end-user applications, with hands-on experience across both manual and automated testing.

• 2+ years of experience testing mobile applications (e.g., React Native, native iOS, or native Android).
• Experience creating test plans and driving coverage across unit, integration, end-to-end, automation, and manual testing for new product capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience building, improving, or maintaining test automation frameworks to catch regressions earlier and reduce manual effort.
• 2+ years of experience creating and executing comprehensive test plans for new product capabilities, including complex feature sets.
• 3+ years operating as a senior or lead QA partner, driving testing strategy or evolving quality practices for a team.
• Experience using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript for test automation, tooling, or debugging workflows.
• Experience testing interactive mobile experiences such as video games, AR/VR applications, or other real-time, motion-sensitive products.
• Experience testing computer-vision–based applications or features.

• Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering or a related technical field.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model
This is a hybrid role based in our Montreal office and follows the Hinge Health Hybrid Model. We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

L'opportunité
Rejoignez l'équipe qui réimagine la façon dont les gens interagissent avec les expériences de Hinge Health basées sur la vision par ordinateur. En tant qu'Ingénieur Qualité Senior au sein de l'équipe expérience utilisateur de vision par ordinateur, vous dirigerez la stratégie de test et les normes de qualité qui garantissent à nos membres des séances de mouvement guidées précises, fiables et engageantes. En collaborant étroitement avec les chercheurs en vision par ordinateur (CV), les ingénieurs logiciels et les concepteurs de produits, vous élargirez nos surfaces de test, réduirez l'effort manuel grâce à l'automatisation et élèverez le niveau de préparation au lancement tout au long du cycle de vie des nouvelles capacités.

Ce que vous accomplirez

Au cours de vos 3 premiers mois :
• Développer une compréhension approfondie de nos pipelines de vision par ordinateur, des surfaces d'applications mobiles et des parcours des membres.
• Collaborer quotidiennement avec les ingénieurs pour définir et exécuter les tests des nouvelles fonctionnalités et améliorations, avec des critères d'acceptation et des cas de test clairs.
• Créer et exécuter des plans de test couvrant les tests unitaires, d'intégration, de bout en bout, d'automatisation et manuels pour les nouvelles capacités du produit.

Au cours de vos 6 premiers mois :
• Étendre la couverture des tests automatisés sur les flux critiques des membres, détectant les régressions plus tôt et réduisant considérablement l'effort manuel.
• Améliorer et maintenir les frameworks d'automatisation des tests pour augmenter la fiabilité, accélérer la validation et rationaliser la préparation au lancement.
• Approfondir la collaboration avec les chercheurs en vision par ordinateur, les équipes produit et conception pour garantir que la qualité est intégrée à la conception et à la mise en œuvre de nouvelles expériences interactives et sensibles au mouvement.

Au cours de votre première année :
• Servir de leader qualité pour le domaine Expérience Utilisateur de Vision par Ordinateur, en faisant évoluer les pratiques de test, les outils et les normes au sein de l'équipe.
• Concevoir des plans de validation pour de nouvelles capacités de vision par ordinateur et des interactions utilisateur complexes en temps réel.
• Partager les meilleures pratiques et encadrer les coéquipiers pour améliorer la qualité dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Votre profil
• Vous êtes un ingénieur qualité pratique qui peut diriger de manière autonome la stratégie et l'exécution des tests pour des fonctionnalités complexes et axées sur l'utilisateur.
• Vous êtes à l'aise pour naviguer dans l'ambiguïté, décomposer les expériences complexes de vision par ordinateur et mobiles en stratégies de validation claires, et faire des compromis réfléchis entre la vitesse et la qualité qui sont cohérents avec un niveau professionnel P3 (Carrière) chez Hinge Health.
• Vous collaborez efficacement avec les ingénieurs, les chefs de produit, les concepteurs et les chercheurs, et vous communiquez clairement sur les risques, la couverture et les compromis.
• Vous incarnez nos valeurs culturelles : vous êtes avide d'apprendre, vous faites preuve de dynamisme pour trouver des moyens créatifs de réduire les risques de lancement, vous vous tenez responsable des résultats de haute qualité et vous faites preuve de leadership à tous les niveaux en vous appropriant la qualité.

Qualifications de base
• 3+ années d'expérience en test d'applications utilisateur final, avec une expérience pratique des tests manuels et automatisés.
• 2+ années d'expérience en test d'applications mobiles (par exemple, React Native, iOS natif ou Android natif).
• Expérience dans la création de plans de test et dans la conduite de la couverture pour les tests unitaires, d'intégration, de bout en bout, d'automatisation et manuels pour les nouvelles capacités de produit.

Qualifications privilégiées
• Expérience dans la construction, l'amélioration ou la maintenance de frameworks d'automatisation des tests pour détecter les régressions plus tôt et réduire l'effort manuel.
• 2+ années d'expérience dans la création et l'exécution de plans de test complets pour de nouvelles capacités de produit, y compris des ensembles de fonctionnalités complexes.
• 3+ années d'expérience en tant que partenaire QA senior ou chef d'équipe, dirigeant la stratégie de test ou faisant évoluer les pratiques de qualité pour une équipe.
• Expérience de l'utilisation de Python, JavaScript ou TypeScript pour l'automatisation des tests, l'outillage ou les flux de travail de débogage.
• Expérience en test d'expériences mobiles interactives telles que des jeux vidéo, des applications AR/VR ou d'autres produits en temps réel et sensibles au mouvement.
• Expérience en test d'applications ou de fonctionnalités basées sur la vision par ordinateur.
• Baccalauréat en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine technique connexe.

Modèle hybride Hinge Health
Il s'agit d'un rôle hybride basé dans notre bureau de Montréal et qui suit le modèle hybride Hinge Health. Nous pensons que le travail à distance et le travail en personne ont leurs propres avantages et inconvénients, et nous voulons être en mesure de tirer parti du meilleur des deux mondes. Les employés occupant des rôles hybrides sont tenus d'être au bureau 3 jours par semaine.

À propos de Hinge Health
Chez Hinge Health, nous utilisons la technologie pour mettre à l'échelle et automatiser la prestation des soins de santé, en commençant par les troubles musculosquelettiques (TMS), qui touchent plus de 1,7 milliard de personnes dans le monde. Grâce à un modèle de soins centré sur l'humain et alimenté par l'IA, Hinge Health exploite une technologie de pointe pour améliorer les résultats, les expériences et les coûts afin d'aider les gens à aller au-delà de leur douleur. La plateforme couvre un large éventail de soins des TMS – des blessures aiguës à la douleur chronique, en passant par la rééducation post-chirurgicale – grâce à des soins personnalisés et fondés sur des données probantes. En tant que partenaire privilégié de plus de 60 régimes d'assurance maladie, gestionnaires de prestations pharmaceutiques (PBM) et autres partenaires de l'écosystème, Hinge Health est accessible à plus de 20 millions de personnes auprès de plus de 2 800 employeurs. Le siège social de l'entreprise est situé à San Francisco avec des bureaux supplémentaires à Montréal et à Bangalore. En savoir plus sur http://www.hingehealth.com.

Ce que vous aimerez chez nous
• Soins de santé et avantages sociaux inclusifs : En plus d'une couverture médicale, dentaire et visuelle complète, nous offrons aux employés et aux membres de leur famille une aide pour les soins d'affirmation du genre, des outils de planification familiale et de fertilité, ainsi que des remboursements de frais de voyage si les soins de santé ne sont pas disponibles là où vous vivez.
• Planification de l'avenir : Commencez à épargner pour la retraite avec notre régime REER, qui inclut une contribution équivalente de l'employeur de 2 %.
• Allocations pour la vie moderne : Gérez votre propre apprentissage et développement.
• Grandissez avec nous : Grandissez avec nous grâce à des actions de l'entreprise à prix réduit via notre PEE (ESPP) avec des retenues sur salaire faciles.

Culture et engagement
Hinge Health est un employeur qui respecte l'égalité des chances et interdit la discrimination et le harcèlement de toute nature. Nous prenons des décisions d'emploi sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'origine nationale, l'âge, le statut d'ancien combattant, le statut d'invalidité, la grossesse ou toute autre base protégée par la loi fédérale, étatique ou locale. Nous tenons également compte des candidats qualifiés, quels que soient leurs antécédents criminels, conformément aux exigences légales. Nous offrons des aménagements raisonnables aux candidats handicapés. Si vous estimez avoir besoin d'aide ou d'un aménagement en raison d'un handicap, veuillez nous en informer en contactant votre recruteur. En soumettant votre candidature, vous reconnaissez que nous utilisons vos données personnelles comme indiqué dans la politique de confidentialité du personnel et des candidats. Méfiez-vous des tentatives d'hameçonnage : Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de détails financiers pendant le processus d'embauche et n'utiliserons que des courriels “@hingehealth.com”. Si vous recevez une offre suspecte, cessez la communication et signalez-la au Centre américain de plaintes pour crimes sur Internet (US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center). Pour vérifier un courriel de notre équipe de recrutement, transférez-le à security@hingehealth.com.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. The Opportunity

Home is the first thing members see when they open the Hinge Health app. The Home Pod is responsible for making sure every member quickly finds the care they came for, and as a result, we sit on a critical business path for Hinge Health. In this role, you’ll own and evolve the core Home experience on our React Native app, using experimentation to deliver a delightful experience that reliably guides members into the right sessions and programs.

You’ll join a strong pod as the senior-most engineer, partnering closely with product, design, data, and backend teams to define the technical direction, raise the quality bar, and mentor others while shipping impactful improvements to one of our most visible product surfaces.

 

What You’ll Accomplish

Below are example impact areas over your first 3, 6, and 12 months. At Hinge Health, we regularly adjust priorities to respond to member needs and business incentives, so these are illustrative rather than fixed checklists.

  • In your first 3 months:

    • Build a deep understanding of the Home domain, member journeys, and how Home connects to core care experiences (sessions, programs, content).

    • Partner with product, design, and data to map the current Home funnel, identify key drop-offs, and prioritize experiments.

    • Ship meaningful improvements to our existing React Native Home experience, focusing on performance, reliability, and polish.

  • In your first 6 months:

    • Mentor and pair with engineers on the pod, helping them grow in mobile best practices, code quality, and experimentation mindset.

    • Continue to improve our new server-driven UI architecture for Home, collaborating with backend and platform teams to refine APIs, configuration models, and guardrails.

    • Deepen and participate in our existing experimentation and measurement framework for Home (e.g., A/B tests, feature flags, event instrumentation) to iterate on layouts, recommendations, and CTAs.

  • In your first year:

    • Own the long-term technical roadmap for the Home pod’s client architecture, balancing flexibility (through server configuration) with a responsive, native-quality member experience.

    • Drive cross-team initiatives to improve the end-to-end journey from Home through sessions and care plans, ensuring the surface reliably delivers business outcomes (session bookings, program engagement, retention).

    • Raise engineering standards on the pod (testing, observability, reliability, accessibility, performance) and help scale the team’s impact as the product and membership grow.

    • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

 

Who You Are

  • Mobile product craftsperson: You care deeply about core flows and how they feel in a member’s hand, from loading behavior and animations to edge cases and error states.

  • Experimentation-oriented: You’re comfortable defining hypotheses, designing experiments, instrumenting funnels, and iterating based on data and qualitative feedback.

  • Server-driven UI experience: You’ve designed or worked with server-configured experiences and know how to keep them fast, reliable, and intuitive for both members and internal stakeholders.

  • Team mentor and collaborator: You enjoy leveling up a strong but more junior team through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and clear written communication.

  • Owner mindset: You think in terms of systems and business impact, not just tickets—you’re comfortable taking a problem from idea through launch, measurement, and iteration.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of practical software engineering experience, including building and shipping user-facing applications in production.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or foreign equivalent).

  • 2+ years of hands-on React Native experience building mobile applications at scale.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing server-driven UI or configuration-driven presentation layers on mobile or other client platforms.

  • Track record of running experiments (e.g., A/B tests or multivariate tests) on core product surfaces and using results to drive roadmap decisions.

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript/JavaScript, React Native, and modern mobile development tooling; familiarity with backend services (e.g., Node/TypeScript, GraphQL, or similar) is a plus.

  • Experience working on high-traffic, critical-path surfaces (e.g., home screens, discovery/navigation surfaces, or key funnels).

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design collaboration, and technical guidance.

  • Comfort collaborating with product, design, and data/analytics partners to define metrics, interpret results, and refine experiences.

  • Experience in healthcare, consumer apps, or other regulated or data-sensitive environments is a plus.

 
 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

 
 


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About Us

Hinge Health is a leader in Digital Physical Therapy, and we’re expanding into new areas of care. In April 2026, we launched our comprehensive Migraine Care Program, extending our digital care platform beyond physical therapy. We’re now building a new team to launch a Gastrointestinal (GI) Care Program. GI conditions affect roughly one in four U.S. adults and drive $135 billion in annual medical spending.

Our planned acquisition of Cylinder Health, a leader in virtual-first digestive healthcare, gives us a strong foundation for entering this market. By combining Cylinder’s clinical expertise and market presence with Hinge Health’s AI-powered care model and technology platform, we can rapidly build a new GI product expected to launch in 2027.

As a Staff Software Engineer for GI, you’ll help shape an end-to-end digital care experience for people living with GI conditions. You’ll lead rapid experiments to validate assumptions, navigate complex technical and product challenges, and turn what you learn into a reliable, scalable product that can improve members’ health at meaningful scale.

At Hinge Health, staff engineers are senior technical contributors who lead through code, technical judgment, and influence. You’ll set direction for critical systems, contribute to production code daily, raise the quality bar, and mentor other engineers without moving into people management. You’ll partner closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, Design, and Marketing in San Francisco, Montreal, and Bangalore. Learn more about the staff engineer archetypes that thrive at Hinge Health.


What You’ll Accomplish

Below are example impact areas over your first 3, 6, and 12 months. At Hinge Health, we regularly adjust priorities to respond to member needs and business incentives, so these are illustrative rather than fixed checklists.

  • In your first 3 months:

    • Help define the GI product line from scratch.

    • Build strong partnerships with Product, Design, and Marketing to align on the strategy, experimentation roadmap, and success metrics.

    • Lead the technical roadmap development for the new GI product line spanning AI systems, UX interfaces, business logic middletier, hardware integration and where to loop in the board-certified clinician for in-person support to members.

    • Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts for the hardest parts of the new product line

  • In your first 6 months:

    • Build the GI product as a minimum lovable product (MLP) delivering a significant & measurable health improvement for members.

    • Mentor and pair with engineers on the pod, helping them grow in engineering best practices, code quality, and experimentation mindset.

    • Create engineering best practices for CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and client performance across the entire stack.

    • Personally develop the hardest, most challenging software elements in the product roadmap.

  • In your first year:

    • Have launched the new product and already work on iterations to adapt it using real member feedback post-launch.

    • Drive cross-team initiatives to improve the end-to-end journey for GI end users

    • Continuously raise engineering standards on the pod (testing, observability, reliability, accessibility, performance) and help scale the team’s impact as the product and membership grow.

Who You Are

  • 0->1 Builder: We are looking for an engineer with a track record of building brand new products from scratch.

  • Talent magnet: someone who is recognized as a leader and other people want to work with.

  • AI-Driven development: You have been using the latest AI software development techniques (ex: teams of AI Agents) and continuously look for new AI techniques that can improve your productivity.

  • You move fast, know how to balance innovation vs reuse, and deliver clear business results.

  • Hands-on engineer: You’re reading and writing code across the tech stack (e.g., React Native, BFF/full-stack web, GraphQL, AI Agents, Computer Vision, Medical Device Integration, etc), and you use that fluency to coach, review, and set technical direction.

  • Experiment-driven operator: You think in terms of hypotheses, sample sizes, and decision rules, and you can run a dense A/B experimentation roadmap without sacrificing quality.

  • Team mentor and collaborator: You enjoy leveling up a strong but more junior team through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and clear written communication.

  • Owner mindset: You think in terms of systems and business impact, not just tickets—you’re comfortable taking a problem from idea through launch, measurement, and iteration.

  • Inclusive team builder: You create clear expectations, give direct feedback, and foster a culture where engineers can do the best work of their careers.

Basic Qualifications

  • A minimum of 8+ years of practical software engineering experience, including building and shipping user-facing applications in production.

  • A minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or foreign equivalent).

  • 2+ years of hands-on React Native experience building mobile applications at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technologies: Experience building in large React Native codebases, TypeScript/Node.js & Go backends, GraphQL, AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, SNS, SageMaker), tooling for client performance, render optimization, devops and app architecture patterns.

  • Product Integration mindset: History operating a product surface that integrates across multiple platforms owned by different teams.

  • Track record of running experiments (e.g., A/B tests or multivariate tests) on core product surfaces and using results to drive roadmap decisions.

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript/JavaScript, React Native, and modern mobile development tooling; familiarity with backend services (e.g., Node/TypeScript, GraphQL, or similar) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design collaboration, and technical guidance.

  • Comfort collaborating with product, design, and data/analytics partners to define metrics, interpret results, and refine experiences.

  • Experience developing consumer-facing apps used by millions/billions of users.

  • Regulated environments: Experience working within healthcare (HIPAA) or other highly regulated domains involving sensitive member data.

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

The Opportunity

Every day, prospective clients ask: “How does digital GI care really work?” As a GI Clinical Commercial Consultant, you’ll bring the answer to life through live product demos, member stories, and presentations on the clinical science behind Hinge Health’s digestive health program. You’ll help enterprise buyers, health plans, and partners understand how our nutrition-led model supports members.

At the intersection of our Commercial and Clinical teams, you’ll partner with Sales, Partnerships, Client Success, Marketing, and the clinicians delivering GI care. Together, you’ll help Hinge Health win new business, strengthen client relationships, and grow awareness of our GI program. You’ll also work alongside our PT Commercial Consultants as part of a growing clinical commercial team. Whether you’re already part of our clinical team or joining from outside, this is an opportunity to extend your impact beyond an individual caseload.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build fluency in the Hinge Health care model, GI program, commercial pitch process, and product demo by shadowing sales presentations and learning the demo end to end.

  • Build strong working relationships across Sales, Partnerships, Client Success, Marketing, and the clinical team delivering GI care.

In your first 6 months

  • Independently deliver live GI program demos during sales pitches and partnership presentations, presenting clinical content clearly and answering questions about our nutrition-led care model.

  • Join Client Success events for existing clients—including health fairs, virtual education sessions, and enrollment campaigns—to increase member engagement and program awareness.

  • Adapt presentations to the needs of enterprise buyers, health plans, partners, and members while incorporating feedback from each engagement.

In your first year

  • Become a trusted clinical voice in commercial settings, contributing clinical perspective to marketing initiatives and reviewing or creating content such as blogs, videos, and presentations.

  • Respond to clinical questions in RFPs and prospect requests, helping explain the evidence and care model behind the GI program.

  • Represent Hinge Health at key industry conferences and in-person client meetings as the primary RD presence for events.

Who You Are

  • A compelling storyteller who makes clinical evidence relatable and can confidently present Medical Nutrition Therapy and digestive health concepts to senior buyers and other non-clinical audiences.

  • A learn-it-all who brings clinical expertise in digestive health and nutrition, welcomes feedback, and continually builds commercial acumen.

  • A resourceful, results-oriented partner who finds creative ways to connect with audiences and move work forward in a fast-paced commercial environment.

  • A clear and concise communicator who can adapt across live demos, RFP responses, client events, and marketing content.

Basic Qualifications

  • Registered Dietitian credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR) and active, unrestricted state licensure.

  • At least 3 years of clinical experience as an RD, including digestive health and Medical Nutrition Therapy—for example, IBS, IBD, GERD, gastroparesis, FODMAP and elimination diets, food allergies, or food intolerances.

  • Ability to educate non-clinical audiences about clinical concepts and care models, and to communicate clinical value in a way that resonates with buyers and decision-makers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current or prior experience as a Hinge Health or Cylinder RD, or experience in telehealth or digital health.

  • Public-speaking or presentation experience through conferences, webinars, community events, or internal forums.

  • Experience contributing to marketing or educational content, such as blog posts, videos, or patient education materials.

  • Experience in a client-facing, commercial, or sales-support role, such as a clinical liaison, health plan, or industry position.

  • A master’s degree in Dietetics or Human Nutrition, a relevant board certification (such as CSG or CSO), or additional training in gut health, IBD, or disordered eating.

Work Location and Travel

This is a remote role with regular travel. You should be comfortable traveling 2–3 days per week, 1–3 weeks per month, for key meetings, client events, or conferences in person.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.

Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI), and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore.

Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401(k) retirement plan options, which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Access discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let your recruiter know.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we use your personal data as outlined in our personnel and candidate privacy policy.

Beware of phishing attempts: We’ll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use “@hingehealth.com” email addresses. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the U.S. FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. About the Role

Join the team responsible for the products at the heart of how Hinge Health delivers care for musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions. This team owns our core MSK programs and the build-out of new ones, like our recently launched migraine offering, that let us scale the business into new conditions and reach more members.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll help take new programs of care from early concept to a stable, scaled offering, then keep sharpening what already works. That means building the greenfield features that make a new program a real, differentiated offering, not just an existing treatment experience with a new label. It also means extending and hardening the shared services that power all of our programs. You'll work closely with Product and with engineers across multiple partner teams to ship a coherent, end-to-end program of care for our members.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Lead through influence: Take on the team's most ambiguous or technically complex problems, setting direction through your own technical work, design docs, and mentorship rather than through formal authority. Sometimes that means digging into the platform itself, when that's what's holding the team back from scaling into new programs of care.

  • Bring new programs of care to life: Lead the technical design and delivery of new MSK programs (in the vein of our migraine launch), building the features and workflows that make each program a credible, differentiated offering.

  • Strengthen what's already live: Take newly launched programs from shipped to stable and scaled, improving reliability, performance, and quality as usage grows.

  • Extend our shared platform: Design and build within our existing services (NestJS backend, React Native app, PostgreSQL) to support new programs without fragmenting the platform.

  • Partner deeply with Product: Work hand-in-hand with Product to translate program strategy into technical plans, surfacing trade-offs and options as scope evolves.

  • Collaborate across teams: Coordinate closely with engineers on partner teams to deliver a cohesive member experience across the many services and teams a program touches.

  • Elevate engineering practices: Champion strong practices around CI/CD, testing, and monitoring. Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for the team.

Who You Are

  • A Technical Visionary: You navigate ambiguity well and can turn a broad product goal, like "launch a new program of care," into a concrete, scalable technical plan.

  • A Builder Across Horizons: You're equally comfortable in 0→1 greenfield work and in the less glamorous work of hardening something already live.

  • A Force Multiplier: You raise the level of everyone around you through code review, mentorship, and by setting technical standards that reduce friction.

  • A Natural Collaborator: You thrive working across team boundaries, with Product and with engineers on other teams, to deliver something coherent even when the work spans many services and owners.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of non-internship full-time professional software engineering experience

  • 2+ years of experience with TypeScript/JavaScript across the stack (Node.js/NestJS on the backend; React or React Native on the frontend).

  • 2+ years of experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerization tools.

  • 2+ years of experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), distributed systems, and microservices architectures.

  • 2+ years of experience mentoring or leading other engineers and collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • NestJS & React Native: Direct experience with NestJS. Any mobile app development experience is a plus (React Native or otherwise).

  • Multi-team delivery: Experience shipping a product or feature that required close, ongoing coordination across several engineering teams, not just your own.

  • Regulated Industry Knowledge: Experience working within healthcare (HIPAA) or other highly regulated environments involving sensitive member data.

  • High-Influence IC Track Record: A track record of operating as a high-influence individual contributor at the Staff level, shaping technical direction and raising the bar for a team without having direct reports.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About the Role

Hinge Health is looking for a strategic, high-judgment Senior Talent Partner to lead engineering recruiting. This is a high-impact role for someone who knows how to partner closely with senior engineering leaders, translate business priorities into clear talent strategies, and deliver exceptional hiring outcomes in a high-bar environment.

In this role, you will own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles across software engineering, hardware, data science, and/or data platform, serving as a true thought partner to leaders across the engineering organization. You will shape search strategy, calibrate hiring plans, use market insights to influence decisions, and ensure candidates have a thoughtful, high-quality experience from first touch through close.

This role is a strong fit for someone who is equal parts operator and advisor: someone who can move quickly, work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions with data, and build trust with demanding technical stakeholders.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for engineering roles across software engineering, hardware, data science, and/or data platform—from intake and calibration through offer close and handoff.

  • Partner with engineering leaders to define role scope, level, and search strategy based on business needs and market reality.

  • Build and manage high-quality pipelines for technical talent, including passive candidate outreach in highly competitive markets.

  • Use recruiting data and funnel insights to diagnose bottlenecks, improve hiring efficiency, and drive better decision-making with stakeholders.

  • Lead thoughtful calibration conversations when hiring teams need to reassess expectations around level, compensation, or candidate profile.

  • Create an excellent candidate experience by ensuring clear communication, strong process management, and a high-touch, respectful approach throughout the interview journey.

  • Influence longer-term headcount planning by bringing technical talent market insights and hiring data into workforce planning conversations.

  • Help improve hiring quality by refining job descriptions, interview process design, and stakeholder alignment where needed.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You are a strong strategic partner, not an order-taker. You know how to influence senior technical stakeholders, push on assumptions, and guide teams toward better hiring decisions.

  • You bring strong technical recruiting judgment. You understand how to assess talent across software engineering, hardware, data science, and data platform domains and tailor search strategy to different levels, problem spaces, and team needs.

  • You are highly data-driven. You use funnel metrics, market signals, and process data to identify issues and improve outcomes.

  • You care deeply about candidate experience and know that high standards and high humanity should go together.

  • You are agile, organized, and comfortable juggling multiple priorities without losing quality or momentum.

  • You are energized by high-bar environments and know how to operate well with senior, discerning engineering teams.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting or talent partnership experience, with meaningful experience supporting hiring across software engineering, hardware, data science, or data platform functions.

  • Track record of partnering with senior engineering hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver against complex hiring goals.

  • Demonstrated success sourcing and hiring passive technical talent in competitive markets.

  • Strong experience using recruiting data to influence decisions, improve processes, and solve hiring challenges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility quickly and handle challenging stakeholder dynamics with sound judgment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting technical talent across software, hardware, or data domains in a fast-paced, high-growth, or mission-driven environment.

  • Experience supporting engineering leaders through org design, workforce planning, or talent mapping conversations.

  • Experience improving technical interview process design, calibration, and candidate experience at the function level.

  • Familiarity with healthcare, digital health, or other complex hardware and software environments.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact on one of the most vital parts of the business: building the engineering and data organization. The role is high visibility—you will work closely with senior technical leaders, help shape hiring strategy in a high-expectation environment, and play a visible role in raising the bar on technical talent across the organization.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

The Opportunity

Access to high-quality musculoskeletal (MSK) care is often fragmented and difficult to navigate. You will solve this by building the engine that powers our physical provider network, directly connecting 20M+ members to best-in-class in-person care. As a foundational member of our Commercial Team, you won't just sell; you will define the provider network strategy for your territory, transforming how major health systems and provider groups partner with Hinge Health to deliver care.

What You'll Accomplish

  • In your first 3 months: You will master the Hinge Health provider value proposition and map the high-priority provider landscape in your territory. You’ll build a qualified pipeline of prospective provider groups and initiate key relationships.

  • In your first 6 months: You will close your first provider network contracts, navigating complex negotiations with legal and clinical stakeholders. You will launch these initial partners, ensuring a seamless implementation and onboarding experience.

  • In your first year: You will fully own the network strategy for your territory, consistently hitting network growth targets. You will act as the "Voice of the Provider" to our product teams, influencing the roadmap for our hybrid care model.

Basic Requirements

  • This territory consists of targeted metro regions in the US.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 5 years work experience.

  • Background in provider sales and/or network development.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, provider network development / management, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health.

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

  • Excellent strategic territory management, prospecting, project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup, with demonstrated ability to innovate and solve problems creatively.

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members.


Preferred Requirements

  • Startup experience

  • Experience with clinical quality and price transparency tools

  • Experience with provider network adequacy tools

  • Experience with physical therapy and/or orthopedic clinical solutions or provider community
