About the Role

Hinge Health is seeking a highly skilled Supply Chain Program Manager to join the company's Logistics team. As the Supply Chain Program Manager, Inbound, you will own the end-to-end inbound process for international products, partnering with vendors, our customs broker, logistics, and cross-functional hardware teams to keep inbound operations running smoothly.

This role is ideal for an experienced supply chain or operations program manager who enjoys solving practical problems, improving established processes, and seeing the direct impact of their work. You will manage vendor-facing programs, customs and duty workflows, commercial documentation, and invoice validation while helping Hinge Health deliver products to members on time.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Take ownership of the existing inbound process and establish clear operating rhythms, responsibilities, and escalation paths.

  • Build strong working relationships with international vendors, the customs broker, logistics partners, and Hardware Operations stakeholders.

  • Review inbound product flows, customs and duty requirements, HS-code usage, commercial documentation, and invoice-validation practices.

  • Identify the highest-impact process gaps and risks affecting product timing, cost, documentation quality, or vendor execution.

  • Establish regular reporting on inbound status, exceptions, documentation issues, and actions required to keep products moving.

In your first 6 months

  • Manage the end-to-end inbound process for international products, from vendor coordination through customs clearance, receipt, and invoice validation.

  • Coordinate with vendors and the customs broker to resolve documentation, classification, duty, and clearance issues.

  • Ensure required commercial documents include accurate and relevant information, including appropriate HS codes and supporting details.

  • Validate invoices against agreed pricing, shipment information, and supporting documentation, escalating discrepancies to the appropriate stakeholders.

  • Partner with logistics and Hardware Operations to improve inbound handoffs, reduce avoidable delays, and maintain reliable product flow.

  • Track vendor performance and recurring operational issues, then drive practical corrective actions with internal and external partners.

In your first year

  • Enhance the scalability, consistency, and visibility of Hinge Health’s inbound operating process as product and vendor needs evolve.

  • Develop and maintain clear process documentation, operating procedures, and controls for inbound execution, customs and duties, and invoice validation.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce cost, improve vendor performance, and increase predictability across the inbound supply chain.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen supply chain operations and support new product or hardware programs.

  • Travel locally to vendors when needed to strengthen partnerships, understand operational constraints, and resolve issues at the source.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced supply chain or operations program manager who can manage complex, vendor-facing processes from end to end.

  • You are comfortable working across international inbound operations, customs and duties, commercial documentation, and invoice validation.

  • You are a practical problem solver who can move between strategic process improvement and detailed day-to-day execution.

  • You build trust with vendors and internal partners, communicate clearly, and drive accountability without relying on formal authority.

  • You take ownership of outcomes, follow issues through to resolution, and use data and operating details to make sound decisions.

  • You are energized by visible impact and enjoy improving real-world systems rather than working only at a theoretical or reporting level.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or program management, including experience managing international inbound products and vendors.

  • Working knowledge of customs and duties processes, including the use of HS codes and supporting commercial documentation.

  • Experience managing cross-functional operational processes from vendor coordination through inbound receipt and invoice validation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting medical devices or other regulated products.

  • Familiarity with ISO 13485 or similar quality-management systems.

  • Experience negotiating vendor contracts or pricing, or implementing cost-reduction initiatives.

  • Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems, such as NetSuite or similar tools.

  • Proficiency with Excel or similar tools for operational tracking, analysis, and reporting.

  • Familiarity with Linear or comparable project-management tools.

  • Mandarin fluency and experience communicating with vendors or teams in Asia.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Every day, prospective clients ask: “How does digital GI care really work?” As a GI Clinical Commercial Consultant, you’ll bring the answer to life through live product demos, member stories, and presentations on the clinical science behind Hinge Health’s digestive health program. You’ll help enterprise buyers, health plans, and partners understand how our GI care model supports members through the medical management of digestive health conditions.

At the intersection of our Commercial and Clinical teams, you’ll partner with Sales RVPs, Partnerships leads, Client Success managers, Marketing, and the clinicians delivering GI care. Together, you’ll help Hinge Health win new business, strengthen client relationships, and grow awareness of our GI program. You’ll also work alongside our PT Commercial Consultants as part of a growing clinical commercial team. Whether you’re a PA or NP already part of our clinical team or joining from outside, this is an opportunity to extend your impact beyond an individual caseload.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build fluency in the Hinge Health care model, GI program, commercial pitch process, and product demo by shadowing sales presentations and learning the demo end to end.

  • Build strong working relationships across Sales, Partnerships, Client Success, Marketing, and the clinical team delivering GI care.

In your first 6 months

  • Independently deliver live GI program demos during sales pitches and partnership presentations, presenting clinical content clearly and answering questions about our GI care model.

  • Join Client Success events for existing clients—including health fairs, virtual education sessions, and enrollment campaigns—to increase member engagement and program awareness.

  • Adapt presentations to the needs of enterprise buyers, health plans, partners, and members while incorporating feedback from each engagement.

In your first year

  • Become a trusted clinical voice in commercial settings, contributing clinical perspective to marketing initiatives and reviewing or creating content such as blogs, videos, and presentations.

  • Respond to clinical questions in RFPs and prospect requests, helping explain the evidence and care model behind the GI program.

  • Represent Hinge Health at key industry conferences and in-person client meetings as the primary GI clinical presence for events.

Who You Are

  • A compelling storyteller who makes clinical evidence relatable and can translate the medical management of digestive health conditions into persuasive, accessible narratives for senior buyers and other non-clinical audiences.

  • A learn-it-all who brings clinical expertise in gastrointestinal care, welcomes feedback, and continually builds commercial acumen.

  • A resourceful, results-oriented partner who is energized by travel, conferences, and a fast-paced commercial environment—and finds creative ways to connect with audiences and drive results.

  • A clear and concise communicator who can adapt across live demos, RFP responses, client events, and marketing content.

Basic Qualifications

  • Licensed Physician Assistant (PA-C) or Nurse Practitioner (NP) with active, unrestricted state licensure and current national board certification.

  • At least 3 years of clinical experience as a PA or NP, including medical management of patients with gastrointestinal conditions such as IBS, IBD, GERD, gastroparesis, constipation, and diarrhea. This includes screening patients and ordering appropriate testing for differential diagnosis, educating patients on general condition management, and prescribing and managing medications for GI conditions.

  • Ability to educate non-clinical audiences about clinical concepts and care models, and to communicate clinical value in a way that resonates with buyers and decision-makers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current or prior experience as a Hinge Health or Cylinder clinician, or experience in telehealth or digital health.

  • Experience working in gastroenterology, whether in a specialty practice, health system, or GI-focused clinic.

  • Advanced Practice Provider Gastrointestinal Certification (APP GI-C).

  • Public-speaking or presentation experience through conferences, webinars, community events, or internal forums.

  • Experience contributing to marketing or educational content, such as blog posts, videos, or patient education materials.

  • Experience in a client-facing, commercial, or sales-support role, such as a clinical liaison, health plan, or industry position.

  • Advanced training or certification relevant to GI care, such as a fellowship, GI-focused CME, or specialty certificate.

Work Location and Travel

This is a remote role with regular travel. You should be comfortable traveling 2–3 days per week, 1–3 weeks per month, for key meetings, client events, or conferences in person.

About the Role:

Help members find the right care and take the next step in their healthcare journey. As the Engineering Manager for Discovery, you'll lead the team responsible for building intuitive, reliable care discovery experiences that connect members and care teams with the information and services they need, whether care happens virtually or in person.

The Discovery team delivers a search and discovery experience across member- and staff-facing applications as well as the shared data and search infrastructure that powers them. You'll lead engineering efforts spanning care search, relevance, and scheduling — making it easier for members to find appropriate care and for care teams to navigate complex information efficiently.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other engineering teams to improve discovery success, reduce friction from intent to action, and build scalable capabilities that support multiple applications. As a hands-on engineering leader, you'll stay close to the technology, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews, and implementation when appropriate (~15% of your time), while developing a high-performing team.

What You'll Accomplish:

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Build strong relationships with your engineering team and cross-functional partners, establishing clear goals, ownership, and execution expectations.

  • Develop a deep understanding of existing discovery experiences, shared search infrastructure, data foundations, and scheduling workflows.

  • Define and execute a technical roadmap that balances user-facing improvements, shared platform capabilities, and operational reliability.

  • Lead delivery of meaningful improvements to care discovery and search experiences, improving relevance, usability, and conversion from discovery to next action.

  • Strengthen shared search and data capabilities to improve accuracy, reliability, and reuse across member- and staff-facing applications.

  • Establish data-driven experimentation and engineering best practices around measurement, automated testing, observability, and performance.

  • Champion AI-native development practices while growing and mentoring a high-performing engineering team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded engineering leader: You care deeply about building experiences that solve real user problems and translate complex information into simple, intuitive workflows.

  • Technically credible builder: You're comfortable reasoning about backend services, data models, APIs, and application architecture. You stay close to the code and use your technical judgment to guide decisions and coach engineers.

  • Systems and platform thinker: You understand how to design reusable infrastructure and shared capabilities while balancing product velocity, scalability, and reliability.

  • Data-driven problem solver: You define success through measurable outcomes, use data and experimentation to guide decisions, and continuously improve the experiences your team builds.

  • Collaborative team builder: You communicate clearly, navigate ambiguity, develop engineers through coaching and feedback, and create an environment where people can do their best work.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience managing a team of approximately 5 or more engineers in a product or platform engineering environment.

  • Strong software engineering background, with experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, and data-intensive systems.

  • Experience owning and evolving production systems end-to-end, including architecture, delivery, performance, and operational reliability.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner with Product and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver measurable product or business outcomes.

  • Track record of building, mentoring, and developing high-performing engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Search and discovery systems: Experience with search infrastructure, information retrieval, ranking, relevance optimization, or knowledge graphs.

  • Data and platform engineering: Experience building shared services and data platforms used by multiple applications or engineering teams.

  • Consumer and enterprise experiences: Experience building member-facing or internal operational workflows, with a strong understanding of usability and performance.

  • Healthcare integrations: Familiarity with healthcare navigation, provider and coverage data, scheduling systems, EMR integrations, or regulated health data.

  • AI-native development: Experience using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or agent-based workflows to improve engineering productivity and quality.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model:

We believe that remote work and in-person work each have their own advantages, and we want to leverage the best of both worlds. The Opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Care Interactions team, you will shape and build the systems that enable Hinge Health’s care teams to communicate with members and deliver personalized musculoskeletal care at scale. Care Interactions is part of CareHub, Hinge Health’s internal care-delivery platform used by physical therapists, health coaches, physicians, care managers, and other clinical teams.

The team owns core communication and care-delivery capabilities, including in-app messaging, video visits, scheduling-related experiences, clinical notes, care plans, and the CareHub interaction record used for coordinated care. You will provide technical leadership across these complex, workflow-heavy domains, helping the team build reliable, secure, and intuitive products that reduce fragmented tools and repetitive administrative work so care team members can focus on clinical judgment and member connection.

CareHub is evolving toward an AI-first platform. In this role, you may help build AI-assisted capabilities for visit preparation, documentation, summarization, contextual recommendations, and follow-up workflows. You will contribute to systems that are clinically useful, observable, resilient, and safe, with appropriate human oversight for decisions that affect care delivery.

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to take problems from discovery through production. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, workflow-heavy products where thoughtful technical decisions can improve care-team efficiency, member experience, and Hinge Health’s ability to deliver care at scale.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language

  • 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle

  • 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript

  • 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

  • A platform-as-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes.

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure-mode analysis.

  • Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling.

  • Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability.

  • Experience improving observability through metrics, structured logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with practical knowledge of cache design and invalidation, database performance KPIs, query and index tuning, connection pools, and capacity management

  • Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines.

  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal, or comparable workflow technology.

  • Experience with media processing tools such as ffmpeg, adaptive bitrate video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, or caption formats such as WebVTT.

  • Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka, and CI/CD automation, such as GitHub Actions.

  • Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or serving as a technical lead for a platform, migration, or cross-functional launch.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

  • Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

  • Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Join the team transforming how benefits consultants, brokers, and advisory firms help their clients bend the healthcare cost trend. You will own a defined market and a portfolio of strategic consultant relationships, turning trusted relationships and market insight into education, influence, qualified pipeline, and closed business.

This is a senior, externally facing role for a relationship-oriented commercial leader who can operate at both the executive and field level. You will build durable relationships with national and regional consulting leaders, practice leads, clinical and analytics experts, producers, and account teams. You will also work closely with Sales and other commercial partners to help employers evaluate and adopt Hinge Health.

The role combines regional leadership with national partnership responsibilities. Depending on business needs, you will own a geographic territory and serve as the relationship lead for employee benefits consulting firms.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Build and execute a territory and consultant-partnership plan focused on the firms, offices, contacts, and employer accounts with the greatest growth potential.

  • Develop trusted relationships with benefits consultants, brokers, advisory firms, practice leaders, clinical experts, actuaries, producers, and account teams.

  • Generate consultant-influenced pipeline by creating targeted engagement plans, warm introductions, executive meetings, and business-case opportunities with Sales.

  • Lead strategic relationships with assigned national and regional consulting firms, including joint plans, business reviews, education, and growth initiatives.

  • Create and activate referral, reseller, data-sharing, and other channel partnerships in collaboration with Legal, Finance, Operations, Health Economics, and commercial leadership.

  • Educate consultants on Hinge Health’s clinical model, technology, outcomes, claims-based ROI methodology, member experience, and solutions such as HingeSelect.

  • Present and demonstrate Hinge Health at consultant meetings, executive briefings, webinars, continuing-education sessions, conferences, roundtables, and partner events.

  • Translate complex clinical, actuarial, product, contracting, and implementation topics into clear, credible stories that help consultants advise their clients.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Client Success, Clinical, Product, Marketing, Health Economics, Health Plan Partnerships, Ecosystem Partnerships, Legal, and Operations to advance opportunities and improve the partner experience.

  • Bring consultant feedback, market intelligence, competitive insight, and objections back to internal teams to strengthen our products, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

  • Maintain disciplined Salesforce activity, relationship, opportunity, and partner-involvement data.

Who You Are

  • A senior commercial and relationship leader who can build trust with both executive stakeholders and field-level consultant teams.

  • A strategic operator who turns relationships and market insight into measurable access, influence, pipeline, and revenue.

  • A clear, compelling storyteller who can make clinical evidence, ROI, product value, and implementation details easy to understand.

  • An entrepreneurial, organized, and adaptable partner who manages multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • A collaborative teammate who brings structure to complex opportunities and works effectively across functions.

  • A credible ambassador for Hinge Health who values clinical rigor, member experience, and long-term partner trust.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience selling health technology, employee benefits, healthcare services, or related solutions through consultant, broker, or advisory channels.

  • Established relationships and market knowledge within benefits consulting, brokerage, or healthcare advisory firms.

  • Demonstrated success building new partnerships and expanding existing strategic relationships.

  • Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, consultative B2B opportunities through indirect or partner channels.

  • Strong executive presence, presentation, discovery, storytelling, negotiation, and written communication skills.

  • Ability to discuss clinical evidence, claims-based ROI, analytics, pricing, contracting, implementation, and competitive positioning with sophisticated audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to create and execute business plans while managing multiple priorities.

  • Strong project-management, organization, follow-through, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Working proficiency with Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 30–50% for partner meetings, conferences, events, and team collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience negotiating channel, referral, reseller, data-sharing, or revenue-based partnership agreements.

  • Experience selling digital MSK, benefits, health plans, clinical services, or adjacent healthcare solutions.

  • Experience leading consultant education, continuing-education programs, executive roundtables, or partner councils.

  • Health insurance license.

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer based in San Francisco or the broader Bay Area to join Hinge Health’s IT & Security team at our San Francisco headquarters. In this hybrid role, you’ll help build the reliable, secure, and scalable technology foundation that enables our people to do their best work.

You’ll own and improve the systems behind our corporate technology environment—from endpoint management, networking, and identity to cloud platforms and internal AI-enabled workflows. You’ll be equally comfortable troubleshooting a difficult network issue, automating device enrollment, designing secure access patterns for enterprise data, and helping the team make thoughtful technology decisions as Hinge Health grows.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for an owner-operator who enjoys solving root causes, reducing operational friction, and turning emerging technology into practical solutions that improve how Hinge Health works.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build context on Hinge Health’s corporate IT environment, including endpoints, Jamf, networking, identity, SaaS platforms, asset management, and existing operational processes.

  • Establish strong working relationships across IT, Security Operations, IT Risk, SRE, Engineering, and AI Enablement.

  • Take ownership of complex technical escalations, using a structured troubleshooting approach and documenting root causes, risks, and follow-up actions.

In your first 6 months

  • Improve the reliability and consistency of endpoint provisioning, configuration management, access workflows, and routine IT operations through automation and self-service.

  • Maintain and optimize Jamf and related endpoint tooling across a multi-OS environment, with a primary focus on macOS.

  • Administer and improve corporate networking, including enterprise wireless and zero-trust network access (ZTNA), in partnership with relevant security and infrastructure teams.

  • Help implement secure integrations and operational guardrails for internal AI tools, including identity-aware access, data handling, logging, and support processes.

In your first year

  • Lead meaningful improvements to the reliability, security, and scalability of corporate IT infrastructure, including projects such as technology refreshes, office buildouts, and infrastructure migrations.

  • Evaluate and operationalize emerging AI capabilities—including LLM-backed tools, retrieval workflows, and agent-style automation—with sound judgment around security, governance, reliability, and employee experience.

  • Raise the effectiveness of the broader team through clear documentation, runbooks, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and durable operational practices.

Who You Are

  • You are an owner-operator who takes responsibility for systems throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation through support, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • You communicate clearly and calmly with both technical and non-technical partners, especially when diagnosing high-impact issues or navigating competing priorities.

  • You are a learn-it-all who stays curious about new technologies and is willing to challenge assumptions, test ideas, and improve based on evidence.

  • You bring a bias toward action and accountability: you make thoughtful tradeoffs, follow through on commitments, and look for creative ways to reduce friction without compromising security or reliability.

  • You lead at all levels by sharing knowledge, mentoring teammates, and making the systems and processes around you easier for others to use and support.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or a comparable infrastructure role supporting a multi-OS environment, with strong experience in macOS.

  • Demonstrated experience owning endpoint management and corporate infrastructure, including Jamf or a comparable MDM platform, enterprise networking, and identity or SaaS administration.

  • Demonstrated experience automating IT operations through scripting such as Bash or Python, MDM workflows, infrastructure-as-code, or comparable engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Okta, Google Workspace, SSO, SCIM, and identity-aware access patterns.

  • Experience supporting or integrating internal AI-enabled tools, including practical familiarity with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), or similar connector patterns.

  • Experience designing controls for AI-enabled systems, including data handling, permissions, logging, monitoring, safe use of internal knowledge sources, and incident response.

  • Experience supporting cloud-based SaaS environments or corporate IT systems that intersect with cloud infrastructure; AWS experience is a plus.

  • Familiarity with security operations tooling such as SIEM, EDR, CrowdStrike, or Netskope.

  • Knowledge of healthcare-relevant compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, or SOC 2.

  • Experience supporting globally distributed teams and/or administering Windows and Linux environments, including Ubuntu.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Join RAIN—the Rewards & Incentives pod—as we build product experiences that help members form healthy habits and stay engaged with their Hinge Health care journey. Our mission is to use rewards, insights, and thoughtful product experiences to encourage behaviors that support members’ health goals.

RAIN owns member-facing capabilities including points, achievements, streaks, challenges, tiers, and digital and physical incentives. We work across mobile experiences, backend services, experimentation, and operational tooling to make these experiences useful, reliable, measurable, and easy to evolve.

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you’ll own meaningful product work across the front end and backend, from technical discovery through production. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering partners to turn member needs into simple, reliable, and measurable solutions.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Build and operate full-stack features using JavaScript, TypeScript, React Native, NestJS, and Node.js.

  • Own projects from technical design through launch, measurement, iteration, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Develop well-tested APIs, data models, and mobile experiences for rewards and incentives.

  • Translate product ideas into practical solutions and make thoughtful trade-offs between member value, quality, simplicity, and delivery speed.

  • Improve reliability through testing, observability, performance improvements, and production support.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical documentation, code reviews, and reducing technical debt.

  • Use Claude Code and other approved AI tools as part of your development workflow.

  • Provide clear context, plan work, review generated changes critically, and validate behavior with tests and running code.

  • Mentor teammates and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Key Partnerships

You will work closely with:

  • Product, to define problems, shape roadmaps, prioritize work, and measure outcomes.

  • Design and User Experience, to create clear and motivating member experiences.

  • Data and Analytics, to design experiments, understand member behavior, and evaluate impact.

  • Adjacent Engineering, Platform, Quality, Security, Privacy, and Compliance teams to integrate services and deliver safe, dependable experiences.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship full-time professional software development experience.

  • Experience building and operating production software as a full-stack engineer.

  • Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and frontend development.

  • Ability to take ownership of ambiguous problems and deliver practical solutions incrementally.

  • Experience making technical decisions across service boundaries and explaining trade-offs clearly.

  • A product mindset and interest in connecting engineering work to member needs and measurable outcomes.

  • Clear communication and effective collaboration with cross-functional partners.

  • Good judgment when using AI coding tools, including providing context, reviewing generated code, and maintaining ownership of architecture, security, and maintainability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with machine learning, including training or fine-tuning models.

  • Experience integrating hosted machine-learning models in the cloud.

  • Experience with rewards, incentives, gamification, engagement, or other consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working in privacy, security, or compliance-sensitive environments.

What success looks like

  • You deliver reliable rewards and incentives capabilities that create clear value for members.

  • You become a trusted technical partner to Product, Design, Data, and Engineering.

  • You improve the clarity, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you touch.

  • You help the team use AI-assisted development effectively without compromising engineering quality.

Why join RAIN

You’ll work on a high-impact product area that connects software, behavior change, and better health outcomes. You’ll join a small, cross-functional team where engineers have meaningful influence over product and technical decisions and own their systems in production.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Join Hinge Health at a pivotal moment as we build a new strategic growth channel focused on healthcare provider partnerships. As Senior Manager, Provider Partnerships, you will create the strategy and operating model that enables providers to seamlessly refer patients to Hinge Health from within their existing clinical workflows.

You will serve as an entrepreneurial, commercially minded builder responsible for developing relationships with leading health systems, integrated delivery networks, academic medical centers, physician organizations, EMR vendors, and healthcare integration partners. This is a highly autonomous opportunity to build from zero to one, shape company strategy, and expand access to evidence-based musculoskeletal care.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Establish the provider partnerships strategy, market priorities, target partner profile, and operating rhythm.

  • Build a qualified pipeline across health systems, provider organizations, EMR vendors, interoperability platforms, and referral workflow partners.

  • Develop trusted relationships with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Marketing, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation.

In your first 6 months

  • Develop and advance executive-level relationships with health system leaders, CMIOs, CIOs, service line leaders, and digital health teams.

  • Structure, negotiate, and close initial strategic partnership agreements, including clear commercial models and pilot plans.

  • Launch and manage strategic provider referral pilots, with success metrics, measurement plans, and cross-functional ownership in place.

In your first year

  • Demonstrate measurable growth in provider referrals originating from within health systems and partner workflows.

  • Translate pilot learnings into repeatable partnership offerings, playbooks, and scalable operating processes.

  • Establish the long-term strategy for scaling Provider Partnerships, including the ecosystem, metrics, forecasting approach, and path to sustainable growth.

Who You Are

  • A strategic builder who is energized by ambiguity, can move between long-term vision and hands-on execution, and enjoys creating new businesses from the ground up.

  • An owner who takes accountability for outcomes, makes thoughtful tradeoffs, and moves complex work forward with urgency and sound judgment.

  • An effective communicator who can earn trust, create clarity, and influence senior internal and external stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • A learn-it-all who uses data, partner feedback, and market insight to test assumptions, improve the strategy, and make better decisions quickly.

  • A hands-on leader who can set a clear vision, navigate complex organizations, remove barriers, and bring diverse cross-functional teams together around shared goals.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, enterprise sales, healthcare technology, or a related field.

  • Experience developing and executing commercial strategies or partnership programs, including negotiating complex enterprise agreements.

  • Experience working with healthcare providers, health systems, EMRs, interoperability, digital health, or related healthcare ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building a new business, market, or partnership function from zero to one.

  • Experience with healthcare integration technologies, referral workflows, interoperability platforms, or EMR ecosystems.

  • A track record of developing executive-level relationships with health system or provider leadership.

  • Experience designing, launching, measuring, and scaling strategic pilots.

  • Experience creating repeatable commercial models, operating processes, and playbooks for a new growth channel.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence product direction based on partner and customer insights.

  • Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Clinical, Marketing, Legal, Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation teams.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Physical therapists are the backbone of the comprehensive clinical care team at Hinge Health. Hinge Health Physical Therapists utilize their clinical expertise and knowledge of pain science to deliver care for a large number of patients across the MSK spectrum, including pelvic health, via telehealth video visits and in-app messaging. We believe in providing the best patient-centered care by applying the Biopsychosocial model, evidence-informed practice, and innovative thinking with technology to help patients reduce pain and achieve meaningful outcomes. Through our technology-first platform, Hinge Health physical therapists improve the lives of many at scale. You will work with a diverse set of members within a team of high performing, inclusive clinicians.


Our physical therapists are on the bleeding edge of delivering virtual MSK care enabled by advanced technology. Come join us if you’re excited to evolve alongside the future of PT practice!

The role is called “Flex Physical Therapist” for a reason - your flexibility and resilience is critical!

  • You thrive in situations requiring you to constantly adapt and evolve. Change is not a scary word to you, and you want to continually improve yourself, your profession, and healthcare as a whole.

  • Our Flex hour model: As a non-exempt employee, an essential requirement of this role is maintaining availability to work between 25 and 40 hours per week, with scheduled hours determined based on business needs (with optional overtime if offered).. You will be notified of your schedule outlook at least one month in advance and fully confirmed 2 weeks in advance. This is not a full time, part time, or PRN position - it is a Flex position where employees must be able to commit to a variable schedule.

  • You embrace technology-forward care delivery, utilizing telehealth, in-app messaging, and a variety of digital tools to serve members at significant scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Evaluate and treat patients remotely utilizing a variety of digital tools to manage care and oversee technology outputs.

  • Communicate effectively to drive member engagement and articulate clinical reasoning to drive product development.

  • Knowledgeable about biopsychosocial model, patient-centered MSK care, behavior change models, pain neuroscience education, and evidence-informed practice.

  • Provides high caliber of service resulting in high customer satisfaction and improved clinical outcomes.

  • Manages patients safely and efficiently given a large and varied caseload.

Basic Qualifications

  • You have 2-4 years of clinical physical therapy experience practicing in an orthopedics setting, evaluating and treating a variety of MSK conditions.

  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program with a Doctorate of Physical Therapy (DPT).

  • Licensed to practice Physical Therapy in at least 1 state of the United States. Ability to complete required documentation to secure additional state licenses upon receipt of offer, within a timely manner.

  • Willing to work across time zones to serve a geographically diverse member population.

  • Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials.

  • You must be able to deliver telehealth services in a private, professional space with reliable, strong internet connectivity and within the United States.

  • Able to work evenings.

  • Your current and foreseeable future state of residence is within: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands

  • Telehealth: Demonstrates excellent and clear decision making to evaluate, treat, and manage MSK members, including some pelvic health, utilizing a biopsychosocial model as appropriate.

  • Effective Patient Management: Manages a large and varied caseload of members safely and efficiently, utilizing a variety of digital tools to manage care and communicate effectively.

  • Effective Communication: Able to communicate effectively and clearly, both written and verbally, with members, colleagues, and other professionals.

  • Change Agility: Highly adaptable to taking on new workflows, processes and challenges within a fast-paced environment by employing critical thinking and creative problem-solving.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Able to work weekends

  • Additional certifications in orthopedics, pain science, or related specialties

  • Medical fluency in Spanish (written and verbal)

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care. As the preferred partner to 60+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,800 employers.   • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

About the Role

Join Hinge Health's GI Care team and help members improve their digestive health through personalized, evidence-based nutrition care.

As a Registered Dietitian, you'll provide Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and behavior-change coaching to members managing a wide range of digestive health conditions. Through virtual visits and in-app messaging, you'll build meaningful relationships with members, help them navigate complex symptoms, and empower them to make sustainable changes that improve their health and quality of life.

You'll be part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary care team that values clinical expertise, professional judgment, and whole-person care. Hinge Health combines innovative technology with human-centered care, giving you the tools and support to focus on what matters most: helping members achieve meaningful health outcomes.

A Flexible Approach to Care Delivery

This is a remote, W-2 position with a flexible scheduling model designed to align clinician capacity with member demand.

  • Guaranteed minimum of 25 paid hours per week, with the opportunity to work up to 40 hours based on business needs.

  • Advance scheduling visibility: Receive an outlook of your anticipated hours approximately one month in advance, with your schedule confirmed at least two weeks ahead.

  • Paid time for more than just appointments: Your scheduled hours include member visits, documentation, care coordination, team meetings, and other clinical responsibilities.

  • No need to build your own caseload: Hinge Health connects members with their care team and facilitates appointment scheduling.

  • Consistent compensation during scheduled hours: Cancellations and no-shows do not reduce your pay for scheduled working time.

We're looking for clinicians who enjoy working in an evolving digital health environment, are comfortable with variable weekly schedules, and are excited to help shape the future of virtual nutrition care.

What you'll do

  • Deliver individualized Medical Nutrition Therapy: Assess and support members managing conditions such as IBS, IBD, GERD, chronic constipation and diarrhea, gastroparesis, SIBO, food intolerances, malnutrition, and other digestive health concerns.

  • Build meaningful member relationships: Provide compassionate, personalized care that helps members feel heard, supported, and empowered to manage their digestive health.

  • Support sustainable behavior change: Partner with members to establish realistic goals, develop practical strategies, and build habits that support long-term health.

  • Use clinical judgment to guide care: Individualize nutrition interventions, appointment frequency, and ongoing support based on each member's needs, goals, and progress.

  • Provide continuous support: Combine virtual visits with personalized in-app messaging to reinforce progress, answer questions, and maintain engagement between appointments.

  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team: Work closely with health coaches and other clinicians to deliver coordinated, whole-person care.

  • Leverage innovative technology: Use digital health tools, clinical resources, and AI-supported workflows to enhance care delivery while maintaining clinical judgment and a human-centered approach.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement: Share clinical insights, member feedback, and opportunities to improve the care experience and delivery model.

  • Maintain high-quality clinical documentation: Complete timely, accurate documentation and follow established clinical standards, protocols, and escalation processes.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for Registered Dietitians who are passionate about digestive health, skilled at building relationships, and excited about delivering high-quality care in a virtual environment.

  • Member-Centered Care. You lead with empathy, listen actively, and understand that every member's experience with digestive health is unique. You can translate complex nutrition recommendations into practical, achievable steps.

  • Strong Clinical Judgment. You apply evidence-based nutrition principles, think critically, and individualize care based on member needs rather than relying on a one-size-fits-all approach.

  • Effective Coaching and Communication. You know how to build rapport, support behavior change, and help members make meaningful progress. You're comfortable communicating through both video visits and written messaging.

  • Collaboration and Teamwork. You value learning from others, sharing knowledge, and working collaboratively to deliver the best possible member experience.

  • Adaptability and Growth Mindset. You're curious, open to feedback, and comfortable learning new approaches as digital healthcare continues to evolve.

  • Technology-Enabled Care. You're confident using technology to support clinical care and comfortable working with AI-powered tools while applying your professional judgment to ensure accuracy, safety, and personalization.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in nutrition, dietetics, or a related field

  • Active Registered Dietitian credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR)

  • Active, unrestricted state licensure as required for clinical practice

  • At least 1 year of relevant clinical experience

  • Experience providing nutrition counseling, behavior-change coaching, or chronic disease management

  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfort managing a clinical caseload and delivering care in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency with digital tools and the ability to learn new technology

  • Ability to independently deliver telehealth services from a private, professional workspace with reliable internet access within the United States

  • Availability to work variable schedules of 25–40 hours per week, including some evening hours, within designated operating hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Central Time

  • Willingness to appear as a member of the clinical care team within the Hinge Health product and related materials

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in nutrition, dietetics, or a related field

  • Experience providing Medical Nutrition Therapy for digestive health conditions

  • Experience working in telehealth or digital health

  • Active licensure in multiple states

  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English, with the ability to complete a language competency assessment

  • Additional training or certifications in gastrointestinal nutrition, behavior change, or related specialties

  • Availability to work occasional weekend hours

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Focus on delivering great care. Hinge Health connects you with members, manages scheduling, and provides the technology and resources you need to deliver meaningful clinical care without having to build your own practice.

  • Practice with clinical autonomy. Tailor your approach to each member's needs, including the frequency and focus of visits, rather than working toward rigid appointment-frequency targets.

  • Be part of a supportive clinical community. Collaborate with talented clinicians, participate in case discussions and journal clubs, and learn from colleagues who are passionate about delivering excellent care.

  • Get paid for the work you do. As a W-2 employee, your paid scheduled hours include member visits, documentation, care coordination, and other responsibilities. Your pay isn't dependent on whether members attend their scheduled appointments.

  • Invest in your professional growth. Access professional development opportunities, continuing education support, and opportunities to expand your clinical expertise.

  • Enjoy comprehensive benefits. Eligible employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, sick time, retirement benefits with a company match, employee stock programs, and additional wellness and lifestyle benefits.

  • Help shape the future of digestive healthcare. Join a growing GI Care program that combines evidence-based nutrition therapy, innovative technology, and human connection to make specialized digestive healthcare more accessible.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

Associate Health Coach, Flex

The Opportunity

As part of the comprehensive clinical care team at Hinge Health, health coaches utilize their behavior change expertise to impact members across the MSK, GI, pelvic health and healthcare spectrum, via telehealth video visits and in-app messaging. We believe in applying the Biopsychosocial model, evidence-informed practice, and innovative thinking with technology to help members reduce pain and achieve meaningful outcomes. Through our technology-first platform, Hinge Health health coaches improve the lives of many at scale.

The role is called “Flex Associate Health Coach” for a reason - your flexibility and resilience is critical!

  • You thrive in situations requiring you to constantly adapt and evolve. Change is not a scary word to you, and you want to continually improve yourself, your profession, and healthcare as a whole.

  • Our Flex hour model: As a non-exempt employee, An essential requirement of this role is maintaining availability to work between 25 and 40 hours per week, with scheduled hours determined based on business needs (with optional overtime if offered). You will be notified of your schedule outlook at least one month in advance and fully confirmed 2 weeks in advance.

  • You embrace technology-forward care delivery, utilizing telehealth, in-app messaging, and a variety of digital tools to serve members at significant scale.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver time-bound, goal-driven, impactful coaching through a series of video visits focused on behavior change, habit formation, and lifestyle adjustments that support members' health goals and adherence to their care plan. Supplement video visits with personalized, goal-oriented in-app messaging that reinforces progress and maintains continuity between sessions.

  • Leverage the Hinge Health technology platform to make strategic, effective coaching decisions that drive health goal attainment and meaningful member outcomes.

  • Collaborate within the care team to ensure a seamless, coordinated member experience and respond to clinician referrals for coaching services. Accurately complete all required processes and updates in the member journey, including video visit notes and clinical escalations.

  • Build strong relationships and rapport with members. Listen to and adapt to each member's unique circumstances, supporting them in staying accountable to their goals, healthy lifestyle changes, while keeping members focused and engaged within Hinge Health activities.

  • As the front line of our product and member experience, critically assess our coaching approaches, synthesize and relay member trends, insights and feedback to the Product and Clinical Operations teams.

Who You Are

  • Member-Centered Mindset: High emotional intelligence and top tier coaching skills to help members understand the behaviors and lifestyle factors influencing their health, build sustainable habits, and connect them to the Hinge Health program in a meaningful manner. Excellent communicator via live interactions (video visits) and asynchronous in-app messaging.

  • Quality at Scale: Track record of delivering high quality coaching to a large caseload, consistently meeting metrics for coaching quality, member outcomes, and efficiency.

  • Adaptability & Initiative: Demonstrates change agility and a growth mindset amidst ongoing coaching practice and program changes in a fast-paced environment. High aptitude for technology, troubleshooting, and learning new features and tools.

  • AI-Enabled Care: Comfortable working alongside AI-powered tools while maintaining personalized, human-centered communication. Critically evaluates AI-generated outputs, applies professional judgment, and ensures the member experience reflects highest quality standards.

Basic Qualifications

  • NBHWC Board Certification and professional Health Coach training from an NBHWC-accredited program required

  • 2+ years experience in health coaching

  • Experience with large caseloads

  • Demonstrated prior experience working with behavior change or chronic disease management, including but not limited to MSK, GI, diabetes, weight loss & nutrition, mental health

  • Must be able to deliver telehealth services in a private, professional space with reliable, strong internet connectivity and within the United States

  • Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials

  • Current and foreseeable future state of residence within:

    • IL (ex Chicago), MD (ex DC Radius), MA (ex Boston Radius), NH (ex Boston Radius), NY (ex NYC Radius), RI (ex Boston Radius), TX (ex Houston), VA (ex DC Radius), WA (ex Seattle Radius), WI (ex Chi Radius), AK, CO, DE, GA, HI, MI, MN, NC, NV, OR, PA, AL, AZ, AR, FL, ID, IN (ex Chicago), IA, KS, KY, LA, ME, MS, MO, MT, NE, NM, ND, OH, OK, SC, SD, TN, UT, VT, WV, & WY.

  • This role requires you to work within the designated hours of 7am - 9pm PST (regardless of your location).

  • Ability to work evenings (4pm and later within designated hours).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Able to work weekends

  • Additional certifications in orthopedics, pain science, women's health or related specialties

  • Medical fluency in Spanish (written and verbal)
