The Opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer on Hinge Health’s Service Enablement team, you will build the platforms, services, and engineering practices that other teams at Hinge Health rely on to ship software safely and quickly.

Service Enablement treats Hinge Health engineers as its customers. The team builds paved roads, automation, and platform capabilities in developer experience, cloud and service platforms, reliability, observability, security, CI/CD, and AI/ML enablement. The goal is to remove friction, improve operational maturity, and make the default path the easiest one for product and infrastructure teams.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership. Expect to turn broad engineering needs into technical strategy, lead initiatives that span several teams, and set standards that get adopted beyond your own pod.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Data, ML, and Infrastructure to balance delivery speed against reliability, security, cost, and maintainability. As Hinge Health expands its use of AI across the software development lifecycle and the care platform, you will also help make those AI and ML workloads reliable, cost efficient, and responsibly run.

The problems in this role are foundational. Fixing them makes every engineering team at Hinge Health more effective, and the software they ship helps make healthcare more accessible and affordable.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Own a multi-quarter technical roadmap for one or more Service Enablement domains, based on what internal engineering teams actually need.

  • Lead architecture and design for highly available, secure, and maintainable platforms and services that cross pod boundaries.

  • Build and maintain paved roads for service development, deployment, observability, reliability, and operational ownership.

  • Improve developer productivity with automation, reusable frameworks, self-service workflows, and documentation that people can follow.

  • Set practical standards for SLOs, alerting, incident response, capacity management, service ownership, and production readiness.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to run AI and ML workloads reliably and cost efficiently, including inference systems where they make sense.

  • De-risk ambiguous problems with prototypes, spikes, and experiments that produce measurable results.

  • Write and lead RFCs, design reviews, and technical decision records. Explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Take part in production operations and eliminate recurring failure modes with systemic fixes.

  • Deliver large initiatives from strategy through production adoption, and measure the result: platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, cost, or reduced operational toil.

  • Mentor engineers, coach senior engineers into broader technical leadership, help with hiring, and raise the bar for engineering practice across the organization.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8:30 pm - 10:30pm IST).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 10+ years of professional software development, or equivalent depth building and operating production systems.

  • 4+ years with at least one modern programming language such as TypeScript/JavaScript,Go, Python.

  • 4+ years across the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.

  • 4+years of experience in cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads such as AWS, Kubernetes, or EKS.

  • Experience in software design and distributed systems fundamentals: reliability, scalability, performance, failure modes, and API or platform contracts.

  • Experience operating production systems, including observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement.

  • Experience treating internal platforms and developer experience as products, with attention to usability, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, Claude etc

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building internal developer platforms, service templates, golden paths, CI/CD systems, or self-service infrastructure.

  • Experience with platform security, identity and access management, compliance controls, or secure-by-default engineering.

  • Experience supporting AI/ML teams with inference infrastructure, model serving platforms, evaluation workflows, or cost and performance optimization.

  • Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability.

  • Experience with event-driven systems, workflow orchestration, service networking, or large-scale data and messaging infrastructure.

  • Experience defining platform metrics such as adoption, deployment lead time, change failure rate, availability, developer satisfaction, or operational toil.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or acting as technical lead for a platform migration, modernization effort, or organization-wide launch.

  • Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

  • Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

  • Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Hinge Health is the leader in Digital Physical Therapy and we are expanding to new areas outside of physical therapy. In May we launched the new Migraine product line, and now we are building a new team from scratch for a Gastrointestinal (GI) product line. GI is a $135B market in the US alone and after the acquisition of Cylinder Health, we are in a great position to rapidly build new products in the GI space. This is your opportunity to build a brand new product from scratch, defining the product that millions of Americans will see in their healthcare plan next year.

As a Senior Software Engineer for GI, you’ll build an understanding for the 60M+ Americans afflicted by this health condition, ensuring that Hinge Health builds a comprehensive end-to-end experience to treat them, run rapid experiments to validate your assumptions, and launch a brand new digital care product for GI. What differentiates HingeHealth from other platforms is our fast pace of innovation blending licensed care providers with AI solutions and medical grade hardware to deliver a complete experience that improves the health of our users.

You’ll partner closely with staff engineers, team leaders including cross-functional partners in Product, Design, and Marketing across our hubs in San Francisco, Montreal, and Bangalore to build a new GI product. As a hands-on engineer, you’ll contribute to and review code daily, raise the quality bar, and independently ship impactful improvements to one of our most visible product surfaces.

What You’ll Accomplish

Below are example impact areas over your first 3, 6, and 12 months. At Hinge Health, we regularly adjust priorities to respond to member needs and business incentives, so these are illustrative rather than fixed checklists.

  • In your first 3 months:

    • Contribute to defining the GI product line from scratch.

    • Deliver at least 1 large project that introduces new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

    • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

    • Exhibit strong user and business judgment, grounding decisions in customer needs and business priorities to drive durable product value

    • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

  • In your first 6 months:

    • Implement key functionalities of the new GI product delivering high-quality, bug-free, high-performance software on a tight schedule.

    • Have a track record of independently driving 3+ high-complexity projects from the roadmap as their engineering leader.

    • Implement engineering best practices such CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, or client performance across the code repo you support.

    • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

    • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

    • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing

  • In your first year:

    • Have launched the new product and already work on iterations to adapt it using real member feedback post-launch.

    • Drive cross-team initiatives to improve the end-to-end journey for GI end users

    • Continuously raise engineering standards on the pod (testing, observability, reliability, accessibility, performance) and help scale the team’s impact as the product and membership grow.

Who You Are

  • 0->1 Builder: We are looking for an engineer with a track record of building brand new products from scratch.

  • AI-Driven development: You have been using the latest AI software development techniques (ex: teams of AI Agents) and continuously look for new AI techniques that can improve your productivity.

  • You move fast, know how to balance innovation vs reuse, and deliver clear business results.

  • Hands-on engineer: You’re reading and writing code across the tech stack (e.g., React Native, BFF/full-stack web, GraphQL, AI Agents, Computer Vision, Medical Device Integration, etc), and you use that fluency to coach, review, and set technical direction.

  • Experiment-driven operator: You think in terms of hypotheses, sample sizes, and decision rules, and you can run a dense A/B experimentation roadmap without sacrificing quality.

  • Team mentor and collaborator: You enjoy leveling up a strong but more junior team through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and clear written communication.

  • Owner mindset: You think in terms of systems and business impact, not just tickets—you’re comfortable taking a problem from idea through launch, measurement, and iteration.

  • Inclusive team builder: You create clear expectations, give direct feedback, and foster a culture where engineers can do the best work of their careers.

Basic Qualifications

  • A minimum Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • A minimum of 3 + years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language

  • 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technologies: Experience building in large React Native codebases, TypeScript/Node.js & Go backends, GraphQL, AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, SNS, SageMaker), tooling for client performance, render optimization, devops and app architecture patterns.

  • Product Integration mindset: History operating a product surface that integrates across multiple platforms owned by different teams.

  • Track record of running experiments (e.g., A/B tests or multivariate tests) on core product surfaces and using results to drive roadmap decisions.

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript/JavaScript, React Native, and modern mobile development tooling; familiarity with backend services (e.g., Node/TypeScript, GraphQL, or similar) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design collaboration, and technical guidance.

  • Comfort collaborating with product, design, and data/analytics partners to define metrics, interpret results, and refine experiences.

  • Experience developing consumer-facing apps used by millions/billions of users.

  • Regulated environments: Experience working within healthcare (HIPAA) or other highly regulated domains involving sensitive member data.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

As a hands-on engineer, you’ll contribute to and review code daily, raise the quality bar, and independently ship impactful improvements to one of our most visible product surfaces. What You’ll Accomplish Below are example impact areas over your first 3, 6, and 12 months. At Hinge Health, we regularly adjust priorities to respond to member needs and business incentives, so these are illustrative rather than fixed checklists. - In your first 3 months: - Contribute to defining the GI product line from scratch. - Deliver at least 1 large project that introduces new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories. - Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents. - The Opportunity

Help expand Hinge Health access by turning complex products into clear stories, successful launches, and meaningful client adoption. As Product Marketing Manager, New Verticals, you will lead product marketing for new expansions. You will partner closely with Health Services to support health-plan approvals and with Client Success to help clients understand and adopt new offerings.

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, Digital Care, you will own GTM strategy and execution, from positioning and launch planning to building slides, writing messaging, and leading live enablement. Your work will help establish Hinge Health as a market leader in new verticals.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first three months:

  • Build expertise in current new verticals solutions, including its strengths, differentiators, and messaging within your first 30 days.

  • Create and improve slides, messaging, FAQs, and objection-handling resources that support health-plan approvals and client conversations.

  • Lead enablement sessions within your first 60 days and develop a reliable approach to answering questions and maintaining useful resources.

In your first six months:

  • Independently own the product marketing work supporting New verticals expansion, prioritizing approval needs with Health Services and delivering the assets partners need to move decisions forward.

  • Drive client readiness and adoption for new offerings through coordinated launch communications, practical resources, and live enablement.

  • Establish adoption measures with Client Success and use client feedback, recurring objections, and performance data to improve messaging and launch execution.

In your first year:

  • Help expand new verticals availability across the book of business by supporting outstanding health-plan approvals.

  • Drive measurable client adoption of new offerings against agreed goals, tracking adoption separately from health-plan approval coverage.

  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for the product expansions, aligning positioning, audiences, launch milestones, partner readiness, and measurement with the product roadmap.

  • Keep cross-functional partners and leadership informed with concise updates on progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.

Who You Are

  • A clear communicator: You translate complex clinical and product information into concise messaging, well-structured slides, and effective live presentations. You can recommend a course of action and answer senior stakeholders’ questions directly.

  • A hands-on owner: You connect business priorities to daily execution, create the assets yourself, and take accountability for commitments and results.

  • A Learn-it-All: You seek feedback, apply it without defensiveness, and quickly build fluency in unfamiliar products and markets.

  • A trusted partner: You work efficiently with Health Services, Client Success, Product, and Clinical partners, make tradeoffs explicit, and follow through.

  • A resourceful problem-solver: You bring urgency and sound judgment, adapt when priorities change, and keep work moving through constraints.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience independently owning product positioning, go-to-market launches, or product-adoption initiatives with measurable outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to create clear messaging and presentation materials and deliver live enablement for business or client-facing teams.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work from planning through execution, influencing partners without direct authority, and improving work through feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Product marketing experience in healthcare, digital health, or another complex, evidence-based category.

  • Experience working with benefit managers, health plans, or healthcare services teams.

  • Experience enabling sales, client success, or partnership teams to drive adoption.

  • Experience translating clinical or technical information into differentiated, business-relevant positioning.

  • Experience measuring adoption and using customer feedback to improve go-to-market execution.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup - ability to innovate, and solve problems creatively

About the Role


Hinge Health is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Commercial Counsel to join our legal team. This role will focus on supporting our commercial, sales, and procurement teams, helping draft and negotiate contracts and get deals over the finish line. The Commercial Counsel will also have the opportunity to work on projects outside the commercial sphere as the need arises. This is a unique opportunity to join a small team as we grow, both as a team and a company. You’ll work closely with other lawyers on our team, as well as in close coordination with the business groups you’ll support, including access to leadership. This role provides a clear path for growth and endless opportunities to learn.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who loves to learn, is willing to roll up their sleeves and dive in and has in-house experience working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment for a recently public company. We are looking for someone with experience drafting and negotiating contracts who is also interested in pitching in in other areas, as the work allows. The ideal candidate has a base set of skills and a hunger and excitement for learning more, honing their existing skill set and growing as an attorney at Hinge Health.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Help ensure success of the commercial teams. Support Hinge Health commercial endeavors by leading contract reviews, contract negotiations, and serving as the main legal contact for the commercial team.

  • Protect the company from unnecessary risk. Spot potential issues in commercial contracts, think creatively to solve problems, and connect and collaborate with cross functional teams to move initiatives forward.

  • Manage templates and create efficiencies in our contracting process. Continuously refine templates and contract workflows, support the development of our contract management system, and provide training to our business partners.

  • Advise on healthcare regulatory matters and contract interpretation. Advise internal clients on regulatory risks as they arise, advise on healthcare and privacy regulations, and advise on and interpret contract terms.

Basic Qualifications

  • J.D. from an ABA accredited law school

  • Admitted to, and in good standing with, at least one state bar

  • 5+ years of experience, with strong experience in the drafting and negotiation of healthcare and technology contracts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Digital health experience

  • Familiarity with AI tools for legal work

  • Experience with TPA/payor contracts, healthcare contracts, referral/reseller contracts, SaaS service agreements

  • Knowledge of insurance law, privacy law, ERISA and benefits law, and/or healthcare FWA laws

  • Experience with a Contract Lifecycle Management System like Ironclad

  • Law firm experience or experience in-house at a digital health company

  • Excellent judgment and ability to balance legal risks with business strategy

  • Ability to thrive independently and manage your own time and workload in a fast-paced environment, and can handle ambiguity and shifting priorities with flexibility, patience, and humor

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The Opportunity

Join the Proactive Communications & Notifications team as we build the systems that help Hinge Health determine what message a member receives, when they receive it, and which channel is most helpful. Our work brings together distributed backend services, data flows, and machine learning and AI capabilities to make member communication more relevant, timely, and actionable.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll build and operate the backend systems that bring AI-powered product capabilities to members. You’ll partner with senior engineers, ML Scientists, Data Engineering, Product, and other software engineers to design APIs, services, workflows, and data flows that are reliable in production.

This role is a strong fit for a backend-leaning software engineer who wants to apply distributed-systems skills to AI products. You’ll help integrate, deploy, and operate models and AI services within product systems; model training and research are not the primary focus. MLOps experience is valuable, but the core expectation is strong software engineering, production execution, and operational ownership.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Learn the Proactive Communications & Notifications domain, service architecture, operational practices, and member-impact goals.

  • Ship well-scoped improvements to APIs, services, asynchronous jobs, or workflows with guidance from senior engineers.

  • Build familiarity with the team’s testing, observability, deployment, and incident-response practices; participate in on-call or incident support as appropriate.

In your first 6 months

  • Own a medium-sized feature from planning through implementation, testing, rollout, and follow-up with minimal support.

  • Integrate an ML- or AI-backed capability into a product workflow through clear interfaces, reliable data flows, and appropriate failure handling.

  • Improve the correctness and operability of distributed systems by applying patterns such as retries, idempotency, versioning, graceful degradation, dashboards, and structured logging.

In your first year

  • Deliver multiple production initiatives that improve the relevance, timeliness, reliability, or maintainability of member communications.

  • Trace and resolve issues across APIs, services, queues, databases, model-backed components, and data dependencies, raising risks and decisions early.

  • Help strengthen the team through thoughtful code reviews, design documentation, pairing, onboarding support, and contributions to engineering practices.

Who You Are

  • You are a backend-minded software engineer who enjoys building reliable systems and learning how they behave in production.

  • You can take a well-scoped problem from design through launch, break work into incremental changes, and ask for direction when complexity or ambiguity increases.

  • You demonstrate effective communication through clear design notes, concise status updates, thoughtful code reviews, and early escalation of risks.

  • You are a learn-it-all who welcomes feedback, builds depth in your primary technologies, and develops the judgment to make sound tradeoffs.

  • You practice accountability by owning the quality, reliability, and follow-through of the systems you build.

  • You lead at all levels: you are hands-on in the details, contribute to a positive team culture, and help teammates succeed through collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.

  • Experience building and operating backend services or distributed systems in production, including APIs, asynchronous processing, event-driven systems, workflows, or data-intensive services.

  • Professional experience with at least one production programming language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, or a comparable language, plus experience with software testing, observability, deployment, or production support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating ML- or AI-backed services into production products.

  • Experience with AWS or another cloud platform and technologies such as Docker, Kafka, PostgreSQL, or equivalent systems.

  • Experience with asynchronous processing, workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, or long-running state.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, service monitoring, model deployment, inference, or model versioning.

  • Experience with Temporal, Step Functions, Kubernetes, Airflow, or comparable systems.

  • Experience with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval, agents, or evaluation systems.

  • Experience working in healthcare, digital health, fintech, or another regulated or data-sensitive domain.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office, requiring in-person attendance three days per week for a full 8-hour business day. On remote days, employees are expected to work during core business hours with flexibility. The office is part of a dog-friendly workplace program.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.

With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain.

The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 60+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,800 employers.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore.

Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options, which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

The Opportunity

Join the team building the intelligence behind Hinge Health’s proactive member experience. The Proactive Communications & Notifications pod is creating the systems that determine what message a member receives, when they receive it, and which channel is most helpful. When these decisions are timely, relevant, and respectful, they can help members stay engaged with care and make progress toward better health outcomes.

As a Senior AI Engineer focused on MLOps and distributed systems, you will own the production path that turns models and AI capabilities into dependable member-facing experiences. You’ll design and operate the deployment, serving, release automation, monitoring, rollback, orchestration, and backend integration systems that make AI reliable, observable, scalable, and cost-conscious in production.

You’ll work closely with ML Scientists, Data Scientists, Data Engineering, Product, and Software Engineering. This role is a strong fit for an MLOps-oriented software engineer who brings deep backend and distributed-systems judgment. You do not need to be a research scientist or own model training strategy; your impact will come from making AI capabilities safe to ship, easy to operate, and straightforward for the team to improve.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build context on Hinge Health’s member experience, communication systems, model lifecycle, data flows, and operational requirements.

  • Establish a clear baseline for the health of key AI-backed services, including service-level objectives, deployment paths, observability, failure modes, and operational ownership.

  • Ship targeted improvements to developer experience, testing, release safety, or incident response that make the team faster and more predictable.

In your first 6 months

  • Own the design and delivery of a production MLOps or distributed-systems initiative from technical plan through rollout, measurement, and iteration.

  • Build or improve safe promotion patterns for model-backed services, including versioning, configuration, feature flags, canaries, rollback, and recovery.

  • Partner with ML Scientists and Data Engineering to define durable interfaces, data contracts, feature inputs, freshness expectations, evaluation hooks, and production-readiness criteria.

In your first year

  • Operate reliable online and batch inference capabilities that meet clear contracts for latency, availability, correctness, resiliency, observability, and cost.

  • Create reusable patterns for APIs, services, queues, durable workflows, monitoring, and incident response that help the pod integrate AI into notifications, personalization, send-time optimization, and related experiences.

  • Lead through influence by shaping technical decisions, mentoring engineers, raising the quality bar through design and code review, and connecting system reliability to outcomes such as message relevance, engagement, reduced communication fatigue, and sustained participation in care.

Who You Are

  • You are a senior software engineer with strong backend and distributed-systems experience, and you enjoy owning systems across their full lifecycle—from architecture and implementation through launch and operations.

  • You are an owner-operator who is comfortable with on-call, incident response, debugging, root-cause analysis, and the follow-through required to prevent recurring failures.

  • You are a learn-it-all who can develop enough fluency in ML systems to ask strong questions, clarify interfaces, evaluate trade-offs, and help model owners bring their work safely into production.

  • You practice effective communication: you write clear technical proposals, make risks and decisions visible, and explain complex system behavior to technical and non-technical partners.

  • You lead at all levels by staying hands-on while creating leverage through reusable patterns, thoughtful code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and practical improvements to the team’s engineering workflow.

  • You care deeply about privacy, security, auditability, and the safe handling of sensitive healthcare data.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.

  • 3+ years designing, building, and operating backend or distributed systems in production, including experience participating in on-call and incident response.

  • Demonstrated experience deploying and operating ML- or AI-backed services in production, with strong proficiency in Python and at least one production backend language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or Kotlin.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating MLOps or ML platform capabilities, such as inference pipelines, model registries, deployment automation, monitoring, evaluation integration, or automated retraining.

  • Experience with online inference, batch scoring, recommendation systems, ranking, propensity models, or send-time optimization.

  • Experience with AWS and production technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Airflow, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent systems.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running state, including Temporal, Step Functions, Cadence, or a comparable system.

  • Experience building observability for ML systems, including data quality, feature freshness, model behavior, prediction quality, latency, errors, and cost.

  • Experience partnering with ML Scientists or Data Scientists to define production interfaces and operate models without owning model research or training.

  • Experience integrating generative AI, LLMs, retrieval, agents, or model evaluation into production products.

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, fintech, or another regulated or data-sensitive domain; familiarity with PHI, HIPAA, or comparable privacy constraints.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

About the Role

Physical therapists are the backbone of the comprehensive clinical care team at Hinge Health. Hinge Health Physical Therapists utilize their clinical expertise and knowledge of pain science to deliver care for a large number of patients across the MSK spectrum, including pelvic health, via telehealth video visits and in-app messaging. We believe in providing the best patient-centered care by applying the Biopsychosocial model, evidence-informed practice, and innovative thinking with technology to help patients reduce pain and achieve meaningful outcomes. Through our technology-first platform, Hinge Health physical therapists improve the lives of many at scale. You will work with a diverse set of members within a team of high performing, inclusive clinicians.


Our physical therapists are on the bleeding edge of delivering virtual MSK care enabled by advanced technology. Come join us if you’re excited to evolve alongside the future of PT practice!

The role is called “Flex Physical Therapist” for a reason - your flexibility and resilience is critical!

  • You thrive in situations requiring you to constantly adapt and evolve. Change is not a scary word to you, and you want to continually improve yourself, your profession, and healthcare as a whole.

  • Our Flex hour model: An essential requirement of this role is maintaining availability to work between 25 and 40 hours per week, with scheduled hours determined based on business needs. You will be notified of your schedule outlook at least one month in advance and fully confirmed 2 weeks in advance. This is not a full time, part time, or PRN position - it is a Flex position where employees must be able to commit to a variable schedule.

  • You embrace technology-forward care delivery, utilizing telehealth, in-app messaging, and a variety of digital tools to serve members at significant scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Evaluate and treat patients remotely utilizing a variety of digital tools to manage care and oversee technology outputs.

  • Communicate effectively to drive member engagement and articulate clinical reasoning to drive product development.

  • Knowledgeable about biopsychosocial model, patient-centered MSK care, behavior change models, pain neuroscience education, and evidence-informed practice.

  • Provides high caliber of service resulting in high customer satisfaction and improved clinical outcomes.

  • Manages patients safely and efficiently given a large and varied caseload.

Basic Qualifications

  • You have 2-4 years of clinical physical therapy experience practicing in an orthopedics setting, evaluating and treating a variety of MSK conditions.

  • At least 1 year of in person or telehealth Pelvic Health clinical experience and completion of:

    Herman & Wallace Level 1 and/or Level 2b

    APTA CAPP-Pelvic Level 1 and/or Level 2 Pelvic Health training

    Evidence In Motion Pelvic Health I and/or II

    Herman & Wallace PRPC

    ABPTS Pelvic & Women’s Health Clinical Specialist

    Evidence in Motion Pelvic Health Specialist Certification

  • or equivalent pelvic health continuing education/certification that includes content focused on: pelvic anatomy and function, bladder and bowel dysfunction, pelvic pain, prolapse, sexual and vulvovaginal conditions, internal/external examination, clinical reasoning and referral, evidence-based exercise, manual therapy, biofeedback, relaxation, and behavioral interventions.Medical fluency in Spanish (written and verbal, to be validated during the interview process)

  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program with a Doctorate of Physical Therapy (DPT).

  • Licensed to practice Physical Therapy in at least 1 state of the United States. Ability to complete required documentation to secure additional state licenses upon receipt of offer, within a timely manner.

  • Willing to work across time zones to serve a geographically diverse member population.

  • Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials.

  • You must be able to deliver telehealth services in a private, professional space with reliable, strong internet connectivity and within the United States.

  • Able to work evenings.

  • Your current and foreseeable future state of residence is within: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands

     

  • Telehealth: Demonstrates excellent and clear decision making to evaluate, treat, and manage MSK members, including some pelvic health, utilizing a biopsychosocial model as appropriate.

  • Effective Patient Management: Manages a large and varied caseload of members safely and efficiently, utilizing a variety of digital tools to manage care and communicate effectively.

  • Effective Communication: Able to communicate effectively and clearly, both written and verbally, with members, colleagues, and other professionals.

  • Change Agility: Highly adaptable to taking on new workflows, processes and challenges within a fast-paced environment by employing critical thinking and creative problem-solving.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Able to work weekends

  • Additional certifications in orthopedics, pain science, or related specialties

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

Culture and Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Every hire at Hinge Health helps more people move beyond pain and access high-quality musculoskeletal care. As a Contract Recruiter focused on high-volume hiring, you will help us scale our talent acquisition engine by creating strong candidate pipelines, conducting thoughtful and efficient interviews, and moving qualified candidates through the hiring process with speed and care.

You will partner closely with hiring managers and the broader Talent Acquisition team to understand hiring needs, maintain healthy funnels, and deliver an inclusive, high-quality candidate experience. This is a hands-on role for a recruiter who enjoys operating at pace, managing multiple priorities, and making a measurable impact through consistent execution.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Ramp quickly on Hinge Health’s mission, recruiting processes, tools, interview philosophy, and the roles supported by the team.

  • Establish strong working relationships with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition partners through structured intake meetings, clear expectations, and proactive communication.

  • Begin partnering on a defined set of high-volume requisitions, conducting recruiter screens and interviews, and building active candidate pipelines.

  • Consistently deliver high-volume hiring outcomes by moving candidates efficiently through the funnel while balancing speed, quality, and candidate experience.

  • Build and maintain qualified pipelines through a combination of inbound review, targeted sourcing, outreach, referrals, and ongoing talent relationship management.

  • Provide a structured and compelling candidate experience through timely communication, thorough interview preparation, clear expectations, and thoughtful follow-up.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience, including experience supporting high-volume hiring.

  • Experience conducting structured recruiter screens or interviews and evaluating candidates against defined qualifications.

  • Experience building candidate pipelines, managing recruiting activity in an applicant tracking system, and maintaining accurate candidate records.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting for multiple roles or functions in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Experience using sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and applicant tracking systems such as Ashby or comparable platforms.

  • Experience working as a contract recruiter, agency recruiter, or embedded recruiting partner.

The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care. As the preferred partner to 60+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,800 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com.

About the Role

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Hinge Health, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our digital health platform. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to design, build, and maintain robust infrastructure and automation solutions that support our mission to deliver outstanding member experiences and improved health outcomes. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role where your expertise will directly influence the stability and growth of our core services, enabling Hinge Health to scale efficiently and securely.

You’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and a culture of learning. Your work will be essential in driving the evolution of our platform, supporting rapid product development, and ensuring our systems meet the highest standards of reliability and security.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Own and lead projects in your domain: turn ambiguous goals into sequenced plans, and set new projects up for success in production, including SLOs, observability, safe rollout and on-call readiness.

  • Design and maintain scalable, secure cloud infrastructure. Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and config management practices, and establish reusable patterns and standards for your domain.

  • Build self-service tooling and standardized workflows for deployment, monitoring and infrastructure management.

  • Lead incident response and participate in the on-call rotation. Drive post-incident reviews and RCAs that reduce MTTD/MTTR and prevent repeat incidents.

  • Define SLOs for the systems you own, track key reliability metrics, and use them to prioritize stability work, capacity planning and disaster recovery.

  • Partner with engineering, product and security teams on CI/CD, observability and safe launches. Author design docs and influence architectural decisions with a focus on operational excellence.

  • Evaluate and implement tools that improve reliability and developer productivity, including AI-assisted tooling used safely. Be a go-to expert in your area and bring new ideas to the roadmap.

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code review and onboarding materials, and contribute to hiring.

Basic Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform).

  • Familiarity with logging and observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, New Relic).

  • Expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, usage and implementation (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins).

  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).

  • Experience in a high-growth, fast-paced technology or healthcare environment.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a mission-driven growth marketer to become our hands-on owner of the paid search channel. Paid search is currently the largest of our digital paid media channels and a significant driver of enrollments, so your work directly ties to furthering Hinge Health’s mission to improve the lives of people suffering from chronic conditions.

You’ll join the paid media pod, the fastest-growing group of channels on the Growth team, with real autonomy to decide what the work is and how it gets done. As we launch new products, you’ll build the keyword strategy that takes Hinge Health into new categories and puts our care in front of more people who need it. The right candidate wants to go deep on one channel and loves working on both strategy and the details.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Own paid search end to end: Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, covering branded and non-branded search, Performance Max, and related formats.

  • Shape the channel strategy: Translate insights from new product launches, audience research, and company goals into channel strategy and experimentation roadmap.

  • Turn data into experiments: Find insights in the numbers and use them to design tests on messaging, ad formats, and other ad features.

  • Build optimized workflows: Create the playbooks, reporting, and automation, including AI-assisted workflows, that help the channel run smoothly, and accelerate test and learn cycles.

  • Own channel reporting: Create regular performance reporting on pacing, efficiency, and test results, and translate results into clear next steps.

  • Manage the platform relationship: Serve as our point of contact with Google account representatives, staying current on new features, betas, and policy changes that help us scale.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with the creative team on developing ad creative, with Data Science on tracking and measurement, and with the broader Growth team on how paid search fits into the overall acquisition strategy.

Who You Are

  • An owner of the channel: You own paid search end to end from the idea through strategy, execution, and optimization.

  • A data-driven experimenter: You dig into the data to find an insight, then design an experiment around it. You’re driven by curiosity and love to see which experiments work.

  • A detail-minded strategist: You are meticulous, and you own your numbers. You can also step back from the account and think about where the channel as a whole should go.

  • A Learn-it-all: You are always willing to learn and improve, whether that’s a new Google Ads feature, a new ad platform, or a better way to run your own week.

  • A mission-driven marketer: You care about making quality care easier to get, and you want your work tied to that.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience managing paid search campaigns, including hands-on Google Ads work managing bid settings, determining campaign structure, and conducting keyword research.

  • Proven track record of managing meaningful budgets and hitting acquisition growth and efficiency goals

  • Experience using Mode, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools to build reports and analyze performance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven success managing a large paid search program, with budgets of at least $3 million annually

  • Demonstrated use of Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools to build workflows that support campaign strategy and execution

  • Working knowledge of SEO and AEO and how they intersect with paid search

  • Experience running structured tests on ad copy, landing pages, and other campaign settings and translating results into action

  • Hands-on Microsoft Advertising campaign management

  • A track record of testing emerging ad formats, including ChatGPT Ads

  • Background in healthcare or another regulated industry

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office, requiring in-person attendance three days per week for a full 8-hour business day. On remote days, employees are expected to work during core business hours with flexibility. The office is part of a dog-friendly workplace program, and while travel is not regularly required, occasional off-site/on-site events may occur. Physical demands are minimal and primarily involve standard office activities such as sitting, typing, and video conferencing.

About the Role

Hinge Health is a digital health company focused on delivering evidence-based solutions for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain. By combining personalized exercise therapy with virtual care, Hinge Health helps people manage and reduce chronic pain while improving quality of life and reducing healthcare costs.

The Financial Systems team builds and operates the billing and financial infrastructure that powers how Hinge Health makes money. Our systems support the movement of revenue-critical data across products, payers, and internal financial workflows. As Hinge Health expands into new products such as HingeSelect, introduces more complex payment models, adds multi-payer integrations, and grows globally, we need engineers who can build systems that are correct, observable, secure, and resilient at scale.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is excited to work on high-impact financial systems where correctness and reliability matter. You will help design the technical foundations for billing and financial workflows, improve the traceability of money-related data, and make it easier for our product, operations, and Finance partners to deliver a seamless experience for members and customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes a systems-thinking approach to problems involving data integrity, integrations, operational workflows, and long-term maintainability. You care about the details, understand the customer impact of financial systems, and take ownership from design through production operation.

Backend engineers at Hinge Health contribute to their team’s success by architecting and implementing end-to-end solutions, well-tested and performant APIs, and durable data models. You will profile systems to stay ahead of scaling bottlenecks, participate in thoughtful and constructive code reviews, and help maintain a high engineering bar.

We practice continuous deployment and expect owner-operators to support the systems they build in production. Our production systems rely on Golang, gRPC, AWS, Postgres, Redis, and Temporal. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance posture reflects the standards required for healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects across billing and financial workflows, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Design and evolve reliable services, APIs, and data models for revenue-critical systems, including billing flows, payment-model changes, payer integrations, and financial data movement.

  • Build for correctness and traceability by establishing clear data ownership, durable workflows, idempotent processing, strong validation, and actionable audit and operational signals.

  • Break down complex, cross-functional problems into manageable tasks, enabling steady delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents and data discrepancies.

  • Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Data, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, roadmap technical strategy, and balance short-term delivery with long-term system health.

  • Improve the maintainability, availability, performance, and observability of financial systems, including developer tooling and operational runbooks.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, design feedback, and knowledge sharing.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners, and document decisions and workflows so they remain understandable as the team grows.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate engineering and operational processes and enhance product capabilities, while preserving appropriate review and control for financial workflows.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software development experience.

  • 2+ years of experience with at least one programming language.

  • 2+ years of experience across the full software development life cycle, from design through production support.

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Golang, Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, data models, and asynchronous or distributed workflows.

  • Experience working with relational databases and integrations where data integrity, failure handling, and observability are important.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building billing, payments, revenue, accounting, claims, or other financial systems.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and scalable cloud services.

  • Experience with Golang, Python, gRPC, Postgres, Redis, Temporal, AWS\

  • Experience improving data quality, operational visibility, incident response, or developer tooling for critical systems.

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers.

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design, coding assistance, or process automation.

We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to shape the systems that give Hinge Health care-team members a clear, actionable view of the people they support. Member Records is the care-team-facing context layer within CareHub: it brings together member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indications, device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions so care teams can spend less time navigating fragmented systems and more time delivering personalized care.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and adjacent engineering teams. You will turn complex healthcare workflows into reliable, intuitive experiences and lead work from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support.

This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area end to end, influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team, and raise the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of the systems and engineers around you.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-service Member Records initiatives—from discovery through production—bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs.

  • Set and advance a multi-quarter technical direction for Member Records in partnership with engineering and product leadership.

  • Establish durable technical patterns for APIs, domain models, integrations, testing, observability, and secure handling of member data.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features.

  • Raise the engineering bar through high-quality design and code reviews, pairing, mentoring, hiring participation, and coaching other engineers toward greater technical ownership.

  • Strengthen operational ownership by defining meaningful health metrics, improving incident response, and addressing root causes rather than symptoms.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree

  • 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software.

  • 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development.

  • 3+years backend experience with Node.js, service development, API design, and integration patterns.

  • 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS

  • Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization,

  • Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support.

  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices.

  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

  • A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.


What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

  • Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.

  • Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

 


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About the Role

Hinge Health recognizes the value of design. As a Staff Product Designer, you’ll join a tight-knit, collaborative team of designers who care deeply about creating cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality product experiences. Our team is at the center of solving impactful problems for millions of members and the clients, partners, and operators who help deliver their care.

In this role, you’ll help shape the future of Hinge Health’s enterprise products, with a focus on B2B web applications that support internal operations and client-facing self-service. You’ll design experiences across products such as Ops Hub and ClientHub, as well as the workflows, integrations, and applied AI capabilities that help clients, partners, and Hinge Health operators complete tasks more efficiently. Your work will reduce manual effort, improve response times, standardize outcomes, and make complex operational processes easier to understand and use.

As a Staff Product Designer, you’ll collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Customer Success, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to create intuitive, scalable solutions from concept to execution. You’ll lead through ambiguity, connect user needs with business outcomes, and bring strong craft across research, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and prototyping. You’ll also help establish the design direction for enterprise experiences that improve self-service task completion, increase automation coverage, and support client retention.

We’re looking for designers who excel at simplifying complex challenges, care deeply about the quality of their work, have a strong track record of shipping impactful experiences, bring a growth mindset, and are excited to explore how AI can improve enterprise workflows. This is a high-impact role at an especially exciting time in Hinge Health’s journey, as we build the next generation of intelligent tools and experiences for our clients, partners, and internal teams.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Shape product vision and strategy: Lead design direction across complex problem spaces, connecting user needs, business goals, and technical possibilities into a clear path forward.

  • Design efficient, AI-enabled experiences: Apply strong product design judgment to simplify complex workflows, identify high-leverage opportunities for AI and automation, and help people complete tasks faster with less manual effort.

  • Raise the quality and scalability of the product: Apply strong interaction and visual design craft, contribute to scalable patterns and systems, and help establish a consistently high bar for the team.

  • Use insight and experimentation to guide decisions: Combine research, data, prototyping, and emerging tools to explore opportunities, test ideas, and improve outcomes over time.

  • Influence through collaboration and communication: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to align on priorities, make decisions, and deliver highly effective, efficient operational experiences.

  • Grow the team and champion inclusive design: Mentor other designers, share your perspective, and ensure the experiences we create are accessible and inclusive.

Basic Qualifications

  • Design craft mastery: Expertise in interaction and visual design, with a track record of advancing the craft and inspiring excellence across teams.

  • Strategic problem-solving: Experience leading ambiguous problem spaces, setting vision, and defining design strategy across products or platforms.

  • Data-informed design: Proficient in forming hypotheses, running/facilitating user research, and leveraging data science insights to optimize experiences.

  • Influence and communication: Highly effective communicator with the ability to align teams and influence senior stakeholders around design direction.

  • Mentorship and team development: Demonstrated success mentoring designers and elevating the overall quality and impact of team output.

  • Prototyping and innovation: Deep prototyping skills with Figma and AI tools used to drive product alignment, experimentation, and innovation.

  • System-level design thinking: Expertise in scalable flows, component design, and building cohesive design systems.

  • Research synthesis and strategic insight: Fluency in synthesizing research and data, translating insights into actionable, strategic design opportunities.

  • Degree type, equivalent to a 4 year degree or Bachelors.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for complex workflows: Strong ability to simplify complexity and create clear, efficient experiences across multiple roles, systems, and edge cases.

  • Proven facilitation skills: Track record of running pillar- or org-level workshops to align cross-functional partners on large, complex initiatives and move teams toward clear decisions.

  • Executive-level influence: Skilled in facilitating executive meetings, guiding conversations, framing decisions, and ensuring proper validation and checkpoints before moving forward.

  • Motion design expertise: Solid experience using animation to communicate status, transitions, and feedback while adding clarity and delight.

  • AI prototyping and exploration: Hands-on experience using AI development tools to prototype and test ideas, along with curiosity to explore emerging tools that accelerate design exploration and elevate quality.

  • Design innovation: Excited to redefine spaces with novel and delightful ideas, drawing inspiration from unexpected sources.

  • Multi-surface product design: Proficient across desktop and mobile, delivering cohesive experiences across surfaces.

  • Passion for healthcare or fitness: Committed to helping others live healthier lives through thoughtful design and technology, with relevant industry experience.

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model (SF-Based)

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.
