Join the team transforming how health care is delivered by pairing innovative technology and connected devices with a top-notch care team. As Senior Manager, Physical Therapy, you will lead multiple Physical Therapy teams and ensure high-quality, technology-enabled care is delivered at scale.

You will translate department strategy and OKRs into clear execution plans, allocate resources across your teams, and scale operating practices that improve access, capacity, quality, clinical outcomes, employee experience, and cost. You will lead through 5–7 PT Managers, coaching them to improve performance and velocity while holding them accountable for team results, talent, execution, and responsible use of resources.

This role owns execution of the PT operating model within its remit, including workforce and capacity planning, performance management, clinical operations processes, and escalation paths. You will partner with leaders across Clinical Operations, including health coaching, dietitians, medical specialists, and care coordination, as well as adjacent cross-functional teams (Product, Commercial, Quality, L&D, etc.) to deliver programs, manage dependencies, and drive process change and continual improvement.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build trusted relationships with your team of and PTs, peer leaders, and cross-functional partners; understand team health, operating rhythms, goals, and key risks.

  • Establish a clear view of performance across your teams, including access, capacity, service levels, utilization, quality, clinical outcomes, member satisfaction, employee experience, compliance, and cost.

  • Align your teams to the PT operating plan, near-term priorities, escalation paths, and decision rights.

  • Identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve execution, manager effectiveness, and consistency across teams.

In your first 6 months

  • Translate department-level OKRs into executional plans, and make thoughtful resource allocation decisions across teams.

  • Establish consistent management systems for capacity planning, performance management, quality controls, clinical operations processes, and risk escalation.

  • Coach PT Managers to address performance gaps early, develop their teams, and deliver predictable results against agreed metrics.

  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional programs, proactively managing dependencies, stakeholder expectations, risks, and blockers.

In your first year

  • Build a strong, layered leadership team by hiring, coaching, and developing leaders; create a ready bench and act decisively when performance gaps persist.

  • Scale effective practices across the PT organization and improve the reliability, efficiency, and quality of the operating model.

  • Lead change within the PT organization and across Clinical Operations, including technology and AI adoption, while supporting teams through transitions and maintaining performance and engagement.

  • Influence leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to drive process improvements and make sound tradeoffs across quality, outcomes, employee experience, and cost.

  • Sustain a culture of accountability, learning, and high performance, including consistently strong management and engagement scores.

Who You Are

  • A healthcare operations leader who has managed leaders and has led multiple teams or program areas in a fast-moving clinical environment.

  • A strategic translator who turns department strategy into practical plans, clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution.

  • A system builder who can identify what works on one team and scale it through repeatable operating mechanisms, including capacity planning, performance management, quality controls, and escalation paths.

  • A talent developer who changes the trajectory of leaders and individual contributors through thoughtful coaching, delegation, feedback, and stretch opportunities.

  • An effective communicator who is clear, concise, and quick to respond—and who uses written updates and simple visuals to support decisions and alignment.

  • A learn-it-all who seeks diverse perspectives, challenges assumptions, and continuously improves the way work gets done.

  • A leader who demonstrates hustle and accountability by resolving dependencies, stewarding resources responsibly, meeting commitments, and addressing risks early.

  • A hands-on leader who can operate at two altitudes: offering practical guidance when teams need it while giving capable managers the autonomy to lead.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in healthcare management, care delivery operations, or a related healthcare operating environment, including experience managing managers.

  • Experience setting operational objectives and work plans, managing resources and labor costs, and using performance metrics to improve quality, outcomes, service, or employee experience.

  • Experience partnering across multiple clinical disciplines and functions, influencing other senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • Experience leading complex organizational change, including adoption of new technology, AI-enabled workflows, or operating processes within a clinical workforce.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a large (50+ clinicians), distributed, or remote clinical workforce.

  • Experience in start-up, digital health, virtual care, or a technology-enabled care model.

  • Licensed physical therapist or other relevant clinical licensure.

  • Master’s Degree in Business and/or Healthcare or related fields

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The Opportunity

In this fast paced client-facing role, you will own day-to-day relationships with our employer clients and ensure they are maximizing the benefits from the Hinge Health programs. This role demands a little bit of everything, from being a trusted adviser, project manager, product expert, coach to other team members, and more. You will be responsible for driving adoption with our clients, reporting on program value, managing escalations, expanding product offerings, and securing renewals. This is a cross-functional role that partners with Growth, Sales, Data, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Clinical to provide excellent service for our clients. The ideal candidate will also help contribute to best practices and be open to evolving responsibilities as our team grows.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Driving revenue: Secure best-practice enrollment communications campaigns aimed at achieving annual enrollment goals for your clients.

  • Long-term client management: Ensure 100% client retention with high client satisfaction (9/10+ NPS scores).

  • Customer advocacy: Turn clients into advocates to fulfill sales references and Marketing/PR requests.

  • Product expansion: Ensure your clients are offering Hinge Health’s full suite of products to maximize member impact.

Who You Are

The ideal candidate will have 2 or more years of experience in client success management. Startup experience is a plus, but not a must. They are excellent at project management, building relationships at all levels, managing the demands of a full book-of-business consisting of employer clients, and an expert of communicating effectively with internal and external stakeholders, (e.g. clients, consultants, health plans, cross-functional partners, etc). We are looking for an individual who can effectively balance their client needs with internal resources to drive high customer retention and satisfaction year after year.

Basic Qualifications

  • Project Management: 2+ years of experience effectively managing a large book of business in various stages of account lifecycle and effectively to use tools and resources to monitor deadlines and deliverables.

  • Data storytelling: Able to craft a compelling story using data-driven insights to make recommendations to influence customer decisions.

  • Product Knowledge: Subject matter expert on our product, knowing the specifics and functionalities, and understanding common use cases and best practices. Able to confidently answer questions and present solutions to clients.

  • Strategic influence: Able to effectively navigate the complexities of a book of business with clients in multiple stages of their lifecycle. Gain insight into client culture, priorities, and goals. Effectively convey client needs internally, driving the resources needed for successful client relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a high-growth company and understand the associated challenges

  • Have an understanding of employee benefits, digital health, and the startup work environment

  • Data integration proficiency, advanced Excel knowledge and skills

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

About the Role

Are you energized by turning data into strategy, building reporting that executive leadership relies on, and shaping decisions at the highest levels of a growing public company? This role pairs the foundations of FP&A (month-end close, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation) with forward-looking analysis that helps R&D and the broader company determine where to invest and how to scale. You'll be a key contributor to Strategic Finance, trusted partner to business leaders, a thought partner on high-visibility strategic work, and a key contributor to the consolidation and corporate forecasting that tell the story of the whole company.

Why Hinge Health? We're revolutionizing how healthcare gets done, and our B2B2C model gives you a front-row seat to big challenges and even bigger opportunities. As a public company, we operate with rigor and urgency, and your insight will be central to how we keep growing efficiently.

What You'll Do

- Partner with R&D: Drive budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for R&D. Work with functional leaders to understand what's driving spend and translate it into clear, decision-ready insights.

- Drive Strategic Analysis: Support and advise on our most important strategic questions around R&D, hardware and AI evolution, including unit economics, return on investment, and how we deploy capital across new and existing product lines. Build models that reveal data trends; turning ambiguity into recommendations.

- Infrastructure Optimization: Translate complex software contract terms into clear financial forecasts collaborating cross-functionally with Procurement and Accounting teams to ensure comprehensive, accurate financial reporting and also, delivering on the forward-looking infrastructure ROI framework.

- Lead the financial evaluation of new business verticals and the creation of business cases to justify strategic projects, ensuring alignment with company growth goals

- Consolidation and Corporate Forecasting: Support the team's financial consolidation, corporate forecast, systems, and reporting work, and serve as a supporting partner during peak periods like quarter-end close, budget, and re-forecast. Work closely with Accounting to ensure accurate, timely data flow and tie-out between the actuals and the forecast.

- Reinvent Reporting: Automate and improve the reports and dashboards leadership depends on, and help keep our planning and consolidation systems (e.g., Adaptive) running smoothly and continuously improving.

- Lead with AI: Use AI to supercharge our financial analytics, dashboard reporting and workflows, and bring fresh ideas for making the team faster and sharper.

- Challenge the Status Quo: Don't just crunch numbers. Question the process, think boldly, and help turn financial analysis into action.

- Collaborate and Conquer: We value people who are low-ego, solution-oriented, and energized by partnering across teams.

- Own Your Impact: You'll have real autonomy and responsibility. We'll trust you to lead workstreams and deliver results, even with lean resources.

What We're Looking For

- 7+ years of experience in strategic finance, equity research, investment banking, business operations, or a related analytical role, ideally with some time in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

- Demonstrated ability to evaluate and advise on strategic investments and business cases using and building analyses around ROI, unit economics, and margin or cash flow impact

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize and present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences and to influence senior stakeholders

- Strong command of corporate finance principles, with experience in monthly close, budget versus actual analysis, financial modeling, and sensitivity and scenario analysis

- Solid business acumen; with prior experience working in a high-scaling software or healthcare company

- Ability to navigate complex business decisions through excellent stakeholder management and seamless cross-functional collaboration

- Familiarity with financial planning and consolidation systems (e.g., Adaptive, Workday)

- Advanced AI proficiency with tools such as Claude, Open AI and Glean, and financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets

- Organized, detail-oriented, and intellectually curious, and comfortable working through ambiguity independently

- Located in the San Francisco Bay Area and excited to be in the office three days per week

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience partnering with R&D, engineering, product, or other functional organizations, especially in high-growth tech, healthcare, software or hardware businesses

- Experience with financial consolidation and corporate forecasting, or the demonstrated ability to learn them quickly

- Solid accounting knowledge (how the three financial statements connect, the close process, GAAP vs. non-GAAP)

- Hands-on experience administering or building in Adaptive or a similar planning tool

- Experience with Mode Analytics and SQL

- Passion for using AI to improve team efficiency

- High interpersonal intelligence, including strong listening skills and the potential to influence

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals to join our Commercial Team as an individual contributor selling into the employer benefit space within a defined territory. The open territory consists of Rocky Mountain: MT, ID,NV,AZ,UT,WY,CO,ND,SD,NE,KS,OK,NM. You must reside in this territory to be considered. You’ll have a unique opportunity to shape Hinge Health’s growth and product. You’ll be involved in every aspect of our commercial process: sourcing & developing leads, driving customers to close and managing relationships with our mid market customers (2,000-7,500 lives). You'll have visibility into the entire company, work side-by-side with our co-founders and product team, and lead commercial strategy sessions.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Work individually, and with Partnerships & Marketing to develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of self-insured employer clients ranging from 2,000-7,500 lives in your region.

  • Independently take deals from initial to conversation to close (both up-sell current clients and sell net-new business).

  • Collaborate with legal on contract negotiation & signature

  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure successful implementation of our program, as well as renewals / upsells.

  • Contribute to product roadmap by feeding back the customer's voice

Basic Qualifications

  • You must reside in this territory to be considered.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 5 years work experience.

  • Background in employer sales, with a history of closing small and mid-large, complex deals with a long sales-cycle.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup - ability to innovate, and solve problems creatively

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

Culture and Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

The Revenue Operations and Strategy team’s mission is to ensure Hinge Health gets reimbursed for the services we provide, while also leveraging our financial operations expertise to lead and enable strategic decisions and initiatives across the organization. We’re looking for an ambitious and energetic individual to support both our Billing and Commercial Enablement function, who will play an instrumental role in supporting internal Commercial stakeholders for both revenue generation and retention motions, while also ensuring that we are billing accurately and reimbursed in a timely fashion from clients, payers and health plans.

We are looking for someone with at least 1 year of professional experience, preferably in the consulting, startup, or healthcare fields, who is interested in understanding the mechanics of healthcare reimbursement, financial metrics, and go-to-market motions/support. They will work cross-functionally to strategize, create, and implement processes and procedures that not only impact key financial metrics, but also improve company efficiency and scalability as we continue to be a high-growth company. We are looking for someone who can wear multiple hats, is a self-starter, and is passionate about improving the financial health of the HH revenue cycle and business as a whole.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Support the growth of general claim and invoice billing practices from pre-submission to post-submission, including ensuring all claims and invoice clients are charged accurately

  • Ensure new clients are set-up for claim submission and HH is able to receive remittances electronically

  • Support the entire life-cycle of billing for a new client, including: taking part in external calls with carriers, monitoring initial claim processing, eventually turning a new client onto daily automated claims, and reporting on the reimbursement of that specific new account

  • Assist in recurring, monthly and quarterly, billing and collections processes such as invoice billing, claims partner set up and implementation/submission, cash collections, and ad-hoc accounting and revenue reporting support

  • Update and refresh reporting for revenue cycle KPIs, including but not limited to: claim denials, claim write-offs, time to cash, partner commissions etc.

  • Ability to identify revenue cycle process breakdowns and apply knowledge to propose & develop potential solutions

  • Communicate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Partnerships, and Engineering teams to support client and partner financial reporting needs and promote revenue retention

    • Participate in external calls assisting sales pitches and explaining key financial- and business-specific concepts to our valued clients/partners

    • Participate in internal solutioning and educational calls to ensure HH Commercial teams are adequately prepared to answer financial questions

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

Basic Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of professional experience, preferably in the startup, consulting, and/or healthcare fields

  • 1+ year experience with Excel in professional setting

  • Experience working cross-functionally with different teams

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup

Preferred Qualifications

  • Efficient written and verbal communication skills

  • Attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills

  • Experience in revenue cycle management

  • Experience project managing of internal projects

  • Finance and accounting experience is a plus, but not required

What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months

In your first 6-12 months, our perfect candidate will have a robust understanding of Hinge Health’s pricing and billing models and motions, along with the ability to operationalize the billing and collections processes that enable us to get paid for the services we provide. Mastery of our internal operations will also need to be applied to commercially sensitive situations such as net new client/partner deal generation and retention efforts.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced sales professional to join our Commercial Team as an individual contributor selling into the employer benefit space within a defined territory. The open territory consists of Rocky Mountain. You’ll have a unique opportunity to shape Hinge Health’s growth and product. You’ll be involved in every aspect of our commercial process: sourcing & developing leads, driving customers to close and managing relationships with our SMB market customers ( under 2,000 lives). You'll have visibility into the entire company, work side-by-side with our leadership, product team, and lead commercial strategy sessions.

WHAT YOU’ LL ACCOMPLISH

  • Work individually, and with Partnerships & Marketing to develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of self-insured employer clients under 2,000 lives in your region.

  • Independently take deals from initial conversation to close.

  • Collaborate with legal on contract negotiation & signature

  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure successful implementation of our program, as well as renewals / upsells.

  • Contribute to product roadmap by feeding back the customer's voice

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • You must reside in the open territory to be considered.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 3 years of work experience.

  • Background in employer sales, with a history of closing large, complex deals with a long sales-cycle.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

  • Excellent project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup - ability to innovate, and solve problems creatively

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members

  • Have a sense of humor and like to have fun. We work hard, but we laugh a lot too.

BONUS POINTS (IF APPLICABLE)

  • Startup experience

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development budget, use the mental health to support therapy costs, and lifestyle stipends to cover your favorite wellness services, and work-from-home equipment.

  • Flexible vacation and paid time off: Employees have flexibility to choose when, how, and why they take time off to rest and recharge. Exempt employees can take advantage of our flexible pto program. Nonexempt employees can utilize up to two weeks of sick time and up to 17 days of vacation per year, including mental health days.

  • In Office Perks: Daily lunch, coffee/tea and office snacks, and weekly social hours.

  • Other compensation: At Hinge Health, we want every employee to be invested and rewarded in the future success of the company. All full-time positions are eligible for equity.

We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals to join our Commercial Team as an individual contributor selling into the employer benefit space within a defined territory. The open territory consists of Mid-Atlantic: KY,WV,MD,VA,NC,SC & DC. You must reside in this territory to be considered. You’ll have a unique opportunity to shape Hinge Health’s growth and product. You’ll be involved in every aspect of our commercial process: sourcing & developing leads, driving customers to close and managing relationships with our mid market customers (2,000-7,500 lives). You'll have visibility into the entire company, work side-by-side with our co-founders and product team, and lead commercial strategy sessions.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Work individually, and with Partnerships & Marketing to develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of self-insured employer clients ranging from 2,000-7,500 lives in your region.

  • Independently take deals from initial to conversation to close (both up-sell current clients and sell net-new business).

  • Collaborate with legal on contract negotiation & signature

  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure successful implementation of our program, as well as renewals / upsells.

  • Contribute to product roadmap by feeding back the customer's voice

Basic Qualifications

  • You must reside in this territory to be considered.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 5 years work experience.

  • Background in employer sales, with a history of closing small and mid-large, complex deals with a long sales-cycle.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup - ability to innovate, and solve problems creatively

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

About the role

Hinge Health is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in the development and sustaining work for our hardware products.

As a junior-to-mid-level engineer, you will work on diverse projects, driving board-level designs for highly integrated medical devices from schematic to layout to assembly. You will work cross-functionally with firmware, mechanical, and manufacturing teams to bring products from concept through production. You will also work on sustaining engineering to support the continuing success of our products post-launch.

The ideal candidate is excited about solving real problems with hardware – your work will have a direct impact on reducing pain and improving the lives of our millions of members. In joining our HW group within the broader R&D organization, you will be part of a highly capable, motivated, small team where your contributions and ideas truly matter.

Help develop the electrical systems behind Hinge Health’s connected hardware products. As an Electrical Engineer on the Hardware Engineering team, you’ll contribute to board-level designs from early exploration through production, working closely with firmware, mechanical, and manufacturing partners. Your work will help bring reliable medical devices to members working to reduce pain and improve their lives.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build an understanding of our hardware products, electrical design practices, product development process, and manufacturing needs

  • Contribute to embedded-system electrical design, including component selection, schematic capture, and PCB layout

In your first 6 months

  • Partner with mechanical, firmware, and senior electrical engineers on system architecture and integration

  • Take part in prototyping, detailed design, testing, and preparation for production

  • Document design decisions and test results to support product quality and applicable medical-device requirements

In your first year

  • Drive board-level design work across product development, from exploration and prototyping through verification and production ramp

  • Support manufacturing and sustaining engineering through test or process development, design-for-manufacturing improvements, and component-level failure analysis

  • Help sustain products after launch and identify design changes that can improve cost or manufacturability

Who You Are

  • You are a hands-on electrical engineer who enjoys turning product needs into reliable embedded hardware

  • You bring a Learn-it-all mindset, seek feedback, and keep building your technical knowledge

  • You take accountability for your work, communicate progress and risks, and follow through on commitments

  • You work well across disciplines and are motivated by the impact thoughtful hardware can have on people’s lives

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional experience in hardware development or embedded-systems design

  • Experience with schematic capture and PCB layout for multilayer boards, including hands-on board bring-up, debugging, and rework on high-density designs

  • Experience designing microcontroller-based systems (such as ARM Cortex-M or MSP430) and using standard digital interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, or USB; proficiency with common lab equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power supplies, and soldering or hot-air rework equipment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Altium Designer

  • Experience with battery management, Bluetooth Low Energy, high-voltage circuits, or analog design

  • Experience developing medical devices or products in another regulated industry, such as aerospace or automotive

  • Familiarity with EMI/EMC practices and certification processes such as FCC, CE, or UL

  • Basic proficiency in Python for test automation or C/C++ for firmware changes that support bring-up and testing

  • Experience transitioning designs to manufacturing and applying design-for-manufacturing practices

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.

Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI), and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus support for gender-affirming care, family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursement when healthcare isn’t available where you live

  • Planning for the future: Traditional or Roth 401(k) options with a 2% company match

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

  • Grow with us: Discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we use your personal data as outlined in our personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

Senior Software Engineer, App Enablement

The Opportunity

Hinge Health’s mobile app reaches members through a production system spanning code integration, mobile builds, release candidates, app-store submission, and phased rollout. App Enablement helps mobile engineering teams ship dependable changes and build on a reliable, shared mobile platform. The team owns both the path from code merge through app-store release and the platform capabilities that help product teams build efficiently and consistently.

As a Senior Software Engineer on App Enablement, you’ll contribute across mobile release operations and platform engineering, with your focus shifting between them as team priorities change. You might improve build, CI, release, and rollout systems, then build or maintain shared mobile-platform capabilities such as the mobile-specific API layer that shapes backend data for the app, server-driven UI, navigation, deep links, and reusable media components. We’re looking for engineers with depth in one area who can partner across the other and are willing to learn into adjacent work. You’ll collaborate with engineering, Quality Engineering, release partners, and product teams. This is a hands-on role with broad impact across the mobile organization.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Design, build, and maintain tooling for mobile builds, release candidates, app-store submissions, and phased rollouts.

  • Build and evolve shared mobile-platform capabilities, including the mobile-specific API layer that shapes backend data for the app, server-driven UI, navigation, deep links, and reusable media components, in partnership with product pods.

  • Improve the reliability, speed, and observability of mobile CI and release pipelines; investigate recurring failures and reduce manual toil with durable fixes.

  • Coordinate release readiness, blocker triage, communication, and resolution with the teams responsible for affected changes.

  • Improve dependency management and mobile code-quality practices, including responses to security updates and iOS and Android ecosystem changes.

  • Reduce friction for feature teams with practical developer tools, documentation, and guidance, while respecting Quality Engineering’s ownership of test automation and sign-off.

  • Define and improve release-readiness checks, staged-rollout safeguards, monitoring, and rollback practices so teams can detect and respond to release risk.

  • Measure pipeline and release performance, identify recurring bottlenecks, and use evidence to prioritize improvements and communicate impact.

  • Balance delivery speed, release safety, maintainability, and compliance; mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and shared operational practices.

Who You Are

  • Effective communication: You communicate clearly and early, raise risks with context, and help teams make decisions and move work forward.

  • Learn-it-all: You are curious about unfamiliar systems and open to feedback; you use incidents, metrics, and reviews to improve your approach. You thoughtfully evaluate approved AI-assisted tools and validate generated changes with tests and running software.

  • Hustle: You act with urgency and creativity on release and reliability problems while applying sound judgment and preserving release safety.

  • Accountability: You own commitments and outcomes from investigation through rollout and follow-up, communicate gaps promptly, and close the loop.

  • Lead at all levels: You are hands-on and proactive, see gaps, propose practical direction, and help peers improve through reviews and design discussions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.

  • Experience building and operating production software, including hands-on delivery from investigation through rollout and use of sound testing, debugging, and code-review practices.

  • Experience in mobile application or platform engineering, or mobile build and release systems, with a working understanding of the iOS and Android delivery lifecycle and willingness to contribute across both areas.

  • Experience improving CI/CD or developer tooling through automation, observability, or systematic problem-solving.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting React Native or another cross-platform mobile application alongside native iOS or Android build workflows.

  • Experience designing or maintaining shared mobile-platform capabilities, such as mobile-specific APIs that shape backend data for the app, server-driven UI, navigation, deep links, or reusable media components.

  • Familiarity with mobile build services such as Bitrise or similar tools, source-control automation, app signing, and app-store release management.

  • Experience diagnosing intermittent or recurring mobile CI failures and improving build pipeline reliability or speed.

  • Experience with dependency-update automation, mobile security updates, platform-policy changes, or release-compliance preparation.

  • Experience designing release-readiness checks, staged rollouts, health monitoring, or rollback workflows.

  • Experience measuring pipeline performance and reliability, then using the evidence to prioritize improvements.

  • Experience coordinating releases across mobile engineering, Quality Engineering, product teams, and platform partners.

  • Experience mentoring engineers through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, or shared operational practices.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We’ve noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We’ll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use “@hingehealth.com” emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

Sr. SWE - Search

The Opportunity

Imagine you're a patient in pain, searching for the right provider who accepts your insurance, is close to home, and specializes in your condition. Now imagine getting it wrong—waiting weeks for an appointment only to discover they can't help you. This role exists to eliminate that frustration.

You'll build the search infrastructure and entity resolution systems that power Hinge Select—our integration of digital and in-person MSK care. As an early team member, you'll architect geospatial search capabilities that help millions of people find the right care, fast. You'll work at the intersection of search infrastructure, data quality, and healthcare—where precision isn't just nice to have, it has real patient impact.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Audit our current provider and facility discovery architecture, identifying gaps in geospatial search precision and entity resolution accuracy

  • Build relationships with product, design, and data engineering teams to understand upstream data sources and downstream user needs

  • Deliver your first search optimization—improving relevance tuning or query performance for a high-traffic lookup scenario

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Design and launch geospatial search capabilities using Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (radius, bounding-box, polygon-based queries) that scale to millions of records

  • Extend entity resolution pipelines to deduplicate and reconcile provider data across multiple upstream sources, reducing duplicate records by 30%+

  • Own the async data ingestion pipeline for a critical data source, ensuring search indexes stay fresh and accurate

In your first year, you will:

  • Act as the code repository maintainer for the search and knowledge graph services, setting technical standards and mentoring junior engineers

  • Drive technical strategy for the team, balancing tradeoffs between search relevance, latency, and infrastructure cost

  • Integrate AI technologies to automate entity matching and improve search personalization, embodying our "Learn-it-all" principle by experimenting with novel approaches

Who You Are

  • A Learn-it-all: You don't have all the answers, but you thrive on solving novel problems—whether that's tuning geospatial queries or debugging cross-source data quality issues. You actively seek feedback and mentor others through thoughtful code reviews.

  • A Builder with Impact: You understand that getting entity resolution wrong has real consequences for patients. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, knowing when to ship fast and when to invest in long-term scalability.

  • A Clear Communicator: You can explain complex technical concepts—like spatial indexing or fuzzy matching algorithms—to non-technical partners in product and design. You document your decisions clearly, making it easy for teammates to understand your work.

  • Collaborative and Accountable: You thrive in cross-functional environments, working across product, data engineering, and operations teams. You take ownership of your code in production and respond thoughtfully to incidents.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software development experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, including index design, mapping configuration, query DSL, and relevance tuning

  • Strong understanding of geospatial search (geo_point/geo_shape types, distance-based queries, bounding box filters) and entity resolution (matching, merging, and deduplicating records across disparate data sources)

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Golang, Python, Java, or similar) and cloud-based services (gRPC, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS)

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience building search-driven discovery products (provider directories, marketplace search, location finders)

  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards (NPI, FHIR) and identifiers

  • Experience with spatial indexing libraries (PostGIS, H3, S2 geometry, Solr spatial)

  • Background in record linkage and fuzzy matching techniques (Jaro-Winkler, Levenshtein, probabilistic matching)

  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions) for data pipelines

  • Exposure to gRPC service architectures and distributed systems

  • Experience in healthcare technology or regulated environments

  • AI technology experience for software design and coding

  • Mentoring or onboarding junior engineers

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

 

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

About the role

Join Hinge Health’s Hardware Engineering team to build the firmware behind next-generation, highly integrated medical devices. Your work will help bring products from concept through production and support technology designed to reduce pain and improve the lives of our members.

As a senior engineer, you’ll own a substantial firmware scope end to end, make technical decisions across prototyping, design, testing, and production, and work closely with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, product, and design partners. You’ll help shape system architecture, strengthen the team’s engineering practices, and contribute to a small, capable group where ideas and ownership matter.

The ideal candidate is excited about solving real problems with hardware – your work will have a direct impact on reducing pain and improving the lives of our millions of members. In joining our HW group within the broader R&D organization, you will be part of a highly capable, motivated, small team where your contributions and ideas truly matter.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Learn the product architecture, firmware codebase, development workflows, and quality documentation practices

  • Partner with engineering and product peers to understand system requirements, design trade-offs, and integration needs

  • Take ownership of a defined firmware feature or subsystem and establish an implementation and test plan

In your first 6 months

  • Design, implement, and test firmware for your scope, building maintainable and testable embedded software

  • Integrate firmware with electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing systems; investigate issues across hardware and software boundaries

  • Improve embedded build and test automation and support clear documentation for quality and regulatory needs

In your first year

  • Lead a complex firmware scope or project from concept through development, integration, and production readiness

  • Guide system architecture and technical trade-offs through prototyping, detailed design, testing, and production ramp

  • Raise the bar through design and code reviews, mentoring, and reliable engineering practices

Who You Are

  • You take ownership of complex technical work and can move between system-level decisions and implementation details

  • You work collaboratively across disciplines, communicate trade-offs clearly, and welcome feedback in design and code reviews

  • You approach quality methodically, balancing development speed with robust testing and clear documentation

  • You enjoy mentoring other engineers and helping a small team deliver dependable products

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional firmware or embedded software experience writing code for consumer electronics, medical devices, or other highly integrated embedded hardware

  • Strong experience with C in embedded systems, RTOS-based system architecture (such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS), low-level drivers, and hardware communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, or UART

  • Experience owning firmware for a project or subsystem from design through production, including technical planning, Python-based testing or automation, version control and embedded debugging workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing medical devices or working in another highly regulated industry, such as aerospace or automotive

  • Experience using AI tools to develop firmware, including copilot or agentic workflows

  • Experience with Nordic nRF5x SoCs and the Nordic Connect SDK

  • Experience developing with Bluetooth Low Energy

  • Experience designing bootloaders, firmware updates, or memory maps

  • Experience building embedded CI pipelines and automated hardware-in-the-loop testing

  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI), and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401(k) retirement plan options, which include a 2% company match

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

  • Grow with us: Access discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we use your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals to join our Commercial Team as an individual contributor selling into the employer benefit space within a defined territory. The open territory consists of the Southeast. You must reside in this territory to be considered. You’ll have a unique opportunity to shape Hinge Health’s growth and product. You’ll be involved in every aspect of our commercial process: sourcing & developing leads, driving customers to close and managing relationships with our mid market customers (2,000-7,500 lives). You'll have visibility into the entire company, work side-by-side with our co-founders and product team, and lead commercial strategy sessions.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Work individually, and with Partnerships & Marketing to develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of self-insured employer clients ranging from 2,000-7,500 lives in your region.

  • Independently take deals from initial to conversation to close (both up-sell current clients and sell net-new business).

  • Collaborate with legal on contract negotiation & signature

  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure successful implementation of our program, as well as renewals / upsells.

  • Contribute to product roadmap by feeding back the customer's voice

Basic Qualifications

  • You must reside in the Southeast territory to be considered.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 5 years work experience.

  • Background in employer sales, with a history of closing small and mid-large, complex deals with a long sales-cycle.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup - ability to innovate, and solve problems creatively

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

About the Role

Hinge Health is changing how health care is delivered with its technology-led model, integrating AI, a complete care team, with connected hardware and a high performance in person care network. As Head of Operations, Care Delivery, you will lead the Physical Therapy organization and be accountable for its health, capacity, quality of service delivery, talent, and financial performance.

You will translate company and clinical strategy into 6-12+ month operating plans, allocate resources across PT teams, and build the systems that let the function deliver predictably at scale. You will lead through a management team of Senior PT Managers and PT Managers/Leads, and you will hold them accountable for team performance, quality, talent, and execution.

Reporting to the SVP Clinical Operations, you will own the PT operating model end to end and ensure constant alignment to the Product vision and strategy. You will also partner with your peers across Clinical Operations (health coaching, dietitians, medical specialists, and care coordination) and other Operations functions to optimize the broader care portfolio. Together you will coordinate simultaneous efforts that shift department-level KPIs.

What you'll accomplish

Own the PT operating plan, headcount, and budget

  • Independently own the full PT operating plan, headcount plan, hiring priorities, and labor budget.

  • Set the PT org OKRs so they ladder up to company and department goals; translate them into half-year plans, quarterly priorities, and resource allocation decisions across all PT teams and operating programs.

  • Own all administrative and operational decisions within the PT function, within company policy, agreed remit authority and clinical governance.

Set and deliver function-level strategy and outcomes

  • Develop and execute on a clear point of view for where the PT org should go and what it should deliver for members and the business.

  • Identify the biggest opportunities to improve access, capacity, quality, clinical outcomes, and cost. Drive them from idea to results. Make the business case for tools, technology, and resources required.

  • Fully own performance for the entire scope of PT operations; including but not limited to access, capacity, quality, clinical outcomes, compliance, employee experience, and cost.

  • Design and own the PT operating model, including workforce planning and staffing aligned to product vision, performance management, clinical operations processes, and escalation paths.

  • Act as the quality guardian for the function: ensure operations and service delivery meets company standards for compliance, reliability, and performance without needing outside audit or intervention.

  • Proactively identify structural impediments (process bottlenecks, policy gaps, tooling limits) that prevent the function from scaling and performing reliably; drive the fix.

Build the leadership bench and the organization

  • Lead the PT leadership bench, succession planning, and ongoing organization design.

  • Develop leaders through coaching, delegation, and stretch opportunities, and act quickly where performance gaps exist

  • Maintain a current read on talent density across the organization, and pressure-test the leadership team so that no pockets of low performance go undetected.

  • Set the tone for a high-trust, high-accountability culture and drive strong employee engagement.

Lead change and cross-functional impact

  • Drive technology and AI adoption and change management across the PT organization.

  • Partner with peer leaders across Clinical Operations disciplines to find and pursue opportunities that optimize the broader portfolio.

  • Influence peers, Directors, and senior executives to drive change, bringing a recommendation and the data behind it. Provide regular strategic updates to executive leadership.

Who you Are

  • Strategic thinking, planning, and execution of finance and resource management: Shapes and operationalizes strategy through rigorous prioritization, process improvement, and strong implementation by teams. Forms an independent point of view on where the function should go, identifies the biggest opportunities, and turns them into prioritized plans. Sets ambitious goals and OKRs aligned to company priorities. Delivers a portfolio of work that measurably moves department-level KPIs. Balances strategic oversight with knowing when to dive into the details. Owns planning and management of labor budget, makes investment and resourcing decisions, and aligns resources to strategic priorities.

  • Leadership and talent development: Builds and strengthens the leadership bench, leads succession planning, and sustains high engagement and management effectiveness scores. Inspects the work, identifies systemic issues individual teams cannot see, grows the capability of leaders to do the same, and acts decisively on performance.

  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management: Builds trusted relationships at every level, navigates and resolves conflicts across teams, and leads cross-functional initiatives. Makes governance-level decisions, obtaining Executive alignment as needed. Speaks up with a clear position and commits fully once a decision is made. Initiates cross-functional efforts. Secures the tools and resources the function needs from teams they don’t manage.

  • Change management: Identifies where change is needed and champions innovation, scale, and organizational change across multiple teams and has a track record as a change leader.

  • Communicates effectively: Translates company strategy into clear context for managers and frontline teams so that the "why" reaches the front line. Keeps messaging consistent across parallel efforts. Communicates a clear point of view to executives and leadership peers.

  • Accountability and Hustle: Owns results and surfaces risks early with proposed mitigations. Holds leaders accountable to ambitious goals and to quality standards. Removes bottlenecks that span teams and keeps initiatives moving.

Basic Qualifications

  • A senior healthcare operations leader who has directed a large, multi-team clinical or service delivery function and managed through layered leadership structure (manager of leaders). At least 5+ years leading a multi-layer organization, with people managers as direct reports and total org size of 200+ headcount.

  • Demonstrated evidence of continually meeting and exceeding targets. Has owned an operating plan, headcount plan, and labor budget and made final operational and organizational decisions with real accountability for outcomes.

  • Builds systems rather than relying on heroics: workforce and capacity planning, performance management, escalation paths, and quality controls that scale

  • Has built a leadership bench, run succession planning, and designed organizations through growth and change

  • Thrives in high ambiguity and fast change, makes sound trade-offs, and escalates appropriately. Has a relentless resourcefulness and bias for action when facing unfamiliar or poorly defined problems.

  • Communicates with clarity to clinicians, executives, and cross-functional partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • Doctorate in Physical Therapy (DPT) or other relevant clinical licensure

  • Experience in digital health, virtual care, or leading clinicians in a remote, distributed environment

  • Experience leading large-scale technology or AI adoption within a clinical workforce

The Opportunity

Bring your clinical expertise to a technology-enabled orthopedic care model that helps members reduce pain, maximize movement, and achieve meaningful clinical outcomes.

As an Advanced Practice Provider (APP) at Hinge Health, you’ll be an essential part of our comprehensive clinical care team, using your expertise in orthopedic and musculoskeletal (MSK) care to virtually evaluate and treat adults with painful MSK conditions. Through video visits, in-app messaging, and digital tools, you’ll deliver patient-centered, evidence-informed care grounded in the biopsychosocial model, develop individualized treatment plans, and help members make informed decisions about their care.

You’ll provide clinical care through HingeSelect, a first-of-its-kind integrated care program, and support members in our digital Hinge Health care programs. You’ll guide members through conservative and surgical treatment options and recommend appropriate next steps across the broader continuum of care. Working alongside physicians, physical therapists, coaches, and care coordinators, you’ll contribute your clinical expertise to a comprehensive approach to treatment. As new partnerships, care pathways, and product capabilities evolve, you’ll use your clinical insights to inform product development and help shape the future of technology-enabled orthopedic care.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Learn Hinge Health’s virtual care workflows, clinical guidelines, technology, and care pathways.

  • Begin delivering comprehensive, evidence-informed virtual orthopedic evaluations and individualized care plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with members and care-team partners through clear communication, empathy, and reliable follow-through.

In your first 6 months

  • Independently conduct comprehensive virtual orthopedic evaluations, interpret clinical information, and develop individualized care plans informed by the biopsychosocial model and lifestyle medicine.

  • Engage members in shared decision-making by explaining findings, discussing appropriate conservative and surgical options, and outlining risks, benefits, and next steps.

  • Coordinate with physicians, physical therapists, and Care Coordinators to connect recommendations to referrals, provider access, scheduling, and follow-up across in-person care.

In your first year

  • Manage a large, varied caseload safely and efficiently, supporting member satisfaction, care-plan follow-through, clinical outcomes, and a connected care experience.

  • Share clinical insights that inform product development and help improve technology-enabled orthopedic care across HingeSelect and the broader Hinge Health care model.

Who You Are

  • You bring sound clinical judgment and orthopedic or musculoskeletal expertise to virtual evaluation, treatment, and care management, adapting as evidence, feedback, workflows, technology, and care pathways evolve.

  • You communicate clearly with members, physicians, and care-team partners. You explain pain science and complex clinical information in practical terms, helping members make informed decisions about conservative and surgical options. You build trust through empathy, curiosity, respect, attentive listening, and shared decision-making.

  • You are organized, adaptable, accountable, and resourceful. You prioritize competing clinical needs, maintain thorough documentation and follow-through in a virtual care environment, honor commitments, and respond constructively to change.

  • You lead at all levels by contributing your expertise, influencing care-team decisions, and finding thoughtful ways to improve care quality, operations, the member experience, and how virtual care is delivered.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of clinical experience caring for adults with orthopedic, musculoskeletal, or closely related conditions.

  • Nurse Practitioner: Graduate of an accredited nurse practitioner education program. Current board certification as a Nurse Practitioner with a primary certification appropriate to the specialty, such as FNP or AGNP.

  • Physician Assistant/Physician Associate: Graduate of an ARC-PA-accredited physician assistant program. Current NCCPA certification allows use of the PA-C designation.

  • Active, unrestricted NP or PA licensure in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to obtain additional required state licenses within a reasonable timeframe.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently interpret orthopedic imaging, including X-rays, MRI, and CT, and prescribe medications within scope of practice.

  • Willingness to work across time zones to serve a geographically diverse member population, including evenings and weekends as needed.

  • Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials.

  • You must be able to deliver telehealth services in a private, professional space with reliable, strong internet connectivity and within the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • NP: ONP-C certification.

  • PA: CAQ in Orthopedics or a related specialty.

  • Medical fluency in Spanish, written and verbal.

  • Knowledge of lifestyle medicine.

  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, or hybrid care delivery.

  • Located in the Eastern or Central time zone, or able to cover core virtual clinic hours.

Remote Role Expectations

This is a remote role supporting members across the United States. You must be able to provide care from a private, professional workspace with reliable internet connectivity and maintain the licensure required for the members you serve.

With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers.
