The Opportunity

Employers, health plans, and benefits leaders make healthcare decisions that affect millions of lives. Hinge Health’s events bring these leaders together around evidence, practical insights, and new ideas to help them improve health outcomes, expand access to care, and reduce costs. As Event Content Lead, you will shape what these audiences learn and take away, turning our expertise and the experiences of customers, partners, and industry leaders into ideas they can act on.

You will work closely with executives, customers, partners, and subject-matter experts to turn complex healthcare topics into clear, engaging, audience-relevant presentations. AI is part of the operating model for this role. You will use AI-powered tools to synthesize research, structure and draft content, pressure-test messaging, revise materials, and accelerate iteration while applying human judgment and maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.

For assigned events, you will own the event narrative strategy, including audience framing, objectives, themes, story arc, key messages, and content recommendations. You will own content development from research and narrative through slide-level content, wireframes, scripts, speaker coaching, rehearsals, run-of-show content, and day-of content coordination, then partner with Commercial Creative on final visual design. As the content show runner for Hinge Health-owned events, you will be accountable for content flow, speaker readiness, transitions, cues, and last-mile content changes. You will partner with the broader Events team and production partners on venue, AV, vendors, staffing, and general logistics rather than owning those functions.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build strong working relationships with senior executives, clients, partners, subject-matter experts, and cross-functional marketing partners.

  • Learn Hinge Health’s business, products, clinical model, messaging, audiences, and event priorities.

  • Establish a clear, repeatable working process for managing a high volume of presentation and event-content projects, with defined review gates, early stakeholder and speaker engagement, disciplined preparation, and clear communication of risks.

In your first 6 months

  • Develop presentation narratives, abstracts, slide-level content, wireframes, scripts, and supporting materials that are appropriately tailored to different external audiences and event goals, and are sufficiently developed to be ready for meaningful review and handoff to Commercial Creative.

  • Research and synthesize internal and external data, customer stories, healthcare topics, medical literature, and market context to strengthen presentation content.

  • Own event narrative strategy for assigned events, partnering with Communications, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Clinical to define audience framing, themes, key messages, story arc, and content recommendations.

  • Serve as the content producer and show runner for Hinge-owned events by owning the speaker and client-partner workstream, including timely outreach, content input, preparation sessions, rehearsals, content flow, speaker readiness, run-of-show materials, transitions, cues, and last-mile changes, while also preparing speaking proposals and other pre-event materials.

In your first year

  • Play a key role in developing agendas and sessions and coordinating presentations for Hinge Health’s flagship Movement conference and satellite On the Move regional events.

  • Coach presenters and speakers to prepare clear, compelling, and confident talks that support specific event goals and messages.

  • Manage a portfolio of simultaneous projects while maintaining strong communication, accountability, and follow-through, incorporating feedback quickly and minimizing avoidable last-minute changes.

  • Collect feedback, study strong external presentations, and help advance repeatable best practices for event content and presentation development.

Who You Are

  • Energized by presentations and events: You want presentation development, agenda planning, and session development to be central to your work. You enjoy the hands-on process of shaping a talk, building its slide-level content, and preparing speakers to deliver it.

  • A strategic storyteller: You can move between the ground-level details and the 50,000-foot view, then turn complex information into a clear and compelling narrative.

  • A strong communicator: You write and edit with precision, create engaging presentations, and adapt messages for audiences with different interests and levels of familiarity.

  • A trusted partner: You work effectively with executives, clients, partners, and subject-matter experts and handle sensitive information with discretion.

  • Comfortable managing many moving pieces: You thrive with a high volume of projects at different stages, from early planning to final rehearsals. You prioritize effectively, shift between projects without losing track of details, and keep contributors and deadlines on track.

  • A practical owner and producer: You bring creative ideas and push for differentiation, while also getting into the details, managing deadlines, coordinating contributors, and delivering finished work.

  • An AI-enabled operator: You use modern AI-powered tools as part of the core research, drafting, editing, and quality-improvement workflow, while applying sound judgment to the output.

  • A continuous improver: You actively seek feedback, incorporate input, and use strong external examples to improve presentation quality and working practices.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field and 6+ years of experience developing presentations and event content for external business audiences.

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing presentations for executive keynotes, conference sessions, webinars, or executive roundtables, from research and narrative through slide-level content, wireframes, and speaker notes. Work samples must demonstrate this experience and make your individual contribution clear.

  • Demonstrated experience planning event agendas and developing sessions, including defining audience objectives, themes, topics, session formats, and speaker roles to create a cohesive audience experience.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with executives, customers, and subject-matter experts to develop presentations, incorporate feedback, and prepare speakers through coaching and rehearsals.

  • A track record of managing a high volume of presentation and event-content projects at different stages, with overlapping deadlines and multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience serving as a content producer or show runner for events, with responsibility for speaker readiness, content flow, run-of-show materials, and live content coordination.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing knowledge of healthcare topics and dynamics affecting patients, providers, health plans, employers, and technology companies.

  • Ability to research and understand medical literature and use evidence to support presentation messages.

  • Ability to translate a large amount of siloed information into a digestible, compelling presentation or event narrative.

  • Strong project management and communication skills, with a track record of managing multiple workstreams and deadlines.

  • High proficiency with Microsoft Word or Google Docs and PowerPoint or Google Slides.

  • Excellent writing skills and a natural ability to tell stories.

  • Experience supporting or growing high-volume customer or thought-leadership event programs.

  • Demonstrated success securing speaking invitations or developing content for thought-leadership events.

  • Familiarity with the musculoskeletal, pain-management, digital-health, or broader healthcare technology industries.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

About the Role

As a Technical Support Specialist specializing in RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) and Internal Tools, you will play a unique and crucial role in assisting both new and existing members with product replacement and returns while providing efficient technical support for their hardware and software needs. Alongside your core RMA responsibilities, you will cross-train to provide vital, non-member-facing support for our internal systems, specifically assisting our Care Hub teams with internal tools issues and inquiries. You will also serve as an internal escalation reviewer for the Support team, ensuring quality in troubleshooting procedures. You must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong soft skills, keen attention to detail, superior organizational skills, a proactive attitude towards learning, and be comfortable handling multiple tasks simultaneously. You’ll consistently prioritize members’ needs while advocating for their seamless program experience and provide direct and efficient support in various communication channels.

 

The role would be ideal for an applicant with at least 1 year of software and/or hardware troubleshooting experience with exposure to and/or focus on product RMA processes. Things here evolve at a rapid pace, so you should be comfortable dealing with ambiguity. But this also means you’ll have the opportunity to grow in your role, as the company grows. We value autonomy in your role and actively support ongoing learning and development.

 

What You'll Accomplish

  • Diagnosing, investigating, documenting and resolving members problems related to Hinge Health products.

  • Develop extensive knowledge of our product including common technical challenges and troubleshooting techniques and act as a point of escalation reviewer for the Technical Support team.

  • Manage the end to end RMA process, including processing replacements and tracking returned Hinge Health products.

  • Maintain accurate records of RMA requests, product failures and resolutions.

  • Collaborate with teammates such as Logistics, Shipping, Field Quality, Compliance teams, and third-party vendors to coordinate product replacement and returns, ensuring compliance with company policies.

  • Maintains knowledge of technology innovations and trends.

  • Provide best in industry support, fielding inquiries and addressing them in a timely and professional manner, while leveraging high level soft skills and de-escalation methods.

  • Understand a member’s program journey by using and interpreting various technical platform tools.

  • Ensure prompt and clear communication for members & internal parties throughout the RMA process, while conveying warmth and empathy.

  • Adhere to key organizational metrics while upholding standards of quality and productivity.

  • Cross-train with the Internal Tools support team to field, troubleshoot, and resolve internal tickets from the Care Hub.

Basic Qualifications

  • Technical troubleshooting or IT help desk experience (minimum one year), with exposure or focus on RMA/ Logistics processes.

  • Excellent and well-rounded member-facing as well as internal stakeholder-facing communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically in high-pressure situations.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks along with excellent time management skills.

  • Proficiency in conducting thorough root cause analysis for technical issues.

  • Confidence with multitasking - managing multiple communication channels efficiently along with processes and workflows simultaneously.

  • Experience with customer support tools (e.g. Zoom, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce) to resolve technical issues and/or process returns and replacements for end users.

  • Experience with mobile and/or data management tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Linear, Tableau, Auth0, Esper MDM) to properly diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues.

  • Flexibility with your schedule. Your work hours will be based on business needs and may include nights and weekends although the role doesn’t currently include nights or weekends.

  • Able to effectively work in a remote environment and be depended on for excellent punctuality and proactive communication.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare background, and/or previous healthcare tech experience.

  • Remote work experience.

  • Prior experience in a dedicated Internal Help Desk, Care Hub support, or Internal Tools support role.

  • Familiarity or experience adhering to PHI/PII compliance standard for health care users.

  • Logistics experience with medical devices & hardware.

  • Experience with Supply Chain management system(s).

 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

 

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

The Opportunity

Bring your clinical expertise to a technology-enabled headache and migraine care model that expands access to high-quality care and helps members reduce symptoms, improve daily function, and achieve meaningful clinical outcomes.

As an Advanced Practice Provider (APP) at Hinge Health, you’ll be an essential part of our comprehensive clinical care team, using your expertise in headache and migraine care to virtually evaluate and treat adults with migraine and other headache disorders. Through video visits, in-app messaging, and digital tools, you’ll deliver patient-centered, evidence-informed care grounded in established headache guidelines and a whole-person approach. You’ll develop individualized care plans, help members make informed decisions about their treatment options, and provide guidance on acute and preventive treatment, medications, lifestyle, and triggers.

You’ll help members access the right care at the right time by selecting appropriate diagnostic testing and coordinating neurology referrals, behavioral health, and other in-person care when needed. Working alongside physicians, physical therapists, coaches, Care Coordinators, and other care providers, you’ll contribute clinical expertise to a connected approach to treatment. As Hinge Health’s partnerships, care pathways, and product capabilities evolve, you’ll share clinical insights that help shape the future of technology-enabled headache and migraine care.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Learn Hinge Health’s virtual care workflows, clinical guidelines, technology, and care pathways.

  • Begin delivering comprehensive, evidence-informed virtual headache and migraine evaluations and individualized care plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with members and care-team partners through clear communication, empathy, and reliable follow-through.

In your first 6 months

  • Independently conduct comprehensive virtual headache and migraine evaluations, interpret clinical information, and develop individualized care plans informed by established headache and migraine guidelines and a whole-person approach.

  • Engage members in shared decision-making by explaining clinical findings, discussing appropriate acute, preventive, pharmacologic, and non-pharmacologic treatment options, and outlining risks, benefits, and next steps.

  • Select appropriate diagnostic testing based on the member’s presentation, recognize red flags that require urgent evaluation, and coordinate with physicians, Care Coordinators, and other care-team partners on referrals, provider access, scheduling, and follow-up across neurology, behavioral health, and other in-person care.

In your first year

  • Manage a large, varied caseload safely and efficiently, supporting member satisfaction, care-plan follow-through, clinical outcomes, and a connected care experience.

  • Share clinical insights that inform product development and help improve technology-enabled headache and migraine care across Hinge Health care programs and the broader care model

Who You Are

  • You bring sound clinical judgment and headache or migraine expertise to virtual evaluation, treatment, and care management, adapting as evidence, feedback, workflows, technology, and care pathways evolve.

  • You communicate clearly with members, physicians, and care-team partners. You explain complex clinical information in practical terms, helping members make informed decisions about appropriate treatment options.

  • You build trust through empathy, curiosity, respect, attentive listening, and shared decision-making.

  • You are organized, adaptable, accountable, and resourceful. You prioritize competing clinical needs, maintain thorough documentation and follow-through in a virtual care environment, honor commitments, and respond constructively to change.

  • You lead at all levels by contributing your expertise, influencing care-team decisions, and finding thoughtful ways to improve care quality, operations, the member experience, and how virtual care is delivered.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of post-licensure clinical experience in outpatient neurology or primary care, treating adults with migraine and other headache disorders.

  • Nurse Practitioner: Graduate of an accredited nurse practitioner education program and current board certification as a Nurse Practitioner with a primary certification appropriate to the specialty, such as FNP or AGNP.

  • Physician Assistant/Physician Associate: Graduate of an ARC-PA-accredited physician assistant program and current NCCPA certification allowing use of the PA-C designation.

  • Active, unrestricted NP or PA licensure in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to obtain additional required state licenses within a reasonable timeframe.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently prescribe medications within scope of practice.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose headache and migraine disorders, recognize red flags that require urgent evaluation, select appropriate diagnostic testing, recognize appropriate referral interventions, and apply diagnostic findings, including laboratory and neuroimaging results, to clinical decisions.

  • Willingness to work across time zones to serve a geographically diverse member population, including evenings and weekends as needed.

  • Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials.

  • You must be able to deliver telehealth services in a private, professional space with reliable, strong internet connectivity and within the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Nurse Practitioner: Neurology- or headache-focused certification where available, such as AQH or the AANN Neuro-APP certificate.

  • Physician Assistant/Physician Associate: Neurology- or headache-focused certification where available, such as AQH or the AANN Neuro-APP certificate.

  • Medical fluency in Spanish, written and verbal.

  • Knowledge of lifestyle medicine.

  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, or hybrid care delivery settings.

  • Located in the Central or Eastern time zones, or able to cover core virtual clinic hours.

Remote Role Expectations

This is a remote role supporting members across the United States. You must be able to provide care from a private, professional workspace with reliable internet connectivity and maintain the licensure required for the members you serve.

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI), and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401(k) retirement plan options, which include a 2% company match.

IN YOUR FIRST YEAR - Manage a large, varied caseload safely and efficiently, supporting member satisfaction, care-plan follow-through, clinical outcomes, and a connected care experience. - Share clinical insights that inform product development and help improve technology-enabled headache and migraine care across Hinge Health care programs and the broader care model WHO YOU ARE - You bring sound clinical judgment and headache or migraine expertise to virtual evaluation, treatment, and care management, adapting as evidence, feedback, workflows, technology, and care pathways evolve. - You communicate clearly with members, physicians, and care-team partners. You explain complex clinical information in practical terms, helping members make informed decisions about appropriate treatment options. - You build trust through empathy, curiosity, respect, attentive listening, and shared decision-making. - You are organized, adaptable, accountable, and resourceful. You prioritize competing clinical needs, maintain thorough documentation and follow-through in a virtual care environment, honor commitments, and respond constructively to change. - You lead at all levels by contributing your expertise, influencing care-team decisions, and finding thoughtful ways to improve care quality, operations, the member experience, and how virtual care is delivered. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of post-licensure clinical experience in outpatient neurology or primary care, treating adults with migraine and other headache disorders. - Nurse Practitioner: Graduate of an accredited nurse practitioner education program and current board certification as a Nurse Practitioner with a primary certification appropriate to the specialty, such as FNP or AGNP. - Physician Assistant/Physician Associate: Graduate of an ARC-PA-accredited physician assistant program and current NCCPA certification allowing use of the PA-C designation. - Active, unrestricted NP or PA licensure in at least one U.S. state, with the ability to obtain additional required state licenses within a reasonable timeframe. - Demonstrated ability to independently prescribe medications within scope of practice. - Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose headache and migraine disorders, recognize red flags that require urgent evaluation, select appropriate diagnostic testing, recognize appropriate referral interventions, and apply diagnostic findings, including laboratory and neuroimaging results, to clinical decisions. - Willingness to work across time zones to serve a geographically diverse member population, including evenings and weekends as needed. - Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials. - You must be able to deliver telehealth services in a private, professional space with reliable, strong internet connectivity and within the United States. About the Role

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals to join our Commercial Team as an individual contributor selling into the employer benefit space within a defined territory. The open territory consists of the Southeast. You must reside in this territory to be considered. You’ll have a unique opportunity to shape Hinge Health’s growth and product. You’ll be involved in every aspect of our commercial process: sourcing & developing leads, driving customers to close and managing relationships with our mid market customers (2,000-7,500 lives). You'll have visibility into the entire company, work side-by-side with our co-founders and product team, and lead commercial strategy sessions.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Work individually, and with Partnerships & Marketing to develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of self-insured employer clients ranging from 2,000-7,500 lives in your region.

  • Independently take deals from initial to conversation to close (both up-sell current clients and sell net-new business).

  • Collaborate with legal on contract negotiation & signature

  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure successful implementation of our program, as well as renewals / upsells.

  • Contribute to product roadmap by feeding back the customer's voice

Basic Qualifications

  • You must reside in this territory to be considered.

  • Bachelor degree and at least 5 years work experience.

  • Background in employer sales, with a history of closing small and mid-large, complex deals with a long sales-cycle.

  • Subject matter expertise in healthcare, employee health benefits, chronic disease management, or digital health

  • History of consistently attaining / exceeding quota.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent project management, organization, and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working with the ambiguity of a fast-paced startup - ability to innovate, and solve problems creatively

  • Desire to learn, grow, develop, and eventually mentor future team members

About Hinge Health

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

What You'll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development

The Opportunity

Join the team that powers the engine of our clinical operations. As a Demand Enablement Associate, you will play a critical role in ensuring our members have access to care when they need it most. You will partner directly with Care Team Leaders to optimize workforce utilization, managing the complex daily puzzle of scheduling and capacity. By maintaining 100% data accuracy and identifying operational inefficiencies, you will help us deliver on our promise to help millions of people move beyond pain. The role provides real-time direction to optimize utilization, enabling Hinge Health to meet margin targets, while serving as the connective layer across cross-functional teams to drive continuous communication, proactively flag utilization risk, and dynamically update assignments. Designs, architects, and delivers executive-level operational intelligence and predictive capacity models for senior leadership, while leading the integration of AI workflows, custom agents, and automated pipeline tooling to systematically scale operational throughput.

  • Oversees all member and work task distribution within the assigned org by actively monitoring dashboards and adjusting scheduling proactively by partnering with front line managers, product, and analytics.

  • Gives strategic real time direction to managers and above in managing utilization based on real time demand.

  • Provides ongoing internal communications with cross functional orgs on load balancing and staffing requirements. This role is required to flag, in real time, utilization concerns, SLA concerns and overall staffing gaps.

  • Monitors and maintains daily utilization targets, service levels, and other key metrics in real time, reporting and other internal tools.

  • Attend critical meetings with stakeholders to share real time findings, propose permanent solutions and escalate additional real time requirements.

  • Compiles and distributes key DE reports to leaders. Understand what is expected to meet utilization and service targets for the current day and beyond.

  • Partner with Finance to drive gross margin targets and optimize COGS inputs, leading cross-functional product initiatives to consistently hit cost efficiency and margin goals.

  • Comfortable presenting to large groups and synthesizing operational data into executive level presentations.

  • Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to tailor engagement strategies to meet the unique needs and priorities of diverse stakeholders.

 

What You'll Accomplish

  • Incorporating unique workload variations into assignments, improving key metrics

  • Drives Workday configuration standards, holiday planning models, and workforce scheduling governance.

  • Establishes and optimizes core operational productivity frameworks (utilization, fill rate, handle time, unit economics) to maximize gross margins.

  • Owning improvements and accuracy for all processes and responsibilities

  • Owning headcount planning for specific teams, calculating scenarios and ensuring COGS goals are achieved.

  • Architects AI automation pipelines to systematically reduce operational friction.

  • Build dashboards to manage workload and track key metrics

Who You Are

  • Action Oriented: You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift. You can handle urgent operational issues (like a coverage gap) without losing sight of your critical deadlines.

  • Detail Obsessed: You don’t just enter data; you have a personal system for ensuring 100% accuracy before you hit "publish." You spot discrepancies that others miss.

  • A "Hustler": You find creative paths through constraints. When you see a metric trending the wrong way, you don't wait for permission—you investigate and take immediate action to turn it around.

  • Collaborative Communicator: You can give real-time direction to managers and clearly articulate "the why" behind staffing changes, even when met with pushback.

Basic Qualifications

  • Skilled in GoogleSheets and Excel, ability to do vlookups, sumifs, and formatting

  • Experience with AI tooling, building agents and automations

  • Proven track record of managing complex, high-stakes operational environments under strict SLA constraints.

  • Highly organized with an emphasis on accuracy and timeliness

  • Skilled in problem solving, sound judgment, and critical thinking

  • Able to understand the impact of timely actions on team deliverables and broader business outcomes

  • Highly analytical, process-oriented thinker with the ability to communicate insights clearly

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency in operational data modeling (SQL, Python, advanced Excel).

  • Demonstrated executive presence with experience influencing VP+ stakeholders and driving organizational change management.

  • Ability to take ownership of a problem, put together a plan, drive a cross functional team to a solution

  • Healthcare + start-up experience is a plus

  • Advanced experience with AI tooling, building agents and automations

  • Experience working with the Scheduling module in Zendesk

The Opportunity

Every day, thousands of people apply to Hinge Health seeking relief from musculoskeletal pain — and this role is at the heart of getting them connected to care. As an Associate, Member Operations, you'll join the team responsible for ensuring applicants are routed to the right Care Team members quickly and efficiently, directly maximizing onboarding rates (Effective Yield) and member satisfaction. You'll balance strategic operational work with member-facing communication to help people move beyond pain, faster.

This is an opportunity to see the "big picture" of how operations power a healthcare company while rolling up your sleeves to improve our processes every day — from managing enrollment workflows to collaborating cross-functionally on go-to-market launches.

 

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

  • Master the Member Operations Playbook and achieve 95%+ resolution rate on Manual Review cases within established SLAs

  • Build relationships with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Care Team, Revenue) to understand the full member enrollment journey

  • Create clear, consistent documentation of actions taken on member accounts and establish yourself as a reliable contributor to team knowledge

In your first 6 months:

  • Proactively identify process gaps and contribute strategic recommendations to improve member experience or optimize costs

  • Support go-to-market processes for new products by developing workflows that unblock member enrollment during launches

  • Drive operational improvements that measurably increase Effective Yield or reduce manual review backlogs

In your first year:

  • Own and refine operational workflows end-to-end, demonstrating the ability to carry forward action plans with minimal oversight

  • Collaborate on initiatives that scale and transform areas of the company — such as duplicate account management, program transitions, or insurance verification — to drive innovation and financial results

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on member enrollment operations, training new team members and proactively surfacing recommendations to leadership

Who You Are

  • A Learn-it-all: You thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly to new processes. You don't wait to be taught — you dig in, ask questions, and build understanding fast.

  • An Effective Communicator: Your written communication is clear, concise, and actionable. You can distill complex member cases into documentation that anyone on the team can follow.

  • Accountable & Detail-Oriented: You understand that timeliness and accuracy in your work directly impacts members' ability to access care. You meet SLAs consistently and take ownership of your results.

  • 1–2 years of relevant experience (e.g., customer/member-facing roles with a high level of operational responsibility)

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns from complex use cases

  • Effective decision-making driven and informed by data

  • Excellent written communication skills (memo writing, documentation)

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple processes and workflows simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare or start-up experience

  • Experience working with health insurance

  • Previous experience with customer support tools (e.g., ZenDesk, FreshDesk, or HelpScout)

  • Previous experience navigating internally-built products

  • Experience in high-performing teams with a focus on cross-functional collaboration and rapid testing

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com

Clinical Product Consultant (PT)

The Opportunity

Help transform how millions of people access musculoskeletal (MSK) care by bringing your clinical expertise into Hinge Health’s digital platform. As a Clinical Product Consultant, you’ll apply your knowledge of MSK care, movement, and pain science to support the design and improvement of exercise therapy programs, assessments, and clinical tools. You’ll partner closely with product, design, user research, and operations to make high-quality, evidence-based care more accessible at scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Learn Hinge Health’s clinical programs and tools, including exercise therapy, education, Enso, care management, care automation, and AI.

  • Build strong working relationships with product management, design, user research, and PT operations partners to understand workflows, priorities, and decision-making processes.

  • Begin reviewing product experiences and clinical content with guidance from senior Clinical Product Consultants, providing clear, actionable feedback grounded in evidence-based MSK care.

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to clinical requirements, user stories, and decision-making for MSK features and workflows, incorporating input from internal and external stakeholders.

  • Help co-design and iterate on exercise therapy and education journeys that balance clinical rigor, usability, and engagement for diverse member populations, including women’s health, migraine, and high-risk populations.

  • Own small to medium-sized workstreams—such as a program update, content refresh, or feature refinement—with regular guidance and support from senior team members.

By your first year, you will:

  • Serve as a go-to clinical partner for a subset of product areas, consistently delivering high-quality input on feature design, clinical content, and care team workflows.

  • Help monitor and interpret clinical and product metrics, including engagement, adherence, and outcomes, and use those insights to recommend iterative improvements.

  • Contribute to team documentation and best practices for integrating MSK, lifestyle medicine, and pain neuroscience principles into digital product experiences.

Who You Are

  • An MSK-focused clinician: You bring expertise in musculoskeletal conditions, movement evaluation, exercise physiology, the biopsychosocial model of care, and pain neuroscience education. Additional training in pain neuroscience education, pain reprocessing therapy, or lifestyle medicine—such as sleep and nutrition—is a plus.

  • A developing product partner: You have experience working with product, design, or operations teams—or the aptitude and motivation to learn how technology products are built, evaluated, and iterated.

  • A clear, collaborative communicator: You can explain clinical concepts and tradeoffs in accessible language, write actionable recommendations, and build trust with clinical and non-clinical partners. You embody Effective Communication by being clear, concise, and responsive.

  • An organized owner: You manage your priorities and smaller workstreams effectively, raise questions and risks early, and follow through on commitments with growing independence. You demonstrate Accountability by acting in Hinge Health’s best interest and delivering on what you commit to.

  • A learn-it-all: You stay curious about emerging evidence in healthcare delivery and digital health technologies, including computer vision and AI. You welcome feedback, learn from others, and continuously look for ways to improve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Current license or certification as a Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), nurse practitioner (NP), athletic trainer (ATC), occupational therapist (OT), physical therapist assistant (PTA), or equivalent clinician, with 3+ years of post-licensure clinical experience delivering physical therapy or other conservative MSK care.

  • Demonstrated expertise in MSK conditions, pain neuroscience education, movement evaluation, exercise physiology, lifestyle medicine, and the biopsychosocial model of care.

  • Experience collaborating with non-clinical partners—such as product managers, designers, engineers, or operations leaders—to improve programs, workflows, or tools, along with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a technology or digital health company, or contributing to clinical program or product design.

  • Training or experience in psychology-informed PT approaches, such as mindfulness, pain reprocessing therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), or acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT).

  • Interest in or familiarity with rehabilitation technologies, computer vision, or AI—including large language models—applied to MSK care.

  • Coursework or additional training in neuroscience or lifestyle medicine.

  • Experience using member, clinical, or product data to evaluate care experiences and inform improvements.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds.

Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Candidates who live outside the Bay Area must be able to relocate within three months of their start date.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide.

Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI), and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs, and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

  • Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401(k) retirement plan options, which include a 2% company match.

  • Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

  • Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.

We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application, you are acknowledging that we use your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy.

Beware of Phishing Attempts

We’ve noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We’ll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use “@hingehealth.com” emails.

If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.
